title: ОСОБЕ СА ИСКУСТВОМ ЖИВОТА У БЕСКУЋНИШТВУ КАО КОРИСНИЦИ БИБЛИОТЕЧКИХ УСЛУГА: СТАВОВИ И ИСКУСТВА БИБЛИОТЕКАРА
abstract: Summary This paper presents the results of a study conducted through a series of interactive professional seminars held during 2026 in several public libraries and the National Library of Serbia, focusing on the provision of library services for people experiencing homelessness. The broader context of the study encompassed issues of inclusive librarianship, understanding the needs of library users with specific needs, familiarity with the legal framework that supports the implementation of the equal rights agenda for all, and the application of international recommendations that facilitate more effective work by librarians with members of vulnerable social groups. An analysis of librarians’ attitudes toward library services for people experiencing homelessness, as well as an overview of the current state of inclusive librarianship in Serbian libraries, was based on a survey conducted during the seminars. The survey findings also served as a basis for defining recommended measures aimed at achieving best practices in this field. The paper describes the main topics, objectives, and conclusions of the seminars, with the intention of promoting this research model as applicable to other contemporary issues of importance to librarianship at the national level. The primary aim of this paper is to draw the attention of the professional community to the complex social issue of homelessness, which requires a comprehensive approach in which libraries play a highly significant role.

title: УНИВЕРЗИТЕТСКА БИБЛИОТЕКА И ПОДРШКА ДОКТОРСКИМ СТУДИЈАМА: РАД НА ДОДАТНОМ ОБРАЗОВАЊУ МЛАЂИХ ИСТРАЖИВАЧА
abstract: Summary This paper presents a range of activities carried out by the University Library “Svetozar Marković” that are related to doctoral dissertations and doctoral studies. It provides an overview of educational programs and other information services that were ultimately consolidated and systematized in 2022 through the establishment of the Centre for Doctoral Studies Support (CDSS). The founding of the Centre marked a key milestone, not only in bringing together existing activities related to doctoral studies but also as an important prerequisite for their further development. In the years that followed, with the support of the Ministry of Science, Technological Development and Innovation of the Republic of Serbia, the Centre launched an extensive educational program comprising seminars, presentations, and workshops on topics important to scientific research. By mid-2026, the program had engaged dozens of distinguished lecturers and attracted several thousand participants. In addition to cooperating with partner institutions—centers affiliated with university libraries at other universities in Serbia—the CDSS seeks to strengthen its communication with doctoral students to ensure the continuous evaluation and improvement of its work. All activities are carried out with the aim of fulfilling the Centre’s mission: to enhance the research activities of higher education institutions by assisting members of the academic community who are at the very beginning of their scientific careers.

title: ВИШЕ ОД ПРОНАЛАЖЕЊА ИНФОРМАЦИЈА: КОРИСНИЦИ И УСЛУГЕ ОДЕЉЕЊА ЗА НАУЧНЕ ИНФОРМАЦИЈЕ НАРОДНЕ БИБЛИОТЕКЕ СРБИЈЕ
abstract: Summary In 2001, the Department of Scientific Information of the National Library of Serbia initiated the establishment of KoBSON (Consortium of Libraries of Serbia for Unified Acquisition), intending to optimize the acquisition of foreign scientific information, transitioning from print to electronic publications, improving access to electronic resources, and promoting domestic scientific publishing. Today, 25 years after KoBSON’s founding, the Department’s activities remain focused on achieving and advancing these original goals. This paper provides an overview of their realization through a presentation of the most frequently used services that the Department offers to researchers in Serbia. Additionally, the paper describes the collaboration in providing assistance and support to scientific publishing in Serbia.

title: AWARENESS AND ATTITUDE OF LIBRARIANS TOWARD ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE FOR EFFECTIVE SERVICE DELIVERY IN UNIVERSITY LIBRARIES IN TARABA STATE, NIGERIA
abstract: University libraries are expected to provide fast, accurate, and technology-driven information services to support students, researchers, and academic staff. Although artificial intelligence (AI) tools can enhance cataloguing, reference services, and information retrieval, service delivery in many university libraries in Taraba State remains predominantly manual. Preliminary observations also indicate gaps in librarians’ awareness and attitudes toward AI, yet the extent to which these factors influence service delivery is unclear. This study examined librarians’ awareness and attitudes toward AI tools and their effect on information service delivery in university libraries in Taraba State. A descriptive survey design was adopted, involving 122 librarians from Federal University Wukari (FUW), Taraba State University (TSU) Jalingo, and Kwararafa University Wukari (KUW). Data from 117 valid questionnaires were analyzed using descriptive statistics and one-way ANOVA at the 0.05 significance level. Results showed a high level of AI awareness among librarians (overall mean = 4.19), with KUW exhibiting the highest consistency, followed by TSU and FUW. Attitudes toward AI were also strongly positive across all institutions (overall mean = 4.41). ANOVA revealed significant institutional differences in awareness (p = .000 < .05) and attitudes (p = .002 < .05), attributed to variations in training, exposure, and institutional support. The study concludes that librarians’ AI awareness and attitudes significantly shape the efficiency and quality of information service delivery. It recommends targeted AI training programmes, enhanced institutional support, and clear policy frameworks to strengthen AI adoption in university libraries in Taraba State.

title: Gender Stereotypes Make Women Invisible: The Presence of Female Scientists in the Media
abstract:
arXiv:2610.28640v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Interest in the situation of women scientists has increased in recent years. Scientific institutions and governmental authorities have launched initiatives to promote science as a vocation among women. Within this context, the effort made by the media in disseminating role models is of vital importance. The aim of this research is to analyse the presence of women scientists in the media, and to conduct an appraisal of the status granted to them and the image conveyed about them. To this end, we analysed the content published on the websites of the regional newspapers Berria, Gara, El Correo and Diario de Navarra between 2014 and 2019 citing women scientists and researchers (N = 2362). The results indicate that presence is greater in quantitative terms, as is the prominence given to them in headlines. However, the disciplines in which they practise and the stereotypes which are conveyed shape their image, which in the case of STEM areas emphasise their role as carers and their singularity in the scientific field.
thinking: 该研究采用内容分析法，对2014-2019年间四家地区性报纸网站中提及女性科学家的2362条内容进行了系统分析，样本量充足，方法规范。研究揭示了媒体在报道女性科学家时存在的学科分布不均和刻板印象问题，对科学传播实践具有直接的警示和改进价值。然而，研究主要依赖于传统的内容分析方法，未引入前沿的自然语言处理或大语言模型技术进行更深层次的语义或情感挖掘，技术方法相对传统。

title: Evolution of article processing charges in medicine: disciplinary position, access gaps and future prospects
abstract:
arXiv:2610.28643v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Medicine occupies a singular position in the open access economy: It is the field with the highest number of OA journals with APCs in DOAJ, the second largest by global APC expenditure with high rates of APC adoption among researchers in the Global South. This article analyses APC trajectories in medicine from a comparative disciplinary perspective, drawing together evidence from multiple studies to position medicine in relation to other scientific fields over the period 2009-2023. It documents price gaps between medical and biomedical subcategories, the particularly acute affordability challenges associated with publishing in global health journals and the structural asymmetry between the public urgency of medical knowledge and the cost of its dissemination. The article concludes with a reflection on alternative models and the conditions required for an equitable and sustainable open access transition in medicine.
thinking: 该论文聚焦医学领域的开放获取文章处理费（APCs）演变，通过整合多源数据（2009-2023年）进行跨学科比较分析，方法较为系统，揭示了医学子领域的价格差异和全球健康期刊的支付挑战等结构性问题。其优势在于选题具有明确的现实紧迫性，对政策制定有参考价值；不足在于作为一篇预印本，其具体数据来源和分析方法的细节透明度有待正式发表后进一步确认。

title: MultiphaseHUB for Evidence-Grounded Metadata Curation and Task-Aware Compression of Multiphase Data
abstract:
arXiv:2610.28644v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Multiphase transport experiments and simulations generate high-dimensional data whose scientific value depends on the physical conditions, sensing configuration, calibration, synchronization, uncertainty, and provenance accompanying the raw signals. These data are difficult to reuse when experimental context is scattered across publications and repositories, while large measurement volumes increase the cost of transfer and analysis. In this work, we introduce MultiphaseHUB as a community infrastructure and an integrated framework for organizing, discovering, and reusing multiphase transport data. The infrastructure connects externally hosted datasets with modality-specific metadata, publications, analysis tools, derived features, source repository links, and boundaries for reuse. Within this framework, we develop two complementary components: literature analysis and data curation, comprising Large Language Model (LLM)-assisted metadata extraction and an agentic literature-analyzer for quantitative values from figures; and modality-specific scientific data compression guided by the quantities of interest needed for downstream analysis. These components address the effort required to interpret heterogeneous sources and the cost of accessing useful information from high-dimensional measurements. Public multiphase datasets provide seed resources for illustrating the framework and its workflows. Building on these components, we outline a research roadmap encompassing cross-facility harmonization, multimodal alignment, task-aware retrieval and dataset valuation, and conditional reconstruction of missing modalities. MultiphaseHUB provides a foundation for connecting distributed data resources to physically meaningful comparison and cross-study scientific discovery.
thinking: 该论文提出一个面向多相流实验数据的社区基础设施框架，整合了LLM辅助的元数据提取和面向下游分析任务的数据压缩技术，技术前沿性突出。其框架设计直接针对科研数据管理中的实际痛点，如数据发现与重用成本高，具有明确的实践应用价值。然而，作为一篇概念性框架论文，其具体方法的实施细节和有效性验证尚不充分，方法严谨性有待后续实证研究支撑。

title: An Open-Source Data Infrastructure for Alloy Synthesis Research: Stage 1 --- Composition Screening and Literature Cross-Referencing
abstract:
arXiv:2610.28647v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Experimental materials-science labs routinely accumulate synthesis and characterization data across spreadsheets, instrument export files, and ad-hoc folders, with no durable link between a sample's recipe, its measured properties, and whether a similar composition has been reported elsewhere. We present Stage 1 of an open-source data infrastructure closing this loop for a single working alloy-synthesis lab: a relational schema for composition and synthesis records, a strict composition/mass calculator, three empirical alloy-design screening metrics (VEC, atomic-size mismatch, mixing enthalpy) plus a melt/boil-point synthesis-feasibility check, an automated cross-referencing layer against three public materials databases (Materials Project, OQMD, Alexandria) with deduplication and adjustable relevance filtering, and a desktop GUI unifying the workflow behind a single "new entry" action. Built and used by a practicing researcher rather than a software team, we report it as a systems/methodology contribution - the architecture, the concrete engineering failures encountered while building it, and how each was diagnosed and fixed - rather than new materials-science results. We argue the specific defects found - a parser ambiguity that produced silent wrong answers, a partial code edit that broke a dependency chain invisibly, a database-metadata bug traceable to an un-cast numeric type, and a credential-hygiene gap that .gitignore alone did not close - generalize to any small scientific-software project built by a domain expert without formal software-engineering training. Both the system and the lessons from building it are reported here; two follow-on papers cover the validated characterization pipelines (Stage 2) and the retrieval-augmented synthesis advisor and CALPHAD thermodynamics module (Stage 3) built on this foundation.
thinking: 该论文提出了一套面向合金合成研究的开源数据基础设施，其核心贡献在于将实验室日常产生的合成与表征数据（如配方、测量属性）与公共材料数据库进行自动化关联和去重，并提供了桌面GUI以简化工作流程。论文在方法严谨性上表现突出，详细记录了开发过程中遇到的具体工程缺陷及其解决方案，具有较高的可复现性和借鉴价值；然而，其技术方案主要基于关系型数据库和自动化脚本，未涉及当前最前沿的大语言模型或深度学习技术，因此在技术前沿性上得分一般。
one_sentence_summary: 这篇论文为合金合成实验室开发了一套开源数据管理工具，能自动关联实验数据与公共数据库，并分享了构建过程中的具体工程经验教训。

title: Building Knowledge Graphs for Theses: A Survey
abstract:
arXiv:2610.28648v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Academic theses are a valuable source of scientific knowledge, yet their semantic exploitation remains limited. While Scholarly Knowledge Graphs have significantly advanced the representation of scientific publications, knowledge graph construction for academic theses has received comparatively limited attention. This paper provides a systematic review of existing approaches and analyzes their potential application for the thesis domain. We analyzed 46 peer-reviewed studies published between 2021 and 2025, and organised existing approaches into a structured classification of techniques, models, and tools. The review reveals a methodological evolution from natural language processing techniques for entity and relation extraction to ontology engineering, Semantic Web technologies, and AI-driven enrichment through knowledge graph embeddings, Linked Open Data, and Large Language Models. The findings provide a consolidated view of the current state of the art and identify methodological foundations and future research directions for building knowledge graphs for the thesis domain.
thinking: 该论文对学位论文知识图谱构建方法进行了系统性综述，梳理了从传统自然语言处理到语义网技术及大语言模型驱动的演进脉络，具有较好的前沿技术覆盖度。然而，作为一篇综述性文章，其本身并未提出新的方法或进行实证验证，因此在方法严谨性和直接业务落地价值上存在局限。
one_sentence_summary: 这篇综述系统梳理了构建学位论文知识图谱的技术演进路径，并指出了从传统信息抽取到大语言模型应用的未来方向。

title: Zero-Cost Detection of Fabricated Citations: A Staged Heuristic Approach for Computing Dissertation Assessment
abstract:
arXiv:2610.28649v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Generative AI's growing role in academic writing has driven a rise in fabricated references across dissertations and student reports. We present the Fabrication Severity Stack (FSS), a three-tiered framework classifying citation fabrications by detection complexity - from non-existent references to subtle content misattribution. Building on the FSS, we propose a staged heuristic verification workflow, executable through mainstream LLM interfaces. We argue that this framework offers computer science educators/examiners a practical, zero-cost basis for embedding reference verification into the assessment of dissertation and students' reports. In a pilot study on 100 citations (20% seeded with Level 1 and Level 2 fabrications), the proposed heuristic workflow enabled mainstream LLM interfaces to correctly flag 9-10 of 10 non-existent references and partially detect metadata corruption. These preliminary results suggest that freely accessible, general-purpose LLMs can achieve high recall on citation verification without reliance on proprietary detection tools.
thinking: 该论文针对生成式AI导致的虚假引用问题，提出了一个实用的分阶段启发式检测框架，并利用主流LLM接口实现零成本验证，具有明确的实践价值。其方法基于分类框架和试点研究，但样本量较小（100条引文），且仅验证了初级和中级的伪造类型，方法严谨性有待更大规模验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种利用通用大语言模型零成本检测学位论文中虚假引用的分阶段启发式方法。

title: The CIDOC CRM Periodic Table: Documentation You Can Test to Support the Adoption of Scientific Research Ontologies for the Humanities
abstract:
arXiv:2610.28650v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: The CIDOC CRM family is not only a schema for museum collections. Its extensions formalise the apparatus through which research knowledge is produced and justified: CRMsci models scientific observation and measurement, CRMdig the provenance of digital processes, CRMinf inference and belief. Together they constitute a schema for research data, and the obstacle to their adoption is documentary rather than theoretical: four normative documents, four code conventions, and eighty-nine typed links crossing document boundaries. This paper presents the CIDOC CRM Periodic Table, a single-page browser rendering 131 classes and 480 property entries from CIDOC CRM 7.1.3, CRMsci 3.2, CRMdig 5.0 and CRMinf 1.2.1 as one navigable surface, with two inference facilities: a one-step triple builder admitting only the class-property combinations licensed by declared domains, ranges and the subclass closure, and a multi-step path finder enumerating property chains between two classes. Because all loaded models are merged into one code-keyed dictionary before the hierarchy closures are computed, both resolve chains that cross model boundaries; we document the addition of CRMsci and the three cross-model tests it made possible, and report preliminary uptake signals from 56 months of analytics, with the reading they support.
thinking: 该论文提出了CIDOC CRM周期表这一工具，旨在通过整合多个本体模型并提供一个可测试的文档界面，降低人文社科领域采用科学研究本体的技术门槛。其优势在于将复杂的本体规范转化为可操作的交互式工具，具有明确的实践导向；不足在于作为工具介绍，其方法论的严谨性主要体现在工具设计本身，而非广泛的实证研究。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究开发了一个整合多版本CIDOC CRM本体的交互式“周期表”工具，旨在通过可视化与推理功能，促进研究数据本体在人文领域的实际应用。

title: The Scientific Research Taste Benchmark (SciTaste-Bench): A Multi-Disciplinary Benchmark for Assessing Large Language Models' Judgment of Research Taste in Scientific Papers
abstract:
arXiv:2610.28653v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Whether large language models can assess the innovativeness of academic publications matters for literature reviews, research funding screening, and academic recommendations. We introduce the Scientific Research Taste Benchmark (SciTaste), a gold-standard benchmark covering six disciplines: physics, mathematics, chemistry, biology, medicine, and finance. SciTaste measures research taste, that is, the ability to judge a paper's scientific value and potential, of which innovativeness is one of seven dimensions. It integrates metadata from NASA ADS, OpenAlex, and arXiv, aligns papers to field-specific classification systems, and scores each paper with the seven-dimensional Academic Taste Index. Dimension weights come from a bi-objective machine-learning approach (five regressors, including random forests) and are shared across all six disciplines. The benchmark includes 300 selected papers (50 per discipline) and a backup pool of 5,700 papers (950 per field) covering 1996-2023. SciTaste supports four evaluation modes: pure_qa, native_search, our structured tool-calling agent DiM (9 bibliometric tools in ADS/OpenAlex), and dimagent_v3_native. Outputs are evaluated by two complementary schemes: correlation with dimension-level accuracy, and WAPE relative error. Across ten state-of-the-art LLMs, tool-based structured evaluation generally outperformed toolless and raw web search modes, though gains were model-dependent. Physics is easiest; chemistry, biology, and medicine remain more challenging. SciTaste supplies the value-judgment substrate auto-research systems need to screen, rank, and prioritize candidate ideas. Dataset, harness, and scoring code are available on Hugging Face at https://huggingface.co/datasets/skylenage/SciTaste-benchmark.
thinking: 该论文构建了一个跨学科基准数据集，用于评估大语言模型对科研论文创新性等维度的判断能力，技术方法前沿且数据集构建规范。但基准目前规模有限，且评估结果对实际科研资助或文献筛选的直接应用路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究创建了一个多学科基准数据集，用于系统评估大语言模型判断科研论文价值与潜力的能力。

title: What Git Does Not Record: Provenance Legibility in Two AI-Assisted Research Repositories
abstract:
arXiv:2610.28655v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Publishers and funders increasingly ask authors to disclose how AI tools contributed to a piece of research. In computational work the repository is where an author or an auditor would look for the answer, and we ask what it can actually supply. We audit two single-investigator repositories by the same author in the same field, each carrying a different class of agent residue: a prescriptive trace of standing rule files and a narrative trace of a running agent scratchpad, in repositories of 466 and 103 commits. The two are legible in opposite ways. 85.6% of the lines ever committed to the prescriptive trace are visible at the current revision, and a standing rule states a conclusion and discards the episode behind it; the narrative trace records episodes and shows 21.8%. Counted by revision the gap is far smaller: 15 of the prescriptive trace's 41 revisions leave no visible line, against 18 of the narrative trace's 41. The Co-Authored-By trailer, the field an automated audit reads, is one of three AI trailer keys Project A carries and covers 66 of the 121 commits carrying any. In Project B it has low sensitivity against an explicit within-repository proxy: 39 commits revise a file maintained to hold an agent's working notes and 1 (2.6%) carries the trailer. Project A's repository-level rate is unstable in time too, stepping from 2.7% to 17.7% across a boundary we did not specify in advance. Repository channels disagree, and neither rate can be read as an involvement rate; we do not isolate the cause, and say so. We give a field-by-field account of which provenance claims such traces support, which they cannot, and which they answer confidently and wrongly, construct an auditable evidence ledger, and derive the requirements this places on any system meant to record research provenance as it happens.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于AI辅助研究场景下的数据溯源问题，通过审计两个真实的研究代码仓库，实证分析了现有版本控制系统（如Git）在记录AI工具贡献方面的局限性和不确定性。其优势在于研究问题前沿且方法严谨，通过详细的量化对比揭示了不同记录方式的差异；不足之处在于样本量较小，且结论主要基于特定案例，普适性有待进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，在AI辅助的研究中，现有的代码仓库记录无法可靠地追溯AI工具的实际贡献，并提出了构建可审计证据账本的需求。

title: FutureLens: Longitudinal Topic Patterns in Scholarly Text and Future-Work References
abstract:
arXiv:2610.28656v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Future-work statements offer a record of the questions researchers choose to leave open. Using them to describe a field, however, requires separating thematic change from changes in document coverage, topic assignment, and scholarly writing. FutureLens examines these measurement issues in a recovered snapshot of 5,655 ACL papers published during 2012--2022, including 4,005 with supplied future-work reference text. We compare non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) and latent Dirichlet allocation (LDA), aggregate topic presence at the paper level, and examine normalized prevalence, exploratory trend statistics, assignment stability, and agreement between input-derived text and references. Across available seeds, NMF has higher mean normalized pointwise mutual information (0.1387 versus 0.1280) and higher pairwise assignment stability, while LDA has greater keyword diversity (0.8900 versus 0.7750). Seed-zero results show increasing prevalence of broad model-training and question-related vocabulary, alongside substantial citation and document-structure content. Mean input/reference topic-set overlap is 0.5191 for NMF and 0.4924 for LDA; temporal rank agreement varies widely and does not imply agreement in prevalence levels. These findings support a descriptive account of the available corpus, with explicit qualifications for missing references, incomplete runs, and unverified reference provenance. The contribution is an empirical measurement study of longitudinal scholarly signals, not a new topic-modeling algorithm or a forecasting system.
thinking: 论文采用非负矩阵分解和潜在狄利克雷分布两种主流主题模型方法，对计算语言学领域未来工作声明进行纵向分析，方法设计严谨，通过多种指标对比了模型性能。研究聚焦于测量方法本身，对领域主题演变的直接实践指导有限，且数据来源仅限于ACL会议论文，样本覆盖范围有待扩展。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究通过对比两种主题模型，系统分析了计算语言学论文中“未来工作”部分的主题演变模式及其测量方法的稳定性。

title: CompLit: Scientific Literature Search Benchmarks Must Cover Implicit, Cumulative, and Unmet Needs
abstract:
arXiv:2610.28658v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: How much can we trust an agent to find the paper we need? As researchers, we search the literature from what we have read toward what we have not. We thus describe what we want in our own terms, which a paper may show only implicitly; our requirements grow as we read; and what we seek may lie in an empty region no paper yet covers. We introduce CompLit, a literature search benchmark spanning all eight arXiv domains, with one diagnostic setting for each of these needs. The strongest agents, Codex (GPT-5.6-Sol) and Claude Code (Opus 4.8), answer 86-87% of Standard queries, yet fall to 66-68% when requirements are implicit (implicit), lose another 6 and 15pp, respectively, as they accumulate (cumulative), and abstain on at most 53% of the queries no paper satisfies (unmet). No agent leads in every domain, and all are less accurate on papers from before 2019 or after 2023. Tracing their search, we find that agents often reach the right paper, or the closest one, yet misjudge it. Doing well on CompLit is a step toward agents that we can trust to find the paper we need, or to tell us that none exists.
thinking: 该论文提出了一个覆盖arXiv八个领域的文献搜索基准CompLit，针对隐性、累积性和未满足需求设计了诊断性测试，具有较强的技术前沿性和方法严谨性。其研究直接指向提升智能代理在学术搜索中的可靠性，具有明确的实践应用价值，但作为基准研究，其直接落地性略低于具体的系统开发或服务创新。
one_sentence_summary: 论文提出了一个能评估智能代理处理隐性、累积性及未满足信息需求的科学文献搜索基准，揭示了当前最先进模型的局限性。

title: Beyond source attribution: Address authorship and comparability decisions in an LLM-built scholarly knowledge graph
abstract:
arXiv:2610.28663v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: A knowledge graph needs a stable address for its evidence even where the literature offers competing classifications and agrees on none. Yet an address chosen for retrieval readily passes for the only classification available. This happens whenever records gathered under one name concern units that differ in boundaries, rank, or the criteria by which they are described or counted. In Sinitic dialectology the same localities recur in schemes whose units differ in membership and rank, and a unit may change its affiliation when the evidence for its diagnosis changes. Two tone counts, each quoted faithfully, may still count different things. The taxonomy of an entire field thus comes to rest on the unstable frame of a literature that contradicts itself. Neither verifying a quotation nor searching for conflicting values detects these differences. I distinguish the working address that gathers candidate evidence, the category that the source defines and the decision that admits a passage to a particular comparison, and argue that such decisions, together with the dependence among records, belong to the provenance of a comparison. On four re-runnable cases, the accompanying PaRAGraph Casebook shows where such differences arise among claims extracted by a language model and verified before entering the graph. The platform now stores the corresponding decisions as objects for one dimension of comparability, the address of a record: the placement of a locality in each source's scheme, the decision that a name in a given publication denotes a unit rather than a place, and the origin of every address. The working taxonomy can then be revised as new sources yield new claims, while the path from each comparison to its evidence stays fixed. Keywords: knowledge graphs; source attribution; classification; claim extraction; comparative concepts; Sinitic dialectology; Yue
thinking: 该论文探讨了在利用大语言模型构建学术知识图谱时，如何超越简单的来源归属，处理文献中存在的分类不一致和可比性问题，并提出了一个记录相关决策的框架。其优势在于敏锐地指出了当前知识图谱构建中一个被忽视但至关重要的方法论问题，并提供了可操作的解决方案和案例；不足在于其研究案例聚焦于汉语方言学这一特定领域，其方法的普适性和在其他学科中的落地效果有待进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 论文提出在利用大语言模型构建知识图谱时，需系统记录关于实体分类和可比性的决策，以确保证据链的稳定和可追溯。

title: Learning Checklists to Reduce Lottery Effects in Scientific Peer Review
abstract:
arXiv:2610.28666v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Reviewer lottery error describes error due to a small set of peer reviews attending to only some of the issues with a paper that a larger pool of eligible reviewers would raise. We show this error can be reduced by surfacing a checklist of criticisms learned from a historical review corpus. Our approach generates a tree of checklists representing coarsenings of the atomic review claim space, then selects the coarsening that maximizes a theoretically-motivated measure of correlated agreement among reviewers. We realize this approach with an LLM-assisted pipeline and test it on NeurIPS 2021 and ICLR 2022 review data. In simulated review with LLM reviewers, the learned checklist reduces the mean squared error (MSE) of a three reviewer committee by 58% on NeurIPS and 21% on ICLR, and on both venues the checklist with the highest correlated agreement has the lowest error for committees of three or more. In a human study with 20 participants, the learned NeurIPS checklist lowers the MSE of a paper ranking, measured against the NeurIPS 2021 order, from 0.48 to 0.22.
thinking: 论文提出了一种利用历史评审语料生成检查清单以减少同行评审随机误差的方法，并采用了LLM辅助流程进行验证，技术方法具有前沿性。研究在模拟和人工实验中均展示了效果，但LLM模拟评审的假设可能不完全符合现实场景，且人类研究样本量较小，方法严谨性存在一定局限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究通过从历史评审中学习生成检查清单，能有效减少同行评审中的随机误差，提升评审结果的稳定性。

title: Epistemic Substitution: How Grokipedia's AI-Generated Encyclopedia Restructures Authority
abstract:
arXiv:2512.03337v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: For more than two decades, Wikipedia has represented a decentralized, human-curated model of encyclopedic knowledge production. The emergence of AI-generated encyclopedias, such as Grokipedia, raises a fundamental question: do human- and AI-curated knowledge systems rely on the same foundations of epistemic authority? We examine this question through a comparative analysis of 1,000 matched Wikipedia--Grokipedia article pairs, comprising nearly 600,000 citation instances. Using an eight-category classification scheme, we construct the epistemic profiles of articles to examine the institutional composition of their cited sources. Our findings reveal substantial differences in sourcing practices. Grokipedia relies proportionally less on academic and journalistic sources and more on user-generated content and NGO and think-tank publications. These differences persist across broad topic domains, although their magnitude varies by subject. We also find that Grokipedia adds citations approximately linearly as articles grow, whereas Wikipedia exhibits greater variation in citation density. Together, these findings suggest a shift in the institutional sources invoked to justify encyclopedic claims, which we characterize as epistemic substitution. For the same topics, the two encyclopedias rest on different institutional sources. Our findings underscore the importance of systematic, ongoing audits of information provenance for accountability in generative knowledge systems.
thinking: 该论文采用大规模对比分析方法，对新兴AI生成百科全书与维基百科的引用来源进行系统性审计，研究方法严谨，样本量充足。其发现揭示了AI知识系统在权威来源依赖上的结构性差异，对理解生成式AI的知识可信度具有直接实践价值，但技术方法本身属于成熟的文献计量分析，前沿性有限。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，AI生成的百科全书比维基百科更少依赖学术和新闻来源，而更多引用用户生成内容和非政府组织报告，改变了知识权威的构成基础。

title: RESEARCHHUB: A Personalized Literature Discovery System for Biomedical Preprints
abstract:
arXiv:2610.28636v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We present ResearchHub, an interactive system for personalized literature discovery over biomedical preprints. Given a researcher profile or a free-form query, ResearchHub retrieves relevant papers from a domain-specific MedRxiv corpus and helps users move beyond near-duplicate recommendations through controllable novelty, diversity, and curriculum ordering. At the core of the system is prism, a bi-encoder retriever adapted to biomedical preprints using GPT-4o-generated natural language queries and a hybrid Multiple Negatives Ranking plus MarginMSE objective with cross-encoder soft labels. On 44,937 MedRxiv papers from 2023--2025, prism outperforms strong off-the-shelf dense retrievers, improving Recall@10 over SPECTER2-Search by 12.4 percentage points. ResearchHub further supports frontier retrieval based on a user's reading history, DPP-based diversity re-ranking, Local Intrinsic Dimensionality ordering from mainstream to specialized papers, and lightweight attribution cards for result explanation. The full pipeline runs with low latency, making the system suitable
thinking: 论文提出了一个针对生物医学预印本的个性化文献发现系统，其核心检索模型采用了GPT-4o生成的自然语言查询和混合训练目标，技术方法具有前沿性。系统设计考虑了新颖性、多样性排序和结果解释，对生物医学领域的科研人员有直接的应用价值。然而，作为一篇技术报告，其在用户评估、实验设计严谨性方面的细节披露有限，影响了方法严谨性的评分。
one_sentence_summary: 该系统为生物医学预印本提供了一个高效、可控的个性化检索与推荐工具，显著提升了相关文献的发现效率。

title: TAGR: Task-Adaptive Geo-Semantic Retrieval across Heterogeneous Urban Delivery Tasks
abstract:
arXiv:2610.28638v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: As urban residents demand higher-quality instant delivery services, demand forecasting, estimated time of arrival prediction, and next-stop prediction have become critical tasks in urban delivery systems. However, the three tasks rely on historical evidence with substantially different structures and granularities. Meanwhile, their prediction targets differ in output form, making it difficult to integrate retrieved evidence through a single fusion mechanism without causing mismatch or negative transfer. These issues can increase prediction errors and subsequently lead to imbalanced resource allocation, where some regions experience unmet demand. In contrast, others suffer from underutilization, ultimately degrading overall efficiency and service quality. To address these challenges, we propose TAGR, a Task-Adaptive Geo-Semantic Retrieval framework across heterogeneous urban delivery tasks. TAGR constructs an LLM-based geo-semantic shared prior and task-specific retrieval banks to share regional knowledge while preserving heterogeneous task-specific evidence. The LLM-derived regional representations encode geographic context and semantic relations among regions, providing transferable knowledge for all three tasks without requiring online LLM inference. It further introduces a task-adaptive retrieval augmentation module to accommodate heterogeneous output structures, thereby mitigating information mismatch and negative transfer caused by a uniform retrieval-fusion strategy. Experiments on three city datasets demonstrate that TAGR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across multiple tasks.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种任务自适应的地理语义检索框架，整合了大型语言模型来构建可迁移的区域知识先验，技术方法具有前沿性。研究针对城市即时配送中的多个预测任务，实验基于三个城市数据集，方法严谨且结果具有直接的应用潜力，能优化配送资源分配。但作为预印本论文，其具体落地到图书馆或信息机构的路径尚不明确，实践价值更多体现在广义的信息服务优化层面。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一个自适应框架，利用大语言模型提取区域知识，以同时提升城市配送中多个关键任务的预测性能。

title: Can AI Chat Replace Traditional Search? Evidence from a RAG-based Live Events Experiment
abstract:
arXiv:2610.28639v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Conversational AI tools are being increasingly integrated into online search and browsing interfaces. To understand how such tools affect user behavior and search outcomes, we run a pre-registered, incentivized online experiment in which participants search a catalog of several thousand events scraped from a major live-events platform. We compare three interfaces: a classic, attribute-based filter interface (Filter), a GenAI chat interface (Chat), and a combined interface offering both (Hybrid). In both AI conditions, AI output is restricted via retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Our main result is that, relative to the other two conditions, the Chat condition performs the worst. The effect is robust across AI models (gpt-4.1-mini, gpt-5.2 and gpt-5.4) and is driven mainly by users who perform open-ended exploration (as opposed to users searching for a specific artist, venue or sports team). Furthermore, there are no significant differences on any metrics between Filter and Hybrid. We also document two mechanisms. First, Chat creates an echo chamber: without a visible menu, users construct queries based on what they think is contained in the catalog. As a result, they frequently search for event types that are not available in the catalog, and they search too narrowly. Second, Chat leads to prompting fatigue: it shifts effort towards prompting, and away from inspecting and evaluating the output. As a result, users often pick one of the first displayed suggestions rather than examining the list more carefully. Taken together, our results suggest that AI is best used as a complementary tool to existing filter-based search rather than as a replacement.
thinking: 该论文采用预注册实验设计，对比了基于RAG的AI聊天搜索与传统过滤搜索的用户行为差异，方法严谨且样本规模合理。研究揭示了AI聊天搜索在开放探索场景下的局限性，如回音室效应和提示疲劳，为信息检索系统设计提供了实证依据。但实验场景局限于特定事件目录，结论在更广泛检索任务中的普适性有待验证。
one_sentence_summary: 实验发现，在开放探索任务中，纯AI聊天搜索效果最差，其最佳应用方式是作为传统过滤搜索的补充工具。

title: Transaction Foundation Models for Retrieval-Augmented Generation over Financial Transaction Data: A Comparative Evaluation with Text Embeddings
abstract:
arXiv:2610.28641v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Domain-specific tabular and transaction foundation models are increasingly proposed as drop-in representation learners for financial applications, but their value relative to off-the-shelf text embedding models for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over structured data remains underexamined. We construct a deterministic, template-generated question-answering benchmark of 1,026 questions with retrieval-level gold-document annotations over IBM's synthetic Anti-Money-Laundering (AML) transaction dataset, and compare NVIDIA's 29M-parameter Transaction Foundation Model (TFM) against five general-purpose and financial-domain text embedding models under a size- and data-matched retrieval setup, as well as against a hand-aggregated summary-text baseline. TFM substantially outperforms every size-matched generic embedder on both retrieval (Recall@5: 0.81 vs. 0.25-0.39) and end-to-end answer accuracy (66.7% vs. 27.5%). However, a simple pipeline that embeds a human-engineered aggregated summary with a generic sentence encoder matches or exceeds TFM overall, and dominates it on several low-cardinality entity categories (bank, currency, payment format). This suggests that the benefit of a transaction-native foundation model over generic text embeddings is category-dependent rather than uniform, and that careful feature aggregation can substitute for domain-specific pretraining in several practically relevant regimes. We release the benchmark generation and evaluation code.
thinking: 该论文针对金融交易数据，系统比较了专用交易基础模型与通用文本嵌入模型在检索增强生成任务中的表现，方法设计严谨，构建了包含1026个问题的确定性基准。然而，其业务落地价值受限于高度特定的反洗钱场景和合成数据集，且技术核心（基础模型与文本嵌入）虽属主流但非最前沿突破。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，针对金融交易数据的专用模型在检索任务上优于通用文本嵌入模型，但经过人工特征聚合的简单文本基线也能达到相近甚至更好的效果。

title: Controllable Generative Recommendation via Guided Token Refinement
abstract:
arXiv:2610.28642v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Generative recommendation over discrete Semantic IDs has become a powerful paradigm for item retrieval. Real-world systems, however, frequently require real-time controllability to balance accuracy against objectives such as diversity. Existing autoregressive methods generate tokens strictly from left to right. This fixed direction locks in early decisions, preventing holistic planning and making control difficult. Consequently, direct interventions often break the semantic structure, producing non-existent items. To address this, we propose ReGen, a framework that shifts from sequential decoding to parallel iterative refinement. ReGen reformulates generation as a mask-filling task, predicting all tokens simultaneously rather than one by one. This global view allows us to apply control signals directly to tokens with high-level semantics without retraining the model. To ensure that decoded candidates map to real items, we introduce a topology-constrained tree that iteratively corrects low-confidence predictions while strictly enforcing valid codebook paths during beam-based inference. Experiments show that ReGen provides a favorable accuracy-diversity trade-off under moderate guidance while maintaining high validity of generated Semantic IDs. The source code is available at: https://github.com/zhang-haichao/ReGen.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于并行迭代优化的可控生成推荐框架，将传统的自左向右序列生成重构为全局掩码填充任务，并在解码过程中引入拓扑约束树以确保生成语义ID的有效性。该方法在信息检索领域具有技术前沿性，通过并行化提升了控制灵活性，但作为arXiv预印本，其方法严谨性尚未经过同行评议的全面检验，且实际业务落地场景和具体系统集成方案有待进一步明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种新的并行解码推荐框架，通过全局掩码填充和路径约束，实现了对推荐结果准确性与多样性的实时可控平衡。

title: Constrained Tagging for Span Labeling
abstract:
arXiv:2610.28922v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Generative LLMs can label spans without task-specific training, but their output is not tied to positions in the input: a returned span may be absent from the input or occur several times. We present constrained tagging, a training-free method in which the model reproduces the input and wraps each span in labeled inline markup. A logits processor using a byte-level token trie and a finite-state machine admits only tokens that continue the input verbatim or form a valid tag, so the output reproduces the input exactly with labels from the given set, and spans may begin or end at any character boundary, even inside a token. Two-phase decoding lets reasoning models reason before the constraint engages. On six datasets and six open-weight models, the guarantee holds in all but 0.022% of 255,312 constrained generations, each failure a reasoning model exhausting its token budget or never closing its reasoning, and the constraint adds no measurable cost. Unlike context-based prompting, which loses 8.5% of its spans, constrained tagging locates every span it proposes on every dataset; it is as accurate on two datasets, and on the other four its errors lie in which spans the model chooses, not where they are.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种无需训练、基于约束解码的文本跨度标注方法，在技术方法上具有创新性，能有效解决生成式大语言模型在文本标注任务中的位置不准问题，方法严谨性通过多数据集和模型验证得到支撑。但作为一项技术方法研究，其直接面向图书馆或信息机构的业务落地场景尚不明确，实践应用价值有待具体场景转化。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种约束解码方法，能强制大语言模型在生成文本时精确标注出原文中的特定片段，解决了模型输出位置不准的问题。

title: Progressive Learning from Content to Relevance to Personalization for CTR Prediction
abstract:
arXiv:2610.29138v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Multimodal click-through rate (CTR) prediction is central to search systems, where ranking depends on item content, query relevance, and user preference. Existing approaches incorporate content through dense embeddings or coarse discrete IDs, yet effectively integrating fine-grained heterogeneous content with ID-based predictors remains challenging. We propose FineSID, a progressive learning framework that unifies content tokenization, query--item semantic pretraining, and personalized post-training via a shared fine-grained discrete representation. Each stage optimizes an explicit objective while preserving token-level access to content. First, a pretrained multi-scale visual tokenizer and text tokenizers convert heterogeneous content into fine-grained Semantic IDs (SIDs), explicitly aligning them with the ID features. Second, full-parameter semantic pretraining under query--item relevance supervision establishes a robust matching prior, jointly optimizing the interactions of multimodal SIDs and conventional fields within a shared predictor. Third, this initialized predictor is directly fine-tuned with user click supervision to capture implicit personalized preferences. Extensive offline and online evaluations demonstrate substantial gains in both standard CTR prediction and core business metrics. Furthermore, FineSID improves within-product creative discrimination, demonstrating its semantic generalization beyond conventional ID memorization.
thinking: 论文提出了一个渐进式学习框架FineSID，通过将细粒度内容转化为语义ID并与传统ID特征统一建模，在CTR预测任务上取得了显著效果，技术方案新颖且实验验证充分。其研究场景主要面向通用搜索引擎或推荐系统，虽未直接针对图情领域的特定业务，但其在内容理解与个性化排序上的方法对图书馆的智能检索与推荐系统有借鉴价值。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种将内容转化为细粒度语义ID并与用户行为统一建模的框架，显著提升了点击率预测的准确性和业务指标。

title: Reasoning-Search-Augmented LLMs: An Operational Taxonomy, Benchmark Analysis and Controlled Evidence Synthesis
abstract:
arXiv:2610.29189v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive emergent reasoning capabilities, yet they remain constrained by fixed model parameters and finite context windows. Even when augmented with static retrieval, they can produce statements that are unsupported by, or even contradictory to, retrieved evidence. This leads to hallucinations, difficulty incorporating up-to-date information, and failures to correctly interpret or reconcile sources. Recent work addresses these limitations by tightly coupling step-by-step reasoning with interactive search, treating retrieval as an action within an iterative agentic loop rather than a one-shot preprocessing step. This study reviews frameworks that implement such reasoning-search loops by interleaving planning, querying, retrieval, integration, verification, and stopping. We analyze these systems through four architectural axes: retrieval coupling, controller design, knowledge source, and grounding strictness. We separately treat the learning signal as a cross-cutting dimension because prompting, supervision, preference optimization, and reinforcement learning can instantiate the same architecture while producing materially different search, stopping, and grounding behavior. We further distinguish benchmark difficulty from RSA-loop demand and synthesize controlled within-study ablations and quality-cost deltas, avoiding invalid pooling across heterogeneous model backbones, retrievers, corpora, and evaluation protocols. Our goal is to clarify the landscape of reasoning-search-augmented LLMs and outline a unified perspective on the design choices shaping future research.
thinking: 该论文系统梳理了推理-搜索增强大语言模型的技术框架，提出了四维架构分析体系，并通过控制变量实验进行性能对比，方法严谨且覆盖前沿技术。然而，作为一篇综述与基准分析，其直接面向图书馆等机构的业务落地路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 这篇论文系统梳理了将大语言模型与交互式搜索循环深度结合的前沿技术框架，并提出了一个统一的分析视角。

title: Preference Is Not Permission: Personalizing the Auto-Purchase Line in Agentic Commerce
abstract:
arXiv:2610.29216v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Personalized shopping benchmarks ask which item fits the user; we ask how far an agent may commit on that item, and pose learning the individual's auto-purchase line as a task. The boundary is evidence-conditioned and three-valued: whether committing is appropriate depends on the sufficiency of product information (warrant), reversibility, price against the user's norm, and urgency, not only on fit; and the natural output is don't buy, confirm first, or buy automatically. Across sixteen instruction-tuned models, autonomous commitment is misaligned with a human authorization reference in which fifteen annotators, role-playing the delegating principal from a given profile, choose the furthest action they would allow without confirmation: models commit even when fit is low and when their own evidence flag reports the warrant missing. This is overreach. The line is individual: these raters disagree, yet the disagreement is structured and partly predictable from a person's own other labels. A shallow learner on a few dozen of a person's own labels predicts their held-out auto-purchase line at a median of 0.79 by 30-40 labels, outperforming every evaluated prompt$\times$model configuration, including a per-annotator oracle over 80 configurations; the learned boundary does not transfer across domains. We release the counterfactual benchmark, human authorization reference, and annotation protocol after acceptance.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种新颖的评估任务——学习用户的“自动购买线”，并系统性地评估了多个大语言模型在此任务上的表现与人类授权的偏差。其方法严谨，设计了包含人类标注参考的基准，并进行了可预测性分析。然而，其研究场景（代理商务）在图情领域的直接落地场景尚不明确，更多属于通用人工智能应用研究。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，当前大语言模型在模拟购物决策中倾向于过度承诺，而通过少量个人数据训练的分类器能比模型提示更准确地预测个人的自动购买界限。

title: Learning Marginal Viewpoint Utility for Budgeted Evidence Selection in RAG
abstract:
arXiv:2610.29234v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation over multi-viewpoint queries must preserve distinct answers and positions from the retrieved evidence while operating under a fixed context budget. We introduce LMVU, a lightweight ranker that learns to prioritize candidates by the marginal viewpoint coverage they add to the current selection. Training uses viewpoint annotations from each benchmark's development split to compare candidates within the same selection state. At inference, LMVU repeatedly scores budget-feasible candidates as the context grows, without accessing these annotations. We evaluate two forms of recovered viewpoint coverage: RVC$_1$ assigns each viewpoint full credit for at least one supporting source unit, while RVC$_2$ assigns half credit for one and full credit for two or more distinct source units. Exact oracles measure achievable coverage under the same evidence pool and budget. Across four viewpoint-annotated benchmarks at a 1,024-token budget, LMVU achieves gains of up to 0.047 and 0.052 points in RVC$_1$ and RVC$_2$, respectively, over the strongest non-oracle baseline for each benchmark and metric, and reaches the exact viewpoint-breadth ceiling on two benchmarks.
thinking: 论文提出了一种针对多视角查询的RAG证据选择方法，通过轻量级排序器学习边际视角覆盖度来优化预算内的证据选择，技术思路新颖且实验设计较为严谨。然而，该方法高度依赖特定基准测试的视角标注数据进行训练，其在实际图书馆或信息检索系统中的通用性和部署成本尚不明确，影响了其业务落地价值的评估。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种学习边际视角效用的方法，用于在固定上下文预算下，为多视角检索增强生成任务选择能最大化覆盖不同观点的证据。

title: Generative Recommenders Forget the Long Tail: Restoring Memorization in Retrieval and Ranking
abstract:
arXiv:2610.29298v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Generative recommenders replace the retrieve-then-rank cascade with a single model: beam search over semantic item identifiers performs retrieval, and the same likelihood performs ranking. We show that this shared score makes them forget long-tail items twice. In retrieval, beam search keeps identifier prefixes by the probability mass of their subtrees, so tail items are pruned early, and a wider beam admits few more of them. In ranking, the likelihood places tail items below head items even when they are admitted, so expanding retrieval alone brings little or no gain. Both failures reflect missing item-level memorization (i.e., direct recall of which items co-occur), which collaborative filtering provides and shared-prefix generation lacks. To this end, we propose CAPE (Co-occurrence-Aware Pool Expansion), a training-free plug-in that restores memorization at both stages: (i) a memorization channel retrieves co-occurrence-supported tail items outside the beam and scores them with the frozen generator, and (ii) memorization-calibrated ranking fuses the generator likelihood with co-occurrence evidence while keeping the generator's first item. Experiments with two generative backbones on product and music domains show that CAPE significantly improves long-tail accuracy over the backbones and over re-ranking baselines that share its candidates, preserves or improves overall accuracy, and adds a small fraction of the latency.
thinking: 该论文针对生成式推荐系统在长尾项目推荐上的双重遗忘问题，提出了一个无需重新训练、可插拔的解决方案CAPE，方法设计清晰且实验验证充分。其创新性在于明确指出了生成范式在记忆化能力上的固有缺陷，并通过引入协同过滤的共现证据来弥补，技术思路具有前沿性。然而，作为一篇预印本论文，其方法尚未在实际的图书馆或信息服务平台中得到部署验证，其业务落地价值有待观察。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究发现生成式推荐系统会双重遗忘长尾项目，并提出了一种通过融合共现证据来恢复记忆化能力的改进方法。

title: Directional Posterior Feedback Fusion for Query Reformulation in Dense Retrieval
abstract:
arXiv:2610.29464v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Dense retrieval has become a fundamental paradigm for modern information retrieval, supporting efficient semantic search across a wide range of applications. Its effectiveness, however, relies critically on query embeddings that adequately capture users' information needs, which can be difficult for short, ambiguous, or underspecified queries. Feedback-based query reformulation approaches like pseudo-relevance feedback (PRF) alleviate this by incorporating additional evidence from retrieved or generated content. However, existing embedding-space approaches commonly aggregate or interpolate feedback vectors, implicitly treating them as complete target representations. Such pointwise fusion can unnecessarily suppress query corrections along directions not expressed by individual feedback items, even when these directions are supported by complementary evidence. To address this limitation, we propose Directional Posterior Feedback Fusion (DIFF), a query reformulation framework that models feedback as directional evidence rather than target points. DIFF represents feedback as confidence-weighted directional evidence in the tangent space of the original query and jointly infers a controlled query update through prior-regularized posterior fusion, without retraining the underlying dense retriever. Experiments across multiple dense retrievers and different feedback sources show that DIFF achieves the best overall retrieval performance, demonstrating the effectiveness of explicitly modeling how feedback should constrain query updates.
thinking: 论文提出了一种新颖的查询重构框架DIFF，将反馈信息建模为方向性证据而非点向量，在方法上具有创新性，属于检索领域的前沿探索。其方法设计严谨，在多个检索器和反馈源上进行了实验验证，但作为预印本，其实际在图书馆或信息机构检索系统中的落地应用价值尚需进一步检验。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种将用户反馈视为方向性证据的新型查询重构方法，能有效提升密集检索系统的性能。

title: Beyond the Vote: When Do LLMs Add Value to Retrieval-Based Tabular Classification?
abstract:
arXiv:2610.29520v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Retrieval-based in-context learning (ICL) enables large language models (LLMs) to predict tabular labels from similar examples, but it remains unclear whether LLM inference improves on direct voting over those same examples. We address this question by comparing four general-purpose LLMs with distance-weighted nearest-neighbor voting (Distance-KNN) using identical retrieved neighbors across 19 tabular classification datasets. With the number of demonstrations fixed, enlarging the retrieval candidate pool improves accuracy for all predictors, yet Distance-KNN achieves the highest mean accuracy at every pool size. More detailed analyses reveal that LLM gains are concentrated where retrieved neighbors exhibit low label consensus and vary across models. These gains further depend on the average feature-space distance to the test query: under low label consensus, some LLMs outperform Distance-KNN in close and intermediate neighborhoods, but all fall behind on average in the most distant group. Complementary experiments on the number of demonstrations, prompt formulation, retrieval representation, and label-balanced demonstration selection largely preserve the overall findings. These results characterize when LLM inference adds predictive value beyond distance-weighted voting in retrieval-based tabular ICL.
thinking: 该论文通过系统实验比较了LLM与距离加权KNN在表格分类任务中的性能，揭示了LLM在检索邻居标签共识度低时可能带来增益，但整体上传统方法仍占优。研究设计严谨，覆盖了多个数据集和变量，但结论对当前LLM热潮提供了重要的冷静视角，其业务落地价值受限于特定条件。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，在基于检索的表格分类任务中，大语言模型仅在检索结果标签不一致的特定情况下优于传统距离加权投票方法。

title: X-Embedding: Two-Stage Training for Multilingual Patent Prior-Art Retrieval
abstract:
arXiv:2610.29521v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Multilingual patent prior-art retrieval requires identifying X-category references that are particularly relevant to the novelty or inventive step of a claimed invention, beyond topical similarity across languages and document views. We present X-Embedding, a two-stage framework that first learns patent-domain representations and then optimizes X-category retrieval relevance. The first stage aligns complementary sections within patents and corresponding sections across different-language patent-family members, learning from both patent structure and multilingual expressions. The second stage learns X-category relevance using examination-report X citations as positives and negatives drawn from retrieval candidates and A-category citations. Matryoshka representation learning (MRL) enables 64- and 1024-dimensional embeddings within one model. Evaluation on a common Chinese, English, and Japanese collection with four query views yields 89.09% overall macro Hit@100 at 64 dimensions, exceeding Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B and RoBERTa by 21.25 and 3.68 percentage points, respectively. Under the same second-stage training and evaluation conditions, two-stage training outperforms direct supervised fine-tuning by 3.19 points, with gains of 5.34 and 4.72 points for English and Japanese and higher scores in nine of twelve language-view combinations. Overall macro Hit@10 and Hit@20 also improve by 3.71 and 3.79 points, respectively. These results support sequential patent-domain and task adaptation for improving aggregate X-category retrieval on this multilingual collection.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种针对多语言专利引文检索的两阶段训练框架，结合了专利结构对齐和特定检索任务优化，方法设计具有创新性。研究在中文、英文和日文专利数据集上进行了评估，并与基准模型进行了对比，验证了其有效性，方法较为严谨。其成果可直接应用于专利审查和情报分析等实际场景，具有较高的应用价值。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种两阶段训练框架，有效提升了跨语言专利引文检索的准确性。

title: pplx-embed-v2-late Technical Report
abstract:
arXiv:2610.29523v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: In this report, we introduce pplx-embed-v2-late, a pair of 0.6B and 9B multilingual and multimodal late-interaction models. Both models achieve state-of-the-art results within their respective size classes across a range of text, image, and visual document retrieval benchmarks. On visual document retrieval tasks, pplx-embed-v2-late-0.6b is competitive with models several times larger than itself. The models are trained via representation distillation from an 18B teacher. Consequently, they share an embedding space that supports asymmetric deployment: documents can be indexed with the 9B model and queried with the low-latency 0.6B model. Both models are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/perplexity-ai/pplx-embed-v2.
thinking: 该技术报告介绍了Perplexity AI开发的多语言多模态检索模型，在文本、图像和视觉文档检索任务上达到了同类尺寸模型中的最优性能，并采用了表示蒸馏和不对称部署等前沿技术。然而，作为一份聚焦模型发布的技术报告，其内容偏重技术介绍与性能展示，未涉及具体的图书馆或信息业务场景，也缺乏传统学术论文的研究方法论述。
one_sentence_summary: 该报告发布了一对性能优异、支持不对称部署的多语言多模态检索模型，可用于高效处理文本、图像和文档的检索任务。

title: ERCLIP: Small-Data Adaptation of CLIP for Free-Length Image-Text Retrieval
abstract:
arXiv:2610.29939v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: CLIP's 77-token text encoder truncates detailed image descriptions. We present ERCLIP, a small-data adaptation of CLIP for long-caption image--text retrieval. During training, a long caption is split into sentences that the CLIP text encoder encodes independently; the sentence embeddings are fused by mean pooling or a gated residual Transformer scorer and receive their own contrastive loss. At inference ERCLIP is an unmodified CLIP dual encoder: test captions are still read through the 77-token window, and only training sees the full caption. We find that this fine-tuning erodes CLIP's zero-shot classification, most when the fusion output is not a combination of CLIP embeddings, and add a frozen-CLIP preservation loss on the image and short-caption embeddings. With 20k pairs and one epoch, ERCLIP improves long-caption R@1 over CLIP by 6.5--11.2 points, closing 62--77% of the gap to LongCLIP with 2% of its long captions. Preservation recovers 1.5--2.1 ImageNet zero-shot points (30--42% of the loss) and adds up to 2.4 points of COCO image-to-text R@1, at no inference cost.
thinking: 论文针对CLIP模型在长文本图像检索中的局限性，提出了ERCLIP这一轻量级微调方法，通过句子级编码融合和对比学习损失优化，显著提升了长文本检索性能，方法设计巧妙且实验验证充分。其不足在于研究场景相对聚焦于技术模型优化，与图书馆、信息机构的具体业务场景结合不够直接，实践应用路径尚需明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种只需少量数据微调CLIP模型的方法，有效提升了其对长文本描述的图像检索能力。

title: Think Harder Where It Matters: Item-Level Adaptive Recursion for Sequential Recommendation
abstract:
arXiv:2610.30128v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Existing sequential recommenders usually allocate a fixed computational budget to every item in a user's interaction history, regardless of the item's contribution to the final prediction. We challenge this de facto design with two diagnostic findings. (1) Non-uniform computational need: items within the same sequence vary drastically in how much computation they require. Most converge after shallow processing while a critical minority only stabilizes at full depth. (2) Suboptimality of fixed allocation: given oracle access to the target item, a non-uniform depth assignment consistently outranks the fixed one, indicating that existing uniform computation both wastes capacity on already-converged items and sacrifices overall recommendation quality. These observations motivate a shift from fixed-depth computation to item-level adaptive reasoning. To this end, we propose LoopRec. LoopRec recursively applies a single weight-shared block and introduces a lightweight gate at each recursion boundary that makes a binary exit-or-continue decision for every item independently. Items whose representations have sufficiently matured exit early, while those requiring deeper reasoning continue to subsequent recursions. This design converts the fixed global depth into a learned, per-item property without auxiliary depth labels, and is readily adaptable to diverse backbone architectures. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks with four backbone families demonstrate that LoopRec consistently outperforms matched fixed-depth counterparts. Further analysis reveals that LoopRec's learned allocation exhibits interpretable patterns aligned with our post-hoc oracle analysis: lower-frequency items and more recent interactions naturally receive deeper computation. Our code is available at https://github.com/Elpmis117/LoopRec.
thinking: 该论文针对序列推荐中固定计算预算的局限性，提出了基于项目级自适应递归的LoopRec方法，在技术方法上具有创新性，并通过多组实验验证了其有效性。但作为预印本论文，其方法严谨性尚未经过同行评议，且实际业务落地价值需结合具体推荐场景进一步评估。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种让推荐系统为序列中不同项目自适应分配计算深度的新方法，在提升推荐效果的同时提高了计算效率。

title: Scriptorium: System Design and Implementation of a Multi-Human, Multi-AI Collaborative Digital Library Search Platform
abstract:
arXiv:2610.28929v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: This technical report documents the design and implementation of Scriptorium, a digital library search interface designed to support multi-human, multi-AI collaboration: full cross-user transparency of search activity combined with a Manager--Worker architecture of seven role-specialized generative AI agents. A companion short demonstration paper describes Scriptorium's interaction design; because a demonstration format is constrained to a few pages, it necessarily omits most implementation detail. This report documents Scriptorium's complete system architecture, data model, collaborative-interaction design rationale, and AI orchestration mechanism, including verbatim agent prompts, the deterministic guardrails that constrain them, the language model and retrieval configuration, and the steps needed to run the system, so that the design can be inspected, critiqued, reproduced, and reused by other researchers. We also discuss the system's current limitations and the user study we are planning to evaluate its central hypothesis: that combining collaborative transparency with scoped multi-agent AI assistance increases serendipitous cross-pollination between collaborators' research threads.
thinking: 该论文提出了一个结合多用户协作透明度和多智能体AI架构的数字图书馆检索平台，在系统设计和AI代理协同方面具有前沿性。然而，作为一份技术报告，其核心假设尚未通过用户研究验证，方法严谨性存在不足，且系统架构的复杂性可能影响其在现有图书馆环境中的直接落地。
one_sentence_summary: 该论文设计并实现了一个支持多用户与多AI智能体协同工作的数字图书馆检索平台原型系统。

title: Our Own Jev: Typed Decisions in One Forward Pass, from an In-House Judge to Open LoRA Models
abstract:
arXiv:2610.29052v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: A typed decision maps evidence, a question and a fixed set of options to a probability for every option, computed in one forward pass, by reading a language model's logits or a small head over its hidden states, instead of generating and parsing text. The commercial system Jev popularised this System~1 interface, and open reproductions have followed. We report two uses of the pattern. \emph{Part I} describes an in-house System~1 judge that triages about 148K agentic coding session records for a training corpus. It replaces a frontier LLM judge that cost on the order of \$1,000 per pass and whose stored labels matched a fresh two-judge consensus on only 26.9\% of the sessions where the two judges agreed; a self-hosted frozen backbone with a rank-16 LoRA adapter and a pointer head answers three typed questions in one forward pass, judges 1,000 sessions in about three minutes of one GPU, about \$0.06 at a reference rate and roughly 1\% of the frontier judge's cost, and keeps every session inside the organisation. \emph{Part II} asks whether a readout that adds no parameters can be competitive and whether training one helps. Applying the public Eikos recipe and corpus of about 25K decisions to three further backbones (1B, 2B and 35B), we read the frozen output layer of a LoRA-adapted decoder. On the 111 public hard items of JevBench our single-seed 35B, developed with those items in view, scores 79.3\%, not significantly different from the commercial reference (73.0\%, unadjusted $p=0.12$) and ahead of five open systems after Holm--Bonferroni correction; our 2B is ahead of all four kev checkpoints on the leaderboard. A single-seed ablation finds no detectable benefit from training the 26 letter rows of the output layer, and a retrain on a later corpus release moves the 2B's hard-tier accuracy by 11.7 points, which shows how little small evaluations resolve.
thinking: 论文提出了一种基于大语言模型的单前向传播类型化决策方法，显著降低了评估成本并提高了效率，具有明确的技术创新性和实践价值。然而，论文在方法严谨性方面存在不足，例如样本量（148K和25K）虽有一定规模，但评估基准（JevBench的111个硬项目）过小，且缺乏对不同数据集和任务的广泛验证，影响了结论的普适性。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种高效低成本的类型化决策方法，利用LoRA适配器在单次前向传播中完成评估，大幅节省了计算开销。

title: Extending FAIR Principles with Observability for Trustworthy Federated Learning
abstract:
arXiv:2610.29252v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Federated learning (FL) keeps data at its source, but locality alone does not make a federation trustworthy. Without sufficient observability, an aggregator cannot determine whether the client service was healthy, the local data pipeline was trustworthy, or contractual constraints were properly monitored during training. We take the position that trustworthy FL needs an evidence plane in addition to its model-update process. Each participant continuously summarizes local infrastructure, data into minimal, signed trust evidence associated with each FL round, while raw data, logs remain local. A local TinyLLM may assist in interpreting observability signals, deriving contextual evidence, and providing natural-language explanations to operators. We instantiate this vision through FAIR-O, an observability extension of FAIR principle. Rather than benchmarking FL accuracy, a three-level trust model has been proposed and a two-participant Python prototype demonstrates evidence generation and trust assessment. We further discuss future integration of FAIR-O Trust Evidence into participant selection, evidence weighting, and federated aggregation.
thinking: 论文将FAIR原则与可观测性结合，提出了FAIR-O框架以增强联邦学习的可信度，在技术前沿性和方法创新上表现突出；但研究目前仅通过双参与者的Python原型进行验证，方法严谨性和实践应用价值尚需更大规模的实证研究来支撑。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出为联邦学习增加一个“证据平面”，通过扩展FAIR原则来提升其训练过程的可信度。

title: SOAR: Social and Opinion-Aware Recommendations
abstract:
arXiv:2610.29556v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: One of the enduring challenges in online platforms is recommendation. Both communities and advertisers face difficulties in analyzing complex user behavior, identifying habits and evolving preferences, and providing timely recommendations that are relevant to user interests. In particular, point of interest recommendation poses the additional challenge of identifying the factors that influence user behavior, capturing user tendencies, and generating accurate, personalized recommendations for each individual. In this work, we propose SOAR, a Social and Opinion Aware Recommendation model that incorporates both the user's friendship network and textual reviews to assess whether a location is suitable for a specific user, with a particular emphasis on the sentiment of shared reviews. Experimental results in real-world datasets demonstrate that incorporating reviews into the recommendation process improves the precision of the recommendation.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种融合社交网络和文本评论情感分析的推荐模型，在技术方法上结合了图神经网络和自然语言处理，具有较好的前沿性。实验基于真实数据集验证了模型有效性，但未详细说明数据规模、对比基线及可复现性细节，方法严谨性有待加强。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究通过融合用户社交关系和评论情感分析，提升了兴趣点推荐的准确性。

title: Real PMIDs, Wrong Papers: Harness Design for Biomedical Claim-Verification Agents
abstract:
arXiv:2610.29812v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Literature-searching language agents are becoming a standard component of scientific assistants for the life sciences, yet there is little controlled evidence on which parts of their harness matter. We run a controlled ablation on biomedical claim verification (SciFact) with the live PubMed API as the only tool. Holding the backbone and output format fixed, we compare four harnesses: closed-book answering, single-shot retrieval using the claim as the query, a ReAct-style agent that writes its own PubMed queries, and an oracle given the gold abstracts, each with two efficient frontier backbones. Naive single-shot retrieval finds the gold paper for only 6% of claims and turns overconfident errors into abstentions without improving accuracy. Letting the model formulate its own queries triples gold recall and yields the best verdicts (62% accuracy vs. 49-59% for the other realistic harnesses), although these differences are not significant at our sample size and agents use fewer than half of their search budget. With gold abstracts, the same models reach 79-86% accuracy, a significant 17-24 point gap showing that retrieval, not reasoning, is the main bottleneck. Finally, a citation audit shows that closed-book models cite PubMed IDs that almost always exist (327/335) but are almost never relevant: a cross-family LLM judge rates only 3 of 327 existing citations as relevant to the claim, versus 67% for citations produced by the search agent. Existence checks are therefore insufficient safeguards for scientific agents. We release code, prompts, and all cached tool calls at https://github.com/saqlain2204/real-pmids-wrong-papers.
thinking: 该论文采用控制变量法系统评估了生物医学文献检索智能体的不同设计对事实核查性能的影响，方法严谨且实验设计清晰。研究揭示了当前检索系统在准确性上的主要瓶颈，并指出仅依赖PMID存在性检查的不足，对科学智能体的安全设计具有直接警示意义。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，让大语言模型自主构建检索查询能显著提升生物医学事实核查的准确性，而检索质量是当前系统性能的主要瓶颈。

title: What the Author Wrote, What the Agent Reads: Silent Cue Loss in Enterprise Document Ingestion
abstract:
arXiv:2610.30026v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Enterprise agents act on documents. Before an agent can follow a policy, answer a compliance question or file a ticket, some ingestion layer must turn a Word file or PDF into tokens - and that layer is where an agent deployed in the wild silently loses information. We show that one layer is lost by every mainstream converter - the meaning an author encodes in how text looks - and that the loss makes agents confidently wrong rather than visibly incomplete. We build a task from 76 real policy documents: recover the requirements the author singled out, scored against the file's own OOXML properties by a deterministic matcher with no LLM judge. Formatting-blind ingestion collapses from micro F1 0.690 to 0.150 (docling) and 0.075 (plain text), a gap that replicates across six answering models from two vendors - five Claude models spanning the Opus, Sonnet and Haiku tiers, and OpenAI's GPT-5.6. An agent that cannot see the cue guesses, and docling's false-positive rate on requirements the author did not flag is four times ours. A span-level leave-one-out localises the loss to two cues - highlight (+0.302) and colour (+0.262), both Holm-adjusted p < 1e-4 - while bold, italic, monospace and strikethrough each sit within +/-0.003 of zero. The same asymmetry appears in PDF. Colour is also the cue no mainstream converter preserves and no parsing benchmark scores, and it is common: 32.8% of 6,460 documents carry a deliberate colour or highlight, 10.3% on an obligation. A pre-registered test shows that typing a cue for the agent adds +0.085 beyond merely preserving it (Holm-adjusted p = 0.049). We validate the labels against rendered page images through an independent modality (kappa = 0.72) and bound what wording alone can achieve (AUC 0.664). For agent builders the practical finding is that ingestion, not reasoning, is where this reliability is won or lost, and that the fix is cheap and measurable.
thinking: 该论文聚焦企业文档处理中格式信息丢失导致智能代理错误的问题，研究问题具有明确的实践指向性。其优势在于方法严谨，设计了基于真实政策文档的任务，并进行了多模型、多格式的对照实验与统计检验，验证了格式线索（尤其是高亮和颜色）的关键作用。不足之处在于，虽然揭示了现有通用转换工具的普遍缺陷，但提出的解决方案（显式标注线索）较为初步，技术前沿性主要体现在对LLM代理应用瓶颈的深刻剖析，而非提出颠覆性的新技术。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，企业文档格式信息（如高亮和颜色）在转换为文本时丢失，会导致基于大语言模型的智能代理产生自信的错误，而保留这些视觉线索能显著提升其可靠性。

title: DualView: Adaptive Local-Global Fusion for Multi-Hop Document Reranking
abstract:
arXiv:2605.18767v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Multi-hop question answering requires aggregating information from multiple documents, a critical capability for knowledge-intensive applications. A fundamental challenge lies in efficiently identifying the minimal relevant document set from retrieved candidates while maintaining high recall.
  We present an efficient dual-view cascaded reranking framework for multi-hop document reranking. Operating as a lightweight post-retrieval stage over E5-base-v2 candidates, our architecture comprises: (1) a Local Scorer employing stacked cross-attention for fine-grained query-document relevance; and (2) a Global Scorer modeling inter-document dependencies via Transformer-based context aggregation. These views are dynamically fused through an Adaptive Gate conditioned on query semantics.
  Under the fixed candidate set reranking setting with offline cached embeddings, our model achieves competitive results, particularly outstanding on MuSiQue with 99.4% Top-4 Recall and 97.8% Full Hit accuracy at 4.0 ms latency (249 QPS). It substantially outperforms 600M-parameter cross-encoders (BGE-Large: 92.0% Recall, Jina-v3: 90.1% Recall) while maintaining 5 to 6 times lower latency. Ablation studies validate that both Local and Global views contribute substantially to multi-hop performance.
thinking: 论文提出了一种用于多跳文档重排的双视图级联框架，结合了局部细粒度相关性和全局文档间依赖建模，在保持低延迟的同时取得了优于大参数模型的召回性能。其方法在特定数据集上验证有效，但作为预印本尚未经过同行评议，且实验设定（固定候选集、离线缓存）可能限制了其在动态检索场景中的普适性。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种融合局部与全局信息的轻量级文档重排模型，在保证高召回率的同时大幅降低了计算延迟。

title: SIREN (Luring LLMs onto the Rocks): PAIR-Driven Preference Manipulation in Web-RAG Recommenders
abstract:
arXiv:2607.21951v4 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: This paper investigates the adversarial manipulation of the ranked recommendations produced by web-augmented large language models (LLMs). When an LLM answers a recommendation query by retrieving and reading live webpages, it acts as a recommender, and each retrieved page becomes a potential attack surface. Prior work has examined fabricated products, retrieval poisoning, and rank promotion. However, these studies do not compare how different edits to an already retrieved page change the model's final ranking while the surrounding source set remains unchanged. To address this gap, we propose SIREN, an automated attacker--judge method that adapts the PAIR jailbreaking loop to competitive rank manipulation, with the goal of moving a chosen entity to rank~1 in an LLM-generated recommendation. SIREN retrieves and captures webpages using Anthropic's web tools, then iteratively edits a retrieved source using an interpretable taxonomy of 23 content-poisoning techniques. The custom-RAG replay platform keeps the same sources in the same order, so changes in the model's ranking can be linked to changes in the supplied content rather than to differences in retrieval. Across two production Claude models, SIREN reaches rank~1 in 62 of 124 technique trials nested within eight query--model contexts. The payloads that reached rank~1 were then tested in fresh sessions, where they reproduced the result with a mean success rate of 0.805. Across the evaluated settings, declarative ranking claims and seeded lists were generally more effective than directive-form injections, although the strength of this difference depended on the target model. To the best of our knowledge, this is among the first controlled studies of competitive rank manipulation in production LLMs where the supplied source context is kept fixed.
thinking: 该论文针对基于检索增强生成（RAG）的LLM推荐系统，提出了一种新颖的、自动化的对抗性攻击方法SIREN，并设计了严谨的受控实验来评估不同内容投毒技术对排名结果的影响，方法学上具有创新性和规范性。其研究揭示了当前LLM-RAG推荐系统在内容安全上的重大脆弱性，对构建更健壮的推荐系统具有直接的警示和实践参考价值。然而，其技术核心（PAIR攻击、内容投毒）虽前沿，但本质上是对现有攻击方法的系统化应用与评估，而非底层技术原理的根本性突破。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，通过自动化内容投毒攻击，可以稳定地操控基于网络检索的LLM推荐系统的排名结果，揭示了此类系统的安全风险。

title: Hierarchical Exponential-Gaussian Mixtures for Watch-Time Distribution Prediction
abstract:
arXiv:2608.23356v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Accurate watch-time (WT) prediction is an important requirement for short-video recommendations. Yet WT distributions are near-zero-inflated, long-tailed and multimodal. The recent Exponential-Gaussian Mixture Network (EGMN) models the full conditional WT distribution rather than a single point estimate and achieves state-of-the-art performance. Our large-scale reproduction study reveals that EGMN is vulnerable to variance collapse, component redundancy, and inactive components. We propose a Hierarchical Exponential-Gaussian Mixture (HEGM) model that addresses these failure modes through a hierarchical skip-watch decomposition, structured initialization, removal of the forced Gaussian shift and entropy regularizer and optional KL-based variance regularization for over-parameterized mixtures. Across large-scale industrial and public datasets, under a fixed-backbone head-replacement protocol, HEGM improves ranking accuracy and threshold-event prediction over reproducible lightweight baselines, while maintaining competitive point-estimation accuracy and substantially improving mixture stability and interpretability. A 1.5-month production A/B test confirms statistically significant engagement lifts. Our code and models are publicly released at https://github.com/rw404/HEGM.
thinking: 该论文针对短视频推荐中的观看时长预测问题，提出了一个改进的层次化指数-高斯混合模型，有效解决了现有模型存在的方差塌缩、组件冗余等问题，并通过大规模实验和线上A/B测试验证了其性能提升和稳定性。其方法严谨，应用场景明确，但所采用的核心混合模型技术本身并非当前最前沿的AI范式。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种改进的混合模型，能更稳定、准确地预测短视频观看时长分布，并在实际线上测试中显著提升了用户参与度。

title: Token-Budgeted Escalation for Financial Document Question Answering: Cost Is Predictable, Benefit Is the Bottleneck
abstract:
arXiv:2610.07760v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation systems can route difficult queries to deeper context, but batch deployments must allocate a shared token budget across calls whose costs vary by query. We formulate selective escalation as finite-batch allocation for financial document question answering. Each of 150 FinanceBench questions first receives a top-1 retrieval answer. Predictors estimate the adjudication-quality gain and token cost of an optional top-5 call, and the allocator prioritizes calls by predicted gain per token. At the nominal 10% budget, gain-per-token allocation improves adjudication quality over gain-only ranking by 0.034 (95% document-bootstrap confidence interval [0.001, 0.072]) while using 46.6% fewer total tokens than one-pass top-5 retrieval. Additional-call cost is accurately predictable (R-squared 0.93), whereas beneficial escalation remains difficult to rank (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve 0.60). These results show that heterogeneous cost is actionable under tight constraints, while progress across the full budget frontier depends on stronger query-specific benefit estimates.
thinking: 该论文针对检索增强生成系统在有限资源下的优化问题，提出了一个基于预测增益与成本的动态分配框架，方法设计严谨，在金融文档问答场景中验证了成本可预测而效益是瓶颈的核心发现。其不足在于研究场景（FinanceBench）相对特定，且效益预测的准确性（AUC 0.60）仍有较大提升空间，限制了其在更广泛业务场景中的直接迁移应用。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，在有限计算资源下优化文档问答系统时，额外检索的成本容易预测，但其带来的质量提升却难以准确预估。

title: The Answer Lies Within: Self-Derived Rewards Enable Explainable Relation Extraction
abstract:
arXiv:2510.06198v4 Announce Type: replace-cross
