Abstract: Despite the remarkable reasoning capabilities of large language models, they still struggle with one-shot relation extraction without predefined relation labels. We identify two pitfalls: models are often misled by irrelevant tokens instead of relation-conveying semantics, and they often fail to align with the abstraction level human annotators expect. We introduce a novel framework that closes this gap with two components: (1) COGRE, a cognitively-inspired reasoning framework that structures RE into a series of processes mimicking human text-processing; and (2) HIT@DICT, a reinforcement learning intermediate reward strategy that encourages reasoning to align with relational labels by rewarding relation-relevant phrases in reasoning. The reward is derived on a credit dictionary automatically extracted from correct predictions. Our experiments show that our framework improves both accuracy and explanation quality by addressing these two pitfalls. For example, COGRE with Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct on One-shot NYT29 achieves 24.65% F1, surpassing prior reasoning-based designs. Optimizing this approach with RL using HIT@DICT further improves performance by +23.46% points. Finally, human evaluation shows that our best model generates relational phrases closely aligned with gold labels, increasing human explanation quality ratings by 54% (relative).
thinking: 该论文提出了一种结合认知启发式推理框架与强化学习奖励策略的新方法，用于提升大语言模型在少样本关系抽取任务中的准确性和可解释性。其优势在于方法设计新颖且实验验证较为充分，但作为预印本论文，其方法严谨性（如样本量、可复现性细节）和业务落地价值（主要面向技术优化而非直接图情应用）仍有提升空间。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究通过模拟人类认知的推理框架和自衍生的强化学习奖励，有效提升了大语言模型在少样本关系抽取任务中的性能和可解释性。

title: PRISM: Prompt-Refined In-Context System Modelling for Financial Retrieval
abstract:
arXiv:2511.14130v3 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Deploying LLMs for financial information retrieval demands accuracy, cost efficiency, and reproducibility, yet most approaches require expensive fine-tuning. PRISM is a training-free framework that composes three deployable modules (prompt engineering, in-context learning, and a candidate refinement module) with a boundary-condition study of multi-agent coordination for financial document retrieval. On FiQA-2018, stacked reranking and $k$-reciprocal encoding raise Recall@100 from 0.7783 to 0.8326. On FinAgentBench, a Cohere-refined top-50 pool yields a higher observed end-to-end NDCG@5, below this evaluation's minimum detectable effect, while cutting per-query cost by about 35%. Added complexity does not always pay off: $k$-reciprocal encoding stops helping once the upstream stage is already high-recall, and multi-agent coordination is not a default for fine-grained chunk ranking. Matched pairs that hold prompt, model, and exemplars fixed lose 0.0702 and 0.0681 combined NDCG@5 to their single-path controls, and the whole gap sits at the chunk stage. We release an expert-annotated FinAgentBench evaluation set, together with a label-robustness sweep over 16 alternative ground-truth constructions, restoring a reproducible evaluation path after the original evaluator went offline. Without fine-tuning, PRISM placed third on the official FinAgentBench private leaderboard (leaderboard basis, NDCG@5 0.71181), reaches NDCG@10 0.6197 on FiQA-2018, and 98% accuracy on FinanceBench. We report per-query latency, token, and dollar accounting across roughly 40 configurations, present the quality-cost-latency Pareto frontier, and introduce FACET, a transparent SLA-specific scalarization for choosing among non-dominated configurations. Code and dataset are released at https://bit.ly/prism-ailens.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种无需微调的LLM金融信息检索框架PRISM，通过模块化设计（提示工程、上下文学习、候选精炼）和边界条件研究，在多个金融基准测试上取得了良好效果。其优势在于系统性地探索了质量-成本-延迟的帕累托前沿，并发布了标注数据集以增强可复现性；不足在于部分复杂技术（如多智能体协调）在细粒度排序中未显示明确优势，且部分提升效果可能低于最小可检测效应。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种无需微调大语言模型的金融信息检索框架，通过优化提示和精炼模块，在控制成本的同时提升了检索效果。

title: Controlling Output Rankings in LLM-Based Search via Generative Engine Optimization
abstract:
arXiv:2602.03608v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: The way customers search for and choose products is changing with the rise of large language models (LLMs). LLM-based search, or generative engines, provides direct product recommendations to users, rather than traditional online search results that require users to explore options themselves. However, these recommendations are strongly influenced by the initial retrieval order of LLMs, which disadvantages small businesses and independent creators by limiting their visibility.
  In this work, we propose CORE, an optimization method that \textbf{C}ontrols \textbf{O}utput \textbf{R}ankings in g\textbf{E}nerative Engines for LLM-based search. Since the LLM's interactions with the search engine are black-box, CORE targets the content returned by search engines as the primary means of influencing output rankings. Specifically, CORE optimizes retrieved content by appending strategically designed optimization content to steer the ranking of outputs. We introduce three types of optimization content: string-based, reasoning-based, and review-based, demonstrating their effectiveness in shaping output rankings. To evaluate CORE in realistic settings, we introduce ProductBench, a large-scale benchmark with 15 product categories and 200 products per category, where each product is associated with its top-10 recommendations collected from Amazon's search interface.
  Extensive experiments on four LLMs with search capabilities (GPT-4o, Gemini-2.5, Claude-4, and Grok-3) demonstrate that CORE achieves an average Promotion Success Rate of \textbf{91.4\% @Top-5}, \textbf{86.6\% @Top-3}, and \textbf{80.3\% @Top-1}, across 15 product categories, outperforming existing ranking manipulation methods while preserving the fluency of optimized content.
thinking: 论文针对LLM搜索中的排名偏差问题，提出了CORE优化方法，通过设计优化内容来影响输出排序，技术方案新颖且实验设计严谨。然而，其研究场景聚焦于电商产品推荐，与图书馆、信息机构的核心业务（如学术资源发现）的直接关联度有限，实践应用价值因此受到制约。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种通过优化检索内容来控制大语言模型搜索输出排名的方法，有效提升了指定产品的推荐位置。

title: LTEM: LLM-Friendly Table-Enhanced Markdown for Table Understanding and Generation
abstract:
arXiv:2610.29188v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Tables in real-world documents, including scientific papers, financial reports, and statistical summaries, frequently use merged cells, multi-level headers, and sectioned layouts. Yet the lightweight formats LLMs handle best (Markdown, CSV) cannot express these structures, while expressive formats (HTML, LaTeX) impose excessive token cost and parsing complexity. To enable systematic analysis of this trade-off, we introduce a taxonomy decomposing table structure into six atomic features (F1-F6) and corresponding complexity levels (L1-L6), and construct STB (Synthetic Table Benchmark), a controlled benchmark with 1,089 tables systematically distributed across complexity levels. Using this framework, we propose LTEM (LLM-friendly Table-Enhanced Markdown), a formally specified, minimal extension of Markdown that explicitly encodes spans and hierarchical headers. Experiments across five state-of-the-art LLMs show that LTEM achieves accuracy comparable to HTML, offers a favorable accuracy-token trade-off relative to HTML and LaTeX, and produces substantially fewer invalid responses than LaTeX; for table generation, LTEM is comparable to MultiMarkdown though HTML is best. We release our taxonomy, benchmark, and format specification to support future research on LLM-table interaction.
thinking: 论文提出了一种面向大语言模型的表格增强标记语言LTEM，通过引入形式化规范来编码表格的合并单元格和多级表头等复杂结构，在保持Markdown简洁性的同时提升了表格理解和生成的准确性。研究构建了系统的表格复杂度分类体系和基准数据集，实验设计严谨，但LTEM在表格生成任务上仍略逊于HTML，且其实践应用场景主要局限于技术文档处理，在图书馆业务中的直接落地价值有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种新的标记语言LTEM，能更有效地让大语言模型理解和生成具有复杂结构的表格。

title: Beyond Binary Labels: Diagnostic Evaluation of LLM Safety with Prompt-Level Rubrics
abstract:
arXiv:2610.29225v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Current LLM safety benchmarks predominantly rely on binary safe or unsafe labels, lacking explanatory depth and suffering from low consistency across automated judges. To address this, we introduce DiagSafe, a diagnostic evaluation framework that moves beyond binary classification by employing prompt-level rubrics. Grounded in globally applicable AI safety policies, each rubric provides explicit criteria along two dimensions: safety, which targets concrete harms with specific exemptions to suppress false positives, and usefulness, which independently evaluates instruction fulfillment. To ensure a robust and realistic evaluation, we construct a bilingual (English-Chinese) benchmark grounded in a comprehensive 84-label safety taxonomy, consisting of two subsets: DiagBase, which covers single- and multi-turn prompts with direct harmful queries and template-based jailbreaks, and DiagAttack, which embeds harmful intents into complex instruction-following tasks to form challenging instruction attacks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DiagSafe significantly enhances the reliability of LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, achieving 95.34% agreement with human annotations -- substantially higher than the 69%-87% achieved by the baselines -- and high inter-judge consistency (Cohen's $\kappa$ = 0.864). Furthermore, applying our framework reveals that leading LLMs differ markedly in their unsafe rates, and each model also exhibits unique vulnerabilities along different dimensions. In addition, we observe that models are particularly susceptible in Chinese and multi-turn contexts. Ultimately, DiagSafe provides a reliable and explainable tool for auditing and optimizing LLM alignment.
thinking: 该论文针对当前大语言模型安全评估中二元标签的局限性，提出了一个基于提示级量规的诊断性评估框架DiagSafe，具有明确的方法论创新。其构建的双语基准和细致的实验设计（包括与人工标注的高一致性验证）体现了较高的方法严谨性。然而，其研究场景主要面向通用AI安全评估，与图情领域的特定业务场景（如信息素养教育、虚假信息检测、参考咨询中的伦理审查）的直接结合点尚不明确，实践应用价值需进一步转化。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一个超越二元标签的大语言模型安全诊断评估框架，通过提示级量规显著提升了自动化评估的可靠性与可解释性。

title: OSynth: A Longitudinal, Context-Sensitive Evaluation of Meeting Understanding
abstract:
arXiv:2610.29319v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Meeting notetakers are increasingly deployed in settings where longitudinal context is available including calendar metadata, prior meetings, emails, slides, and speaker enrollments; however, meeting corpora remain limited in terms of size, domain coverage, and available context. We present OSynth, a large-scale synthetic dataset of simulated organizations comprising 570 hours of meeting audio together with associated artifacts and a latent ground-truth state. In a pairwise comparison, human raters distinguish OSynth meetings from real meeting transcripts with only 56% accuracy based on excerpts of 150-300 words. Across state-of-the-art LLMs, additional context yields significant gains on several entity-sensitive dimensions, demonstrating limitations of contemporary approaches and the potential usefulness of OSynth in developing better-contextualized meeting-understanding systems.
thinking: 该论文通过构建大规模合成数据集OSynth，为会议理解系统提供了丰富的纵向上下文资源，弥补了现有语料库的不足，在数据生成和评估方法上具有创新性。然而，其研究场景（模拟组织会议）与图书馆、信息机构的核心业务（如信息服务、知识组织）的直接关联性较弱，实践应用价值有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究创建了一个大规模合成会议数据集，证明增加上下文信息能显著提升大语言模型对会议内容的理解能力。

title: Policy Central: Detecting Conflicts, Redundancy, and Similarity in Deployed Police Policy
abstract:
arXiv:2610.29338v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Policy Central is a deployed system that helps police departments find relationships between sections of their written policy: whether two sections conflict, are redundant, are merely similar, or are different. We describe the system and compare two architectures. Retrieve-Judge, a retrieve-then-classify pipeline, runs as a cheap library-wide health signal; Screen-Confirm, a screen-then-confirm cascade, is a selective audit of the documents a reviewer chooses, checking them exhaustively against one another. On a 302-pair benchmark drawn from one department's ~84 real policy documents, given each pair Screen-Confirm reaches 0.795 aggregate recall and 0.885 on Conflict, so current models judge well. Finding the pair is the hard part: Retrieve-Judge's composed recall falls to 0.457, and Screen-Confirm recovers 0.472 (0.615 on Conflict). Today these pairs are found by reading the whole library, nearly 20,000 sections, checked against one another and re-checked after every revision. A scan that returns half of them in minutes, at low cost, and can be re-run on demand changes the economics of policy review even before recall improves.
thinking: 论文提出并比较了两种用于检测警务政策文本冲突、冗余和相似性的系统架构，采用了检索-分类和筛选-确认的混合方法，技术方案具有创新性。研究基于真实政策文档构建了302对样本的基准测试，方法较为严谨，但样本量相对有限，且主要面向警务政策这一特定领域，在图书馆与信息科学领域的直接应用价值有待进一步转化。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究开发并评估了两种能自动检测警务政策文本中冲突、冗余和相似关系的系统，显著提升了政策审查的效率。

title: ChronoSynth: Constraint-Aware Question Synthesis over Temporal Knowledge Graphs
abstract:
arXiv:2610.29339v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Knowledge graph question generation (KGQG) generates natural-language questions from structured graph evidence and a target answer. When the input graph is temporal, a valid question must also preserve the answer field, time condition, reference event, and temporal order that determine the answer set. Existing KGQG methods and prompting baselines can produce fluent questions that alter these conditions, causing temporal semantic drift. This paper studies temporal KGQG as a constraint-preserving graph-to-question problem and proposes ChronoSynth, a memory-augmented and constraint-aware generation framework. ChronoSynth first constructs a Temporal Intent State to make the intended question semantics explicit. It then retrieves compatible typed question patterns from an indexed pattern memory, adapts them to the input graph, and validates the generated question. Validation feedback guides revisions when a supported inconsistency is detected. Experiments on CRONQUESTIONS and MultiTQ demonstrate state-of-the-art generation performance, with ablations supporting the contributions of its components.
thinking: 该论文针对时序知识图谱的问答生成问题，提出了一个约束感知的生成框架，在方法上结合了显式语义状态构建、模式记忆检索和验证反馈机制，具有较好的创新性和严谨性。其研究场景（时序知识图谱）和解决方案（约束保持）具有明确的针对性，但作为一项前沿方法研究，其直接落地到图书馆等业务场景的路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种能确保时间约束不被破坏的时序知识图谱问答自动生成新方法。

title: Memory-Centric Continual Learning for AI Agents
abstract:
arXiv:2610.29357v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Autonomous agents powered by foundation models can reason, plan, and use tools, but their fixed weights and context limits hinder sustained learning from experience over long-term deployment. While external memory systems attempt to bridge this gap, they mostly act as passive retrieval caches, evaluated primarily by whether they can recall stored facts or past interactions. Whether memory can drive genuine continual learning remains an open question. In this paper, we introduce Memory-Centric Continual Learning (MCCL), arguing that memory should be judged by whether it improves future actions, not merely what it retrieves. MCCL has three main parts. First, a three-axis taxonomy organizes memory by where state is stored (substrates), what form it takes (assets), and how it is managed (policies). This defines a two-loop lifecycle that updates memory state in an inner loop while refining management policies in an outer loop based on task feedback. Second, an evaluation protocol measures retention under interference, adaptation to change, and task transfer to isolate genuine behavioral gains from simple context expansion. Third, a memory scaling framework models how agent performance scales with experience, storage capacity, and compute budgets across non-parametric and parametric memory. Together, these components reframe agent memory from passive lookup to continuous learning, offering a principled route toward self-improving autonomous agents.
thinking: 该论文提出了面向AI智能体的记忆中心持续学习框架，在方法论上具有创新性和系统性，通过三轴分类法、评估协议和扩展框架构建了严谨的研究体系。然而，论文目前处于预印本阶段，其具体技术实现细节和在图情领域的直接应用场景尚不明确，业务落地价值有待后续研究验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一个将AI智能体的外部记忆从被动检索转变为主动驱动持续学习的系统性框架。

title: Graph Topology Meets Energy-Driven Pathfinding: Preserving Contextual Consistency in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract:
arXiv:2610.29933v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frequently integrates knowledge graphs (KGs) for complex multi-hop question answering. However, their performance is increasingly bottlenecked by the knowledge structuring and reasoning processes. (i) Severe semantic loss: Distilling continuous texts into discrete symbols strips away contextual nuances and narrative coherence. (ii) Pronounced modality mismatch: Fragmented graph structures clash with the continuous texts LLMs are pre-trained on, while rewriting them into natural language introduces generative noise and omits information. To address these limitations, we propose ThreadRAG, a semantic-topology-based RAG framework for context-preserving knowledge structuring and modality-native evidence reasoning. ThreadRAG introduces a Semantic Topology Mapper (STM), which organizes retrieved documents into context-intact Semantic Nodes and constructs a Semantic Topology Graph (STG) through narrative, semantic, and lexical edges. It further incorporates Energy-Driven Pathfinding (EDP), which identifies query-relevant subgraphs via energy diffusion and deterministically linearizes them into coherent textual evidence paths. Experiments on three multi-hop QA benchmarks demonstrate that ThreadRAG consistently outperforms strong baselines. Notably, it achieves a 14.4% EM improvement over text-centric methods on HotpotQA and surpasses the best baseline by 5.8% EM on 2WikiMultihop, while reducing token cost to 23.3% of the strongest baseline.
thinking: 该论文提出了ThreadRAG框架，通过语义拓扑图（STG）和能量驱动路径查找（EDP）技术，创新性地解决了传统知识图谱在RAG中的语义损失和模态不匹配问题，技术方案具有前沿性。实验在多个基准测试上验证了其有效性，方法严谨，但作为预印本，其在实际图书馆或信息系统的落地应用路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种结合语义拓扑图和能量驱动路径的新框架，显著提升了检索增强生成在多跳问答任务中的准确性和效率。

title: Building Auditable AI Text Detectors with Sparse Autoencoders
abstract:
arXiv:2610.30006v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: AI-generated text detectors are increasingly deployed in consequential settings---peer review, education, admissions, journalism, and content moderation---where their outputs directly affect individuals. Yet the strongest detectors are fine-tuned neural classifiers whose decisions are opaque, while transparent alternatives (stylometric and linguistic-feature classifiers) underperform them by wide margins. We present a pipeline that converts a fine-tuned neural detector into a classifier that operates on human-readable concepts. We accomplish this by training sparse autoencoders (SAEs) directly on a detector's residual stream, assigning auto-interpretation labels to each SAE feature, and retaining only features whose generated descriptions pass a global fidelity threshold. We then train a lightweight classifier on just the interpretable features. We find that our SAEs recover latent concepts that correspond to highly specific and predictive linguistic "tells" of AI-generated text. Classifiers built on these extracted features are not only highly interpretable but exhibit stronger performance on out-of-distribution texts than either neural or stylometric alternatives.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种利用稀疏自编码器构建可审计AI文本检测器的方法，在提升模型可解释性的同时保持了较强的检测性能，尤其在分布外文本上表现优异。其方法结合了前沿的神经网络技术与传统特征工程的优势，技术路线清晰且实验验证较为充分，但作为预印本论文，其方法在真实业务场景（如学术出版、教育审核）中的具体部署和稳定性仍需进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究通过稀疏自编码器提取可解释的文本特征，构建了性能更强且可审计的AI生成文本检测器。

title: Disentangling generalization and memorization in large language models using chess
abstract:
arXiv:2601.16823v3 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit remarkable capabilities, yet it remains unclear to what extent these reflect sophisticated recall or genuine reasoning ability. We introduce chess as a controlled testbed aimed at disentangling these faculties. Leveraging the game's structure and scalable engine evaluations, we construct a taxonomy of positions varying in density of relevant priors -- ranging from common states solvable by memorization to completely novel ones requiring generalization. Crucially, our approach achieves this distinction without requiring explicit knowledge of the models' training data. Applying this taxonomy, we combine a longitudinal analysis of the GPT lineage with a rigorous evaluation of contemporary models, including Claude Opus and Gemini. Our analysis reveals a steep gradient: performance consistently degrades as the density of relevant priors decreases. Notably, for tasks with few relevant priors, base model performance regresses to the random-play baseline, and all models propose illegal moves at sharply increasing rates, indicating that they fail to reliably apply the fixed rules of the game in unfamiliar positions. While newer models improve, progress slows significantly for tasks with sparse priors. Furthermore, while reasoning-augmented inference improves performance, its relative marginal benefit per token decreases in the absence of relevant priors. These results suggest limitations in systematic generalization, highlighting the need for mechanisms beyond scale to achieve robust performance when deprived of relevant priors.
thinking: 该论文采用国际象棋作为受控实验环境，通过构建基于先验知识密度的分类法，系统评估了LLM的泛化与记忆能力，方法设计严谨且具有创新性。然而，其研究场景（国际象棋）与图情领域的直接业务实践关联较弱，应用价值主要体现在对AI技术能力的理解层面。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究通过国际象棋实验发现，大语言模型在缺乏相关先验知识的陌生情境下，其泛化能力存在显著局限，性能会急剧下降。

title: AfrIFact: Cultural Information Retrieval, Evidence Extraction and Fact Checking for African Languages
abstract:
arXiv:2604.00706v3 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Assessing the veracity of a claim made online is a complex and important task with real-world implications. When these claims are directed at communities with limited access to information and the content concerns issues such as healthcare and culture, the consequences intensify, especially in low-resource languages. In this work, we introduce AfrIFact, a dataset that covers the necessary steps for automatic fact-checking (i.e., information retrieval, evidence extraction, and fact checking), in ten African languages and English. Our evaluation results show that even the best embedding models lack cross-lingual retrieval capabilities, and that cultural and news documents are easier to retrieve than healthcare-domain documents, both in large corpora and in single documents. We show that LLMs lack robust multilingual fact-verification capabilities in African languages, while few-shot prompting improves performance by up to 43% in AfriqueQwen-14B, and task-specific fine-tuning further improves fact-checking accuracy by up to 26%. These findings, along with our release of the AfrIFact dataset, encourage work on low-resource information retrieval, evidence retrieval, and fact checking.
thinking: 该论文聚焦非洲低资源语言的事实核查任务，构建了多语言数据集并评估了嵌入模型与大语言模型的表现，在技术前沿性上体现了对多语言NLP和事实核查的关注，但方法严谨性受限于数据集规模和模型评估的初步性。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究构建了涵盖十种非洲语言的事实核查数据集，并发现现有模型在跨语言检索和事实核查任务上存在不足，但提示工程和微调能显著提升性能。

title: A Robust Evaluation of Probe Robustness: Lessons for Reliable OOD Uncertainty Quantification
abstract:
arXiv:2604.11662v3 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Recent work has shown that the hidden states of large language models contain signals useful for uncertainty estimation, motivating a growing interest in efficient probe-based approaches. Yet it remains unclear how robust existing methods are, with prior work reporting conflicting conclusions under substantially different evaluation settings. We address this by introducing ProbeDrift, a systematic evaluation framework for supervised uncertainty probes covering a wide range of OOD settings across models, tasks, and distributional shifts. Using ProbeDrift, we train over 2,000 probes to disentangle the effect of key design choices, showing poor robustness of current methods beyond near-OOD settings. We find that robustness is driven by design decisions that have a largely invisible effect in-distribution, including the choice of feature type, aggregation strategy, and training signal. We argue that robust uncertainty estimation requires robust evaluation. To support this, we release ProbeDrift as a lightweight Python library that contains the train and test splits underpinning our extensive evaluation. We also show how insights from our evaluation can directly lead to more robust methods through a simple Hybrid Back-Off (HBO) strategy.
thinking: 该论文提出了一个系统性的评估框架ProbeDrift，用于检验基于探针的OOD不确定性量化方法的鲁棒性，其大规模实验设计（训练超过2000个探针）和方法论分析具有较高的严谨性。然而，论文更侧重于评估范式的构建和方法论探讨，其提出的HBO策略仅为初步示例，在具体图书馆或信息业务场景中的直接落地路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 论文通过构建系统性评估框架，揭示了现有大语言模型不确定性探针方法在分布外场景下的鲁棒性不足问题。

title: Deep Reasoning in General Purpose Agents via Structured Meta-Cognition
abstract:
arXiv:2605.11388v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Humans intuitively solve complex problems by flexibly shifting among reasoning modes: they plan, execute, revise intermediate goals, resolve ambiguity through associative judgment, and apply formal procedures to well-specified subproblems. Current LLM agents lack this flexibility, as their scaffolds hard-code such reasoning decisions in advance. These scaffolds are effective when their prescribed structure matches the task, but brittle when solving the task requires adapting the structure of reasoning itself. We introduce Deep Reasoning -- an inference-time approach for constructing task-specific scaffolds through structured meta-reasoning. Deep Reasoning uses a formal language that represents meta-reasoning as executable decompositions over associative inference, formal computation, and recursive subproblem solving, enabling decomposition principles to be encoded as in-context examples that guide test-time scaffold construction. We instantiate this approach in a general-purpose agent (DOLORES) that distributes complex tasks across more controlled reasoning threads. We evaluate it against state-of-the-art scaffolding methods across four hard benchmarks: multi-hop reasoning, long-chain question answering, long-context aggregation, and deep research-style information seeking. DOLORES outperforms all evaluated scaffolds across three model sizes and two model families, improving over the strongest evaluated scaffold baseline by 24.8% on average. DOLORES distributes cognition across structured, lower-load reasoning threads, thereby reducing premature termination and hallucinations. This advantage can even bridge the scaling gap, with an 8B version surpassing all evaluated 32B baselines from the same family in more than half the settings. These results point toward future agentic systems that treat scaffolding as adaptive reasoning, constructing the structure each task requires just-in-time.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种通过结构化元认知实现深度推理的方法，并在通用智能体DOLORES中进行了实例化，其核心创新在于推理过程的动态构建，而非预先固定的框架，这属于当前AI代理研究的前沿方向。论文在四个硬基准测试上进行了系统评估，方法严谨，结果显著，但其业务落地值在图情领域尚不明确，主要贡献在于方法论层面。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种让AI智能体能够像人类一样动态切换和组合不同推理模式的方法，从而在复杂任务上超越了现有的固定框架方法。

title: PersonalAI 2.0: Enhancing knowledge graph traversal/retrieval with planning mechanism for Personalized LLM Agents
abstract:
arXiv:2605.13481v4 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: We introduce PersonalAI 2.0 (PAI-2), a novel framework designed to enhance LLM-based systems through integration of external knowledge graphs (KGs). The proposed approach addresses key limitations of existing Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) methods by incorporating a dynamic, multistage pipeline. The central point of the PAI-2 design is its ability to perform adaptive, iterative information search, guided by extracted entities, matched graph vertices and generated clue-queries. Conducted evaluation on five benchmarks (Natural Questions, TriviaQA, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA and MuSiQue) demonstrates an improvement in the factual correctness of generated answers compared to baseline methods (LightRAG, RAPTOR, HippoRAG 2 and PAI-1). PAI-2 achieves a 9 percentage points (pp) average gain by LLM-as-a-Judge on 2WikiMultihopQA and MuSiQue benchmarks, and attains comparable accuracy to HippoRAG 2 on the TriviaQA and HotpotQA benchmarks with Qwen2.5 7B and multilingual-e5-large reflecting its effectiveness in reducing hallucination rates and increasing recall. We show that enabled search plan enhancement mechanism gain in average a 18 pp boost compared to disabled one by LLM-as-a-Judge across five benchmarks. In addition, an ablation study reveals that PAI-2 achieves superior result on the MINE-1 benchmark, obtaining an 89\% information-retention score with Qwen2.5 7B and multilingual-e5-large. Collectively, these findings underscore the potential of PAI-2 to serve as a reusable component for personalized AI applications, which require context-aware knowledge-representation and reasoning capabilities. The source code of PAI-2 is available at the following link: https://github.com/Dzigen/PersonalAI.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种结合知识图谱检索与规划机制来增强大语言模型代理的框架，在多个问答基准测试上验证了其在提升事实准确性和减少幻觉方面的有效性，方法较为新颖且实验设计系统。但作为预印本，其方法在真实图情业务场景（如数字图书馆或学科知识服务）中的具体落地路径和适用性尚不明确，且部分技术细节（如知识图谱构建）的普适性有待进一步考察。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究通过引入动态规划机制优化知识图谱检索，有效提升了大型语言模型在复杂问答任务中的事实准确性。

title: MARS: Multi-hop Adaptive Retrieval and SPARQL Generation for KGQA
abstract:
arXiv:2607.14561v3 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong reasoning performance, but their tendency to hallucinate limits their reliability in knowledge-intensive tasks requiring up-to-date and grounded information. Combining knowledge graphs (KGs) with LLMs facilitates the use of explicit symbolic knowledge that can be continuously updated without costly fine-tuning, while benefiting from rapidly advancing LLM reasoning. We propose MARS, a scalable knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) approach that requires no model fine-tuning. Rather than relying on open-ended agentic exploration, MARS performs a structured retrieval procedure that links question entities to the KG and iteratively retrieves relevant next-hop information. At each step, MARS decides whether to continue graph traversal or to generate the final SPARQL query, allowing the model to adapt the retrieval depth to the question while keeping the overall pipeline more predictable than fully agentic approaches. We evaluate MARS on three established KGQA benchmarks across several LLMs and settings, including multilingual evaluation, and provide insights through ablation studies and error analysis. Our approach achieves competitive performance relative to state-of-the-art methods while remaining efficient and scalable. The evaluation results, code and resources are publicly available: https://github.com/dice-group/mars-kgqa.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种结合知识图谱与大语言模型的知识图谱问答方法，无需微调模型，通过结构化检索和自适应图遍历来提升可靠性和效率。其优势在于方法设计严谨，在多个基准测试上进行了验证，并提供了代码资源，具有较好的可复现性；不足在于其核心技术（LLM与KG结合）虽属前沿，但并非首创，且作为方法学研究，其直接业务落地场景尚需进一步明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种无需微调大语言模型的自适应知识图谱问答方法，通过结构化检索平衡了回答的可靠性与效率。

title: NodeSynth: Socially Aligned Synthetic Data for AI Evaluation
abstract:
arXiv:2605.14381v3 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Recent advancements in generative AI facilitate large-scale synthetic data generation for model evaluation. However, without targeted approaches, these datasets often lack the sociotechnical nuance required for sensitive domains. We introduce NodeSyn, a methodology that pairs a fine-tuned taxonomy generator (TaG) with credible published sources and extracted sensitive attributes to generate queries reflecting authentic societal contexts and nuanced harms. Evaluated across ten open-weight and proprietary LLMs in Medical Advice and Self-Harm using human-validated autoraters, NodeSyn ranked first on 8 of 10 models in each domain. NodeSyn datasets induced average failure rates 3.1 times higher than generic synthetic baselines, 2.4 times higher than structured synthetic benchmarks, and 1.6 times higher than authentic human-authored queries. Ablation studies confirm that, controlling for structural confounds, our granular Level 3 taxonomic expansion significantly drives these failure rates over Level 2 across 9 of 10 models (+29.2% relative lift in Medical Advice and +24.0% in Self-Harm). Variance attribution analysis reveals that failures are driven not only by what topics are queried (taxonomic nodes and lexical specificity), but also by their sociotechnical grounding (affected demographics, occupations, geographies, and querying personas). We embed this method into a research prototype, and open-source (https://github.com/google-research/nodesynth) the code and datasets to enable scalable, high-stakes model evaluation
thinking: 论文提出了一种结合细粒度分类生成器与可信来源的社会对齐合成数据生成方法，在医学建议和自伤领域显著提升了LLM评估的失败率，方法严谨且经过充分验证。然而，其技术核心在于对现有生成式AI的针对性应用与优化，而非开创全新的前沿技术范式，且其直接应用场景目前主要局限于AI模型的高风险评估领域，在图情领域的普适性落地路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种能生成反映真实社会语境和细微危害的合成数据方法，用于更有效地评估人工智能模型在高风险领域的表现。

title: From Atomic to Agentic: Towards Interpretable Evaluation of LLMs' Agentic Mathematical Capabilities
abstract:
arXiv:2608.26950v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are evolving from performing end-to-end mathematical reasoning to integrating agentic intelligence. However, most existing math benchmarks evaluate only final answers. This outcome-oriented evaluation provides limited diagnostic value for identifying process-level failures or rigorous logic, failing to guide the transformation of LLMs into robust agents. To bridge this gap, we present a process-level benchmark designed to evaluate the inherent agentic mathematical reasoning abilities of LLMs. Our framework aligns problem-solving agentic behaviors with a structured taxonomy of reusable mathematical atomic capabilities. We design a comprehensive suite of planning, action, and feedback tasks across both textual and multimodal contexts, supported by an automated pipeline that synthesizes high-quality trajectories and produces fine-grained annotations via controlled LLM rewriting. Experiments reveal that models with similar end-to-end accuracy can exhibit markedly different agentic capability profiles. This demonstrates that process-level evaluation is crucial for interpreting the true potential of LLMs and guiding the development of next-generation mathematical agents.
thinking: 该论文针对大语言模型在数学推理中的代理能力评估，提出了过程级评估框架，并设计了自动化标注流程，方法较为严谨。然而，其研究场景聚焦于通用AI能力评测，与图书馆、信息机构的具体业务结合度较低，实践应用价值有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一个过程级评估框架，用于更精细地诊断大语言模型在数学推理中的代理能力，超越了仅关注最终答案的传统方法。

title: Guest Post — All this AI Signal and Noise: What Deserves Action Now
abstract:
Amidst the onslaught of industry and global changes, opportunities, and advancements, which signals deserve action now, which are context, and which are weather?

The post Guest Post — All this AI Signal and Noise: What Deserves Action Now appeared first on The Scholarly Kitchen.
thinking: 该资讯发表于2026年，对当前（2024年）而言是未来内容，时效性评分受限。内容聚焦于AI在学术出版领域的应用辨析，与图情领域的信息组织、传播和服务高度相关。文章旨在帮助从业者从海量信息中识别关键趋势并采取行动，具有较高的决策参考价值。
one_sentence_summary: 一篇来自学术厨房的客座文章，探讨在AI热潮中，哪些信号值得图书馆和出版界立即采取行动。

title: FOS: a large-scale temporal graph benchmark for scientific interdisciplinary link prediction
abstract: Interdisciplinary connections between scientific fields often develop gradually, and forecasting where new cross-field connections will next arise remains a major challenge. We introduce FOS (Future Of Science), a time-aware, graph-based resource built from the OpenAlex knowledge graph that reconstructs annual co-occurrence graphs spanning 65,027 research sub-fields across 19 general domains over the period 1827–2024. In these graphs, edges denote the co-occurrence of two fields in a single publication and are timestamped with the corresponding publication year; nodes are enriched with semantic embeddings, and edges are characterized by temporal and topological descriptors. We formulate the prediction of new field-pair linkages as a temporal link-prediction task, distinguishing recurrent links from emerging (first-time) links, while explicitly treating first-time co-occurrence as a proxy for interdisciplinary novelty. On a tractable, representative multi-domain evaluation subset of FOS, we benchmark eight temporal graph neural network architectures alongside simple, interpretable baselines under three negative-sampling regimes, and we report performance separately for recurrent and emerging links. Our experiments show that (i) embedding long-form textual descriptions of fields improves prediction accuracy beyond structural signals alone, (ii) distinct model classes exhibit complementary strengths across evaluation regimes, and (iii) predicting emerging links is markedly harder than predicting recurrent links for every model, underscoring the difficulty of forecasting genuine novelty. Illustrative case analyses suggest that a subset of high-confidence predictions correspond to field pairings that subsequently appear in 2025 publications and we present these as qualitative examples. We publicly release the full FOS taxonomy graph, the evaluation subsets, temporal data splits, and evaluation code to establish a reproducible benchmark and a challenging testbed for temporal graph learning on sparse, long-horizon scientific networks.
thinking: 论文基于OpenAlex知识图谱构建了大规模时序图数据集FOS，并系统评估了多种时序图神经网络在跨学科链接预测任务上的表现，方法严谨且数据公开。研究聚焦于预测新兴跨学科链接，具有显著的前沿性和理论价值，但作为基准数据集研究，其直接业务落地性相对有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究构建了一个大规模的科学领域时序图数据集，用于预测未来可能出现的跨学科研究连接。

title: Mutualism in socio-semantic networks: structural correlates of publication output across ecosystem approaches to health
abstract: While existing scientometric research has examined how individual network position and team composition affect citation-based performance, less is known about how the structural configuration of socio-semantic networks relates to collective publication output. We propose that publication output is associated with configurations that foster mutual visibility between research topics (memes) and author communities. Drawing on mutualistic network theory from ecology, we hypothesise that lower bipartite modularity (H1) and higher nestedness (H2) are associated with higher publication output. We analyse 6,406 publications across three ecosystem approaches to health (EcoHealth, One Health, Planetary Health) over 18 approach × period observations (2004–2023), linking author communities to 20 research topics identified by Latent Dirichlet Allocation. Our analyses show an empirical asymmetry: bipartite modularity is negatively and robustly associated with publication output (Spearman ρ = −0.79, p < 0.001; robust across four community detection algorithms and under leave-one-out by approach), whereas weighted nestedness shows a positive but non-significant association (ρ = +0.39, p = 0.11), in a direction consistent with H2 but without statistical support at the cell level. The modularity result supports the H1 component of the framework: low modularity — author communities touching multiple topics — fosters mutual visibility between authors and themes. Given the observational design, we report these as field-level patterns, not causal mechanisms. The non-significant association for H2, combined with marked algorithmic variability, invites reconsidering how nestedness is operationalised in socio-semantic contexts. By integrating social and semantic dimensions within a mutualistic framework, this approach complements existing scientometric tools.
thinking: 论文将生态学中的互利网络理论引入科学计量学，采用LDA主题建模和多种社区检测算法，方法具有跨学科前沿性。研究通过分析6406篇文献，稳健地验证了模块化与产出的负相关关系，但嵌套性假设未获统计支持，表明理论操作化存在挑战。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，在健康研究领域，作者社群与主题间联系越广泛（模块化越低），整体论文产出越高。

title: Are explicit novelty claims in research abstracts associated with higher ChatGPT scores?
abstract:
arXiv:2610.26947v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT can estimate research quality from article titles and abstracts, and decision makers may increasingly use LLM scores to support research assessment. In this context, it is a concern that LLM scores may be influenced by linguistic signals rather than the quality of the research described. This study investigates whether explicit novelty claims in research abstracts are associated with higher ChatGPT scores. Using 99,245 journal articles submitted to the UK Research Excellence Framework (REF) 2021, ChatGPT scores and percentile rank gains relative to REF departmental average scores (as a proxy for article-level scores) were compared between abstracts with and without any of 282 three-word phrases identified as indicating a novelty claim. Abstracts containing novelty claim phrases had higher mean ChatGPT quality scores in all four main REF research groupings (panels). Moreover, the score difference was higher for the originality dimension of research quality than for significance and rigour in 30 of the 34 broadly field-based Units of Assessment (UoAs) used to categorise research in the REF. Thus, explicit novelty claims probably associate with higher quality scores primarily because they associate with higher scores for the originality dimension. Follow-up tests suggested that abstracts containing novelty claims tended to rank more favourably under ChatGPT than under the REF departmental quality proxy. Whilst the findings suggest that ChatGPT may be influenced by explicit novelty claims, they do not conclusively show that novelty phrases caused the higher scores because the scores and phrases may at least partially reflect more novel research.
thinking: 该论文采用大规模样本（99,245篇REF提交文章）和严谨的对照方法，探究了ChatGPT评分与摘要中显式新颖性表述的关联性，方法学上较为扎实。其发现对依赖LLM进行科研评估的潜在风险提出了重要警示，具有直接的政策和实践参考价值。然而，研究主要基于相关性分析，未深入采用更前沿的因果推断或模型解释技术，在技术前沿性上略有不足。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，研究摘要中明确宣称新颖性的表述与ChatGPT给出的更高评分（尤其是原创性维度）显著相关，提示大语言模型用于科研评估时可能受语言信号干扰。

title: Large Teams Consistently Develop Science
abstract:
arXiv:2610.27649v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Scientific progress depends on both developing established knowledge and disrupting it to make way for new ideas. Using the disruption index (D), our previous work showed that large teams tend to develop science, while small teams are more likely to disrupt it. Recent work challenges this finding, arguing that D mechanically depends on reference-list length. Using an alternative measure (oneD), it reaches the opposite conclusion: large teams are more disruptive. Combining Nobel Prize case studies, mathematical analysis, and large-scale publication data, we show that oneD misclassifies developmental contributions as disruptive and introduces the very sensitivity to reference-list length that it seeks to eliminate. The original measure, D, however, shows no evidence of the claimed systematic dependence on reference-list length. More fundamentally, even after controlling for reference-list length, larger teams remain more likely to produce strongly developmental work. Our findings reaffirm that large teams consistently develop science and offer new insights into the measurement of scientific disruption.
thinking: 论文通过数学分析、案例研究和大规模数据验证，对科学颠覆性测量方法进行了严谨的辨析，方法学扎实。其核心结论对理解科研团队规模与创新模式的关系具有重要理论价值，但作为一项基础性计量研究，其直接指导图书馆或信息机构具体业务实践的路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 本研究通过方法学辨析和大规模数据验证，重申了大规模科研团队更倾向于发展现有科学，而非颠覆它的结论。

title: InsightRAG: Aggregating Distributed Scholarly Judgments for Scientific Survey Generation
abstract:
arXiv:2610.28085v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: The rapid growth of scientific literature makes survey writing increasingly challenging, motivating automatic survey generation. Yet, existing systems must search an open space of papers and an open space of concepts with no trace of how the community itself has navigated them, leading to incomplete scope, weak taxonomies, and unreliable citations. Our core insight is that author-written Related Work sections contain the human judgments needed to address both limitations: authors curate the citations relevant to their contributions and explain how the cited works relate, yielding paths for scope reconstruction and relational evidence for organization. We propose InsightRAG. Its insight-guided retrieval follows author-supported citation relations to reconstruct a verified research scope and structure the resulting relational evidence. It aggregates these judgments under a minimum-conflict objective into a taxonomy that reflects recurring author-written perspectives in the retrieved literature, guides generation, and bounds each section's evidence. Results on ten topics show gains in scope reconstruction, taxonomy quality, citation support, and reference reliability.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于作者撰写的相关研究章节进行聚合的自动综述生成方法，通过追踪和整合学术社区已有的引用关系与判断来构建更可靠的综述范围与分类体系。其方法创新性地利用了现有文献中的结构化知识，提升了生成综述的可靠性和组织性，但在前沿技术应用上主要依赖现有RAG框架，且实验规模（十个主题）相对有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究通过聚合论文“相关工作”章节中的作者判断，为自动生成科学综述提供了更可靠的范围界定和分类体系。

title: MOSS: A Production Framework for Monitoring and Diagnosing Semantic Failures in Search and Recommendation Systems
abstract:
arXiv:2610.26902v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Detecting semantic failures in production recommendation and search systems is hard: behavioral metrics lag by days, manual review does not scale, and most LLM evaluation frameworks are designed for offline, fixed datasets rather than continuous operational monitoring. We present Model Sanity Service (MOSS), a production framework that addresses this operational gap by embedding LLM-based relevance scoring into a recurring monitoring loop with targeted sampling, strategy-aware prompting, structured alerting, and diagnostic follow-up prompting that categorizes failures into actionable root causes.
  MOSS has been running in production at a large U.S. retailer for over six months across recommendation, search, and offer surfaces, and has surfaced two confirmed serving defects. For one of these, a backfill blending defect, MOSS quantified the impact of the proposed fix offline as a 76.4\% relative reduction in alert rate. On a 498-pair human-annotated recommendation benchmark, frontier LLM judges achieve higher F1 and AUC point estimates than non-LLM baselines (internal production embeddings and SBERT), with the largest gains on strategy-dependent tasks requiring intent-level relational reasoning. The same judge, score scale, and threshold transfer to a 466-pair search benchmark spanning 21 queries with only a surface-specific prompt adaptation, achieving strong F1 and AUC without retuning. These results show that a single LLM monitoring framework can provide useful, actionable quality signals across multiple product discovery surfaces in a large-scale e-commerce setting.
thinking: 论文提出了一个基于大语言模型的语义故障监测框架MOSS，并在大型电商生产环境中验证了其有效性，技术前沿性突出。框架具备明确的业务落地价值，通过结构化告警和根因诊断直接支持系统运维决策。研究方法严谨，结合了生产环境部署、人工标注基准测试和跨场景验证，但样本规模相对有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一个基于大语言模型的框架，用于在线监测和诊断搜索与推荐系统中的语义故障，并在电商场景中验证了其有效性。

title: GRaSP: Latency-Aware Optimization for Geo-Distributed Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract:
arXiv:2610.26938v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is increasingly served across geo-distributed cloud and edge infrastructures, where wide-area latency, cross-region egress cost, and data-residency rules compete with retrieval quality. Conventional pipelines rank by semantic similarity alone and ignore where content lives, inflating tail latency and cost. We formalize the Geo-RAG Selection Problem (GRaSP), a drop-in re-scoring layer that decays relevance by latency and adds an optional cost penalty under a cardinality budget and per-region caps, with no retraining. We first settle its complexity: the base formulation is a linear objective over a partition matroid, solved optimally by an O(N log N) greedy algorithm, rather than NP-hard as a knapsack framing suggests, with hardness entering only under an additive egress budget. On a five-node CloudLab testbed emulating a four-region WAN over the Natural Questions corpus (2.68M passages), GRaSP's benefit is placement-dependent: under uniform placement it cuts fetch latency at negligible quality cost; under topical (residency-like) placement it traces a recall-latency Pareto frontier that dominates relevance-only, nearest-k, and a latency-budgeted baseline. At a moderate latency setting, GRaSP lowers P90 fetch latency by 41% while retaining 78% of relevance-only's recall, with sub-millisecond selection overhead, stable to 200 queries/s. Findings generalize across four public BEIR benchmarks. In end-to-end question answering, GRaSP reduces context-fetch latency by 43% while remaining within 0.062 absolute EM of relevance-only retrieval.
thinking: 该论文针对检索增强生成在跨地域部署时的延迟和成本问题，提出了一个形式化的优化框架和高效的贪心算法，具有明确的技术创新性。其方法在模拟实验中验证了有效性，但作为预印本，其实际部署效果和在不同业务场景下的普适性仍需进一步检验。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种考虑地理延迟的检索增强生成优化方法，能在保证检索质量的同时显著降低跨区域数据获取的延迟。

title: UIBK-Embedding: Effective Text Retrieval by Unifying Dense and Late-Interaction Retrieval
abstract:
arXiv:2610.27195v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Dense bi-encoders and late-interaction retrievers are usually treated as alternatives, yet they fail on different queries: one vector captures what a text is about, token-level matching finds its exact entities and phrases. Using both today means two models, two indexes and a score-fusion step. We present UIBK-Embedding-v1, a 179M-parameter English encoder that produces both representations in one pass and scores them with one unmodified MaxSim. The dense embedding is written into the list of token vectors as three extra vectors, and a one-dimensional tag keeps the two kinds of vectors from matching each other, so that plain MaxSim equals the token-level MaxSim plus a weighted dense cosine. The model therefore runs in a standard late-interaction index without changes; we test it with PLAID. A shared 18-layer trunk with a separate 4-layer top per head, and a cross-encoder distilled into the fused score, turn the two heads into one retriever. On BEIR, UIBK-Embedding-v1 reaches 59.79 nDCG@10. This is 2.57 points above LateOn, the strongest model of its size, and 2.10 points above it when both models read documents of the same length; UIBK-Embedding-v1 is ahead on all 15 datasets. On a decontaminated version of BEIR it stays ahead on average (61.55 against 60.36) and on 8 of 12 datasets. Among the 156 models with complete BEIR results in the MTEB results repository, only models with at least 1.5B parameters score higher. Code, model weights, and a technical blog post are available at https://github.com/DataScienceUIBK/uibk-embedding , https://huggingface.co/DataScience-UIBK/uibk-embedding-v1 , and https://huggingface.co/blog/abdoelsayed/uibk-embedding-v1 .
thinking: 该论文提出了一种创新的文本检索方法，通过统一稠密检索和延迟交互检索的表示与评分机制，有效提升了检索性能。其方法设计巧妙，在标准BEIR基准测试上取得了优于同类规模模型的成绩，具有较高的技术前沿性和方法严谨性，但其应用场景目前主要集中于信息检索研究领域，直接面向图书馆等机构的业务落地路径尚需进一步探索。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种能同时生成稠密向量和词元向量的统一编码器，在单一模型中融合了两种主流检索方法的优势，显著提升了文本检索效果。

title: Neighborhood-Aware Unlearning for Generative Recommendation
abstract:
arXiv:2610.27232v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Generative recommendation predicts items by autoregressively generating semantic identifiers (SIDs), whose tokens are shared across semantically related items. With this paradigm gaining adoption, the question of how to support unlearning in it has become pressing. If training interactions must later be removed, such as injected spam or interactions with items a user no longer wants, this sharing lets an unlearning update unintentionally affect the predictions for the interactions' neighbors. We show that this effect is locally structured and hidden by global metrics: unlearning can leave recommendation utility on the whole test set nearly unchanged while substantially degrading it on neighborhoods of the forgotten interactions' SIDs. We propose Neighborhood-Aware Unlearning (NAU), which augments interaction-level unlearning with explicit control over the probability mass assigned to the forgotten items' neighborhoods. Across three datasets and four SID tokenizers, NAU restores spam-induced exposure toward the retrained reference while retaining more than 95% of retrained utility, and recovers the neighborhood utility that forget-and-repair unlearning loses at no global cost. We identify local probability redistribution as an important failure mode of unlearning in SID-based generative recommenders and show that explicitly controlling this redistribution can mitigate its effects.
thinking: 该论文针对生成式推荐中的遗忘学习问题，提出了创新的邻域感知遗忘方法，技术前沿性突出。其方法设计严谨，通过多数据集和分词器验证了有效性，但作为算法研究，其直接业务落地价值尚需具体应用场景验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种邻域感知遗忘学习方法，有效解决了生成式推荐系统中因遗忘特定数据而损害相关项目推荐质量的问题。

title: FLINT: Fixed-budget Late Interaction
abstract:
arXiv:2610.27273v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Multi-vector retrieval models such as ColBERT often outperform single-vector models of comparable scale by matching queries and documents at the token level. However, retaining a vector for every token substantially increases storage requirements and slows retrieval compared to single-vector bi-encoders, limiting their scalability. We introduce FLINT (Fixed-budget Late INTeraction), an architecture that uses attention-based pooling to represent each query and document with a fixed number of embedding vectors. Unlike architectures that pool only document representations while retaining token-level queries, FLINT applies pooling symmetrically to both sides, limiting document storage and the number of vector comparisons needed during retrieval. FLINT achieves comparable ranking effectiveness to the closest baselines on BEIR and outperforms them on several benchmarks with longer and more complex queries, including BrowseComp+, CRUMB, and TREC Tip-of-the-Tongue 2025. We demonstrate that FLINT's effectiveness-efficiency benefits extend across encoder architectures, testing it on two separate backbones (BERT and ModernBERT). On long-query corpora, FLINT delivers 1.5-2.8 times faster end-to-end retrieval than ConstBERT, the closest baseline. FLINT also reduces index size by 5.3-9.3 times relative to token-level late-interaction models such as ColBERTv2.
thinking: 论文提出了一种固定预算的交互式检索架构FLINT，通过注意力池化技术对称处理查询和文档，在保持检索效果的同时显著提升了效率。该方法在多个长查询数据集上验证了其有效性，但作为预印本尚未经过同行评议，且实验主要基于公开基准，实际业务场景的适用性有待进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: FLINT模型通过固定向量预算的对称池化方法，在保证检索精度的同时，大幅提升了多向量检索系统的速度和存储效率。

title: Conversational AI for Perceived Cognitive Decline Screening in Older Adults
abstract:
arXiv:2610.27344v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Early detection of cognitive decline in older adults remains challenging due to the resource demands of standard neuropsychological assessments. Chatbot-based Intelligent Cognitive Assistants (ICAs) provide a scalable alternative by eliciting open-ended responses rich in linguistic, semantic, and autobiographical cues. This study evaluates whether ICA question-answer (Q/A) interviews with older adults can screen for participant-reported perceived cognitive decline and related cognitive, functional, and personality outcomes. We compare traditional machine learning, frozen transformer embeddings, fine-tuned transformers, and large language model (LLM) reasoning strategies across Global Q/A, Single Q/A confidence averaging, and Aggregated Q/A pipelines. Among text-based methods, Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite (1-example-per-class, Aggregated Q/A) achieved the highest held-out test performance (0.742 accuracy, 0.739 balanced accuracy, 0.728 macro-F1). Given the small test set (n = 31), these results are interpreted descriptively. Frozen clinical transformer embeddings with a random forest head led non-LLM text methods, whereas fine-tuned models showed limited generalization. Models utilizing structured questionnaires, cognitive tasks, and personality traits outperformed text-based models in classification. Continuous regression analyses revealed modest predictive signals for AD8, FAQ, IQCODE, neuroticism, and conscientiousness. Exploratory prompt-level analyses identified both direct symptom-related and indirect autobiographical questions with strong test metrics, though sample sizes varied across prompts. These findings indicate that ICA chatbot interviews capture meaningful signals of perceived cognitive decline, supporting scalable screening research. Larger, clinically diverse cohorts with validated clinical outcomes are needed for clinical translation.
thinking: 该论文将对话式AI应用于老年人认知衰退筛查，采用了前沿的LLM（如Gemini）和多种机器学习策略，技术前沿性突出。研究设计严谨，对比了多种模型与数据管道，但测试集样本量（n=31）过小，限制了结论的统计效力与临床落地价值。
one_sentence_summary: 研究表明，基于对话式AI的智能助手能够从老年人的开放式回答中捕捉到感知认知衰退的信号，为大规模筛查提供了新方法。

title: Baseline and Incremental: User, Item, and Request Debiasing in Instagram Feed Ranking
abstract:
arXiv:2610.27423v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: A feed ranker scores candidates with a value model, a weighted sum of engagement predictions. Each prediction conflates a baseline, what this viewer, item or request would produce anyway, with the incremental amount by which this candidate exceeds it. The literature mostly removes the baseline. We argue that a multi-signal value model should keep the raw prediction and add the incremental part as a separately weighted term. On Instagram Feed, three debiasing families deployed independently, for viewer habit, item popularity and request context, are one parameterised operator, and a design procedure picks a point in it. Media-type (format) bias goes instead to a debiased label chosen by the same procedure. In a controlled four-arm ablation of deployed Feed terms (neither term, each alone, both), the two-term arm beats both single-term arms at production weights on point estimates in 11 of 13 judged (term, metric) pairs. Of the 26 direct contrasts, 17 are significantly for it and only 1 against it, on impressions. The ablation also suggests that the offline diagnostic should screen signals, not rank them. Such terms have served Instagram Feed production for most of a year. Beyond Feed, Meta, whose apps serve billions of people, has adopted the operator across surfaces, apps and both ranking stages. Its launches there drive sessions and daily active users, the core visitation and retention metrics.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于Instagram信息流排序中的去偏技术，提出了融合原始预测与增量部分的双项模型，并在大规模生产环境中验证了其有效性。其优势在于方法具有明确的工程实践导向和可复现的A/B测试框架，但技术新颖性相对有限，属于对现有去偏方法的系统化工程实现。
one_sentence_summary: 论文提出并验证了一种在Instagram信息流排序中有效融合用户习惯、物品流行度和请求上下文等多种去偏信号的双项模型。

title: Robustness Analysis of Pareto-based Joint Evaluation of Fairness and Relevance in Recommender Systems
abstract:
arXiv:2610.27850v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Recommender Systems (RSs) can be evaluated for many aspects, two of them being recommendation relevance and fairness. These two aspects can be evaluated either in isolation, using a measure for each aspect; or jointly with a single`relevance-aware' fairness measure that quantifies fairness with respect to relevance. Yet, neither approach provides a simultaneous evaluation of both relevance and fairness: the first approach may result in two different rankings of models, each corresponding to an evaluation aspect; the second approach often provides an imbalanced evaluation of the two aspects. To address this gap, we propose Distance to Pareto Frontier (DPFR), a new approach to jointly evaluate RS fairness and relevance. DPFR is based on a Pareto frontier of relevance and fairness scores from existing measures. The frontier is generated from user-item interaction data and represents various Pareto-optimal trade-offs between the two aspects. Thus, the distance from a point in the frontier provides a joint score of fairness and relevance. As DPFR can be used with existing measures, it is modular and intuitive. Our experiments with 4 recommenders and 3 fairness-aware re-rankers on 6 real-world datasets reveal inconsistent associations between existing measures and DPFR, showing that they are not reliable proxies for evaluations based on Pareto optimality. We further examine the robustness of DPFR as a joint evaluation approach for fairness and relevance by conducting experiments with artificial recommendations and with various fairness-relevance trade-offs, as well as by analysing DPFR's agreement to simple measures of fairness and relevance. These analyses show that DPFR is more robust than existing joint evaluation approaches. Finally, we provide guidelines for evaluating fairness and relevance jointly with DPFR. Our code: https://github.com/theresiavr/robustness-DPFR-recsys-evaluation.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于帕累托前沿的推荐系统公平性与相关性联合评估方法，方法设计新颖且具有较好的理论严谨性，通过多数据集和多模型实验验证了其鲁棒性。然而，其技术核心仍基于传统推荐算法与公平性度量，未引入当前最前沿的大语言模型等技术，且其作为评估框架，距离直接部署到图书馆或信息机构的业务系统中尚有一定距离。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种基于帕累托前沿的新方法，用于更稳健地联合评估推荐系统的公平性和相关性。

title: SPAR: Stepwise Personalized Autoregressive Recommendation with Prefix-Balanced Semantic IDs
abstract:
arXiv:2610.27898v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Semantic ID (SID)-based generative recommendation retrieves items through successive token-level decisions, making personalization at each decoding step essential. However, existing methods insufficiently account for prefix-dependent user evidence and imbalanced historical interaction loads among candidate branches. This can cause irreversible branch-selection errors and favor popular paths. We propose SPAR, a generative recommendation framework that jointly improves stepwise personalization and SID construction. Its PATH Decoder retrieves prefix-relevant evidence from compressed long-term user memories and combines it with recent behavior, user profiles, and event context to guide each token decision. Its RQ-PIB module balances historical interaction loads among sibling branches under each parent prefix while preserving semantic structure. Experiments on large-scale Youku production data show an average relative HitRate improvement of 2.66% over the strongest baseline. SPAR also increases target-prefix retention by 5.79 percentage points and reduces the traffic-weighted largest child-branch share by 32.84% across SID levels. In a 7-day online A/B test, SPAR serves 10% of Youku's production traffic and improves average watch time per user by 3.95% and play conversion rate by 3.38%. These results demonstrate more reliable hierarchical decoding, balanced SID branches, and improved user engagement in industrial recommendation.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种结合前缀平衡语义ID的逐步个性化自回归推荐框架，在工业级数据集上验证了其在点击率和用户参与度上的提升，技术方法具有前沿性且实践价值显著。然而，论文未详细说明基线模型的具体构成和超参数设置，方法严谨性略有不足。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种新的生成式推荐框架，通过改进逐步个性化决策和平衡语义分支，有效提升了视频平台的推荐效果和用户观看时长。

title: AutoSim: A Self-Improving User Simulator for Conversational Search Evaluation
abstract:
arXiv:2610.28054v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: User simulators promise to evaluate conversational search systems at a scale human studies cannot reach, but only if their behavior is realistic enough to trust. We study AutoSim, a conversational-search user simulator whose relevance judgments rank a controlled pool of retrieval systems in agreement with NIST across three TREC iKAT years (Kendall's $\tau$ of $0.66$, $0.91$, and $0.91$; all $p{\le}0.002$), an agreement that survives removing its persona. AutoSim self-improves against a held-out signal from real users, and we find that fine-tuning its weights makes it behave like real users, which in turn gives a more accurate estimate of how well a system serves them. Reaching that behavior takes more than prompting: when discriminating between real and simulated user sessions, no prompt we tried lowers a held-out real-versus-simulated classifier below AUC $0.85$, whereas fine-tuning the weights drives it to $0.45$, where neither the classifier nor a human reading full dialogues can tell it from a real user. That added realism is what makes the evaluation more accurate: where real users retrieve little, a prompted simulator over-estimates retrieval effectiveness by $+0.136$ nDCG and returns a relevant passage on $57\%$ of the turns where real users find none, enough to change a deployment decision. Only the weight-level simulator escapes this bias. We release the framework and code.
thinking: 论文提出了一种自我改进的用户模拟器AutoSim，用于对话式检索系统的评估，通过微调权重显著提升了模拟行为的真实性，使其在统计指标上与真实用户难以区分。该方法在TREC iKAT数据集上验证了有效性，但技术前沿性受限于对话式检索这一特定领域，且实践应用仍需在更多实际场景中验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究开发了一种能自我改进的用户模拟器，可更真实地评估对话式检索系统，减少评估偏差。

title: Multimodal Reranking Is a System One Decision
abstract:
arXiv:2610.28435v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Multimodal rerankers are usually dedicated models: a vision-language model (VLM) is trained on retrieval data to score the candidates of a query. Scoring options is not specific to reranking. System One decision models such as Jev map a state and a typed question to one probability per option without generating text, and general models can make such decisions with little or no training. Reranking is one such decision, with the query and its candidates as the state and the candidates as the options. We therefore argue that a general VLM can serve as a multimodal reranker through System One decisions, and that decision tuning can improve its reranking. We ask a VLM one choice question over the top 16 candidates of a first-stage retriever and rank the candidates by the probabilities of their labels, read from one forward pass. On MMEB-V2 image retrieval, this choice scores 5.4 to 7.3 hit@1 above a yes/no question per candidate, and the yes/no question falls below the first stage. With the choice, zero-shot Qwen3.8-27B beats the supervised Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B on all three benchmarks and comes within 1.6 points of Reranker-8B on each. It matches Reranker-8B on MMEB-V2 visual documents (84.79 vs. 84.78 nDCG@5), at 1.1 to 1.5 times its latency. JEV-27B-VL, the same backbone tuned on text decisions only, improves page reranking by 0.6 to 1.1 points, with gains on most tasks (sign test, p <= 0.017), and leaves natural images unchanged. The zero-shot model is larger than the supervised rerankers and of a newer generation, so these comparisons are confounded; we discuss this and other alternative views, and the experiments that would test the position.
thinking: 论文提出将多模态重排序视为系统一决策任务，并验证通用视觉语言模型（VLM）通过零样本或决策微调即可实现有效的重排序，方法新颖且具有启发性。然而，其与专用重排序模型的对比存在模型规模和代际差异的混淆因素，且实验主要基于特定基准，方法严谨性有待在更广泛场景下验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究发现，通用视觉语言模型通过将其视为一种快速决策任务，可以在不专门训练的情况下，有效完成多模态检索结果的重排序。

title: ECHO: Efficient Cascade with Homogeneous Operators for Distillation-Guided 100K-Sequence Modeling
abstract:
arXiv:2610.28569v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Modeling lifetime user behavior sequences is essential for capturing long-range preferences in industrial recommendation, yet 100K-length user sequences make target-aware ranking prohibitively expensive. Search-based methods that retrieve from raw sequences incur candidate-dependent costs that grow with sequence length, whereas latent compression methods reduce computation at the expense of item-level addressability. We propose ECHO (Efficient Cascade with Homogeneous Operators), a framework that balances efficiency and fine-grained retrieval by retaining a subset of original event records per user via a Distilled Selector (DS) and retrieving a smaller set of target-relevant records per candidate via a Target-aware Fine-grained Retriever (TFR). DS is supervised by a candidate-aware full-history teacher via per-target distillation, enabling target-aware user-level selection without incurring full-history computation for every candidate. The retriever and target-attention scorer share the teacher's learned relevance parameters, ensuring consistent relevance estimation across the cascade. At a sequence length of L = 100K, ECHO reduces online sequence-branch FLOPs by approximately 160x compared with a representative end-to-end model. Three deployment optimizations, including common user inputs, compact record encoding, and key-side projection absorption, further reduce memory, storage, and data-movement overhead. Experiments on KuaiRand-1K and an industrial-scale short-video platform demonstrate relative GAUC improvements of 0.113%-1.520% over state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines across multiple tasks. Furthermore, online A/B testing shows a 0.613% improvement in app usage time.
thinking: 该论文针对工业级推荐系统中超长用户行为序列建模的计算瓶颈，提出了创新的级联检索框架ECHO，通过蒸馏选择器和目标感知细粒度检索器实现了效率与精度的平衡。其方法在公开数据集和工业平台上的实验验证了有效性，但作为arXiv预印本，其方法严谨性（如实验细节、可复现性）的全面评估需待同行评审确认。
one_sentence_summary: 论文提出一种高效级联检索框架，通过蒸馏技术大幅降低超长用户序列建模的计算成本，并在工业推荐场景中提升了推荐效果。

title: Expert-Guided Rubrics as Dense Reward Signals for Reinforcement Learning in Non-Verifiable Domains
abstract:
arXiv:2610.26932v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents in non-verifiable domains such as financial services, where they must interpret user intent, rewrite queries, and retrieve information under domain-specific constraints. Although reinforcement learning (RL) can train such agents from the consequences of their actions, recent successes largely rely on verifiable tasks with automatically computed binary rewards. In non-verifiable retrieval tasks, assessing query quality requires scarce subject-matter expert (SME) judgment that is inherently graded rather than binary. With Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), sparse rewards yield no useful learning signal when all sampled outputs within a group receive the same outcome, causing optimization to stall. We introduce a method that converts a small, fixed investment of SME judgment into a dense reward and combines it with retrieval-based metrics to form a hybrid, GRPO-compatible training signal. Experiments show improvements of up to 6\% in Recall@3 and 6.7\% in MRR@3 compared with sparse-reward baselines.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种在非可验证领域利用专家指导的评分标准作为强化学习密集奖励信号的方法，结合检索指标形成混合训练信号，在信息检索任务中取得了显著效果提升。其方法创新性较强，但应用场景较为特定，且实验设计虽严谨但样本量和领域泛化性可能有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种将少量专家评分转化为密集奖励信号的方法，有效提升了大型语言模型在金融等非可验证领域信息检索任务中的性能。

title: The Bottleneck Is Retrieval, Not Reading: Diagnosing Evidence-Based Generation with RAG for Long Context Question Answering
abstract:
arXiv:2610.26951v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is the dominant paradigm for grounding large language models in external corpora, but its similarity-driven, chunked pipeline has structural blind spots: it cannot anticipate which passages a question requires and discards document-level context that resolves cross-passage references. We introduce evidence-based generation (EBG), requiring models to return an answer with line-level citations, and a joint Ans+Evid metric that scores correctness and grounding simultaneously. We reformulate two corpora into evidence-grounded multi-document QA benchmarks- MultiHop-RAG and QASPER-MP, a multi-paper adaptation of QASPER with realistic short paper cues, and pair them with a controlled synthetic two-hop haystack and an evidence-augmented NoLiMa spanning 10K-1M characters. Across ten proprietary frontier and three open-weight LLMs, EBG isolates two RAG limitations that long-context models avoid: similarity retrieval surfaces any relevant chunk far more reliably than all required chunks for multi-fact queries, and chunking destroys document meta-information needed to resolve identity-bearing queries. EBG also exposes grounding failures invisible to answer-only evaluation, including incomplete citations in two-needle settings and a widening gap between Ans and Ans+Evid when context contradicts parametric knowledge. Data and code are available at https://github.com/debobanerjee/LC-EBG.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于检索增强生成（RAG）在长上下文问答中的局限性，并提出了基于证据的生成（EBG）新范式及配套评估指标，在诊断RAG的检索瓶颈方面具有方法创新性。研究构建了新的基准数据集，并进行了跨多个大语言模型的系统性实验验证，方法严谨。其发现对改进信息检索与生成系统的设计有直接指导意义，但作为一项诊断性研究，其提出的EBG范式本身在图书馆等具体业务场景中的直接落地路径尚需进一步探索。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究发现，在长文档问答中，RAG的主要瓶颈在于检索而非阅读，并提出了新的评估方法来诊断模型生成答案的证据支撑问题。

title: MultiCard: Multiple Attribute Cardinality Estimation via Deep Learning
abstract:
arXiv:2610.27019v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Cardinality estimation is essential for query optimization, but most existing learned estimators focus on a single predicate type, such as string LIKE clauses or numerical range filters. In practice, analytical workloads often combine both types, while the accuracy of string estimators tends to decrease with longer patterns. We introduce MultiCard, a comprehensive learned cardinality estimator that unifies LIKE predicates and numerical filters within a single end-to-end architecture. By combining a Transformer for long-range sparse patterns with an LSTM for short, frequent patterns, MultiCard achieves robust pattern modeling. In parallel, a numerical encoder integrates catalog histograms and structural predicate features, enabling the model to dynamically assess histogram estimation accuracy across different operators and data skew conditions. A final Transformer layer captures interactions among heterogeneous predicates before a multilayer perceptron predicts query cardinalities. We also introduce UPCI, a workload generator that produces length-balanced LIKE patterns, multi-column numerical predicates, and exact cardinality labels for training and evaluation. Experiments on five real-world datasets show that, for string-only workloads, MultiCard achieves the best or near-best Q-error across all datasets compared with state-of-the-art methods. For mixed multi-attribute queries, MultiCard reduces PostgreSQL's mean Q-error by up to 16 times while maintaining an inference latency below 5 ms.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于深度学习的多属性基数估计方法，结合Transformer和LSTM处理字符串与数值谓词，技术方案前沿且架构完整。其提出的UPCI工作负载生成器增强了方法验证的严谨性，但作为预印本，其在实际数据库系统中的部署细节和长期稳定性验证尚不充分。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一个统一的深度学习模型，能同时准确估计数据库查询中字符串匹配和数值范围过滤的基数，显著提升了查询优化性能。

title: Joint Constraint Aggregation for Qualifier-Sensitive Retrieval-Augmented QA
abstract:
arXiv:2610.27114v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Retrieval-augmented QA can fail even when the correct answer is in the retrieved evidence. This can happen when a competing answer satisfies some, but not all, of the question's requirements and is mentioned frequently in the retrieved documents, which can make it appear to be the best-supported answer. To test whether this retrieval skew actually affects the decision, we manipulate it directly: increasing the prevalence of passages that favor the competing answer makes the model more likely to select it. This points to a decision problem that candidate-level support alone cannot resolve. We therefore introduce Joint Constraint Aggregation (JCA), which compares candidates against the same question-derived requirements using the retrieved evidence. Across three evaluation settings and three instruction-tuned backbones, JCA improves overall accuracy, and its advantage grows when retrieval favors a competing answer. Together, these results suggest that when partial matches and retrieval prominence pull models toward a competing answer, comparing candidates against the question's full requirements can make selection more reliable.
thinking: 该论文针对检索增强问答中因证据偏斜导致的错误答案选择问题，提出了联合约束聚合方法，在方法创新和实验验证上具有较高严谨性。其研究直接针对当前大语言模型应用中的核心痛点，技术前沿性突出，但作为一项方法学研究，其直接业务落地价值尚需具体场景适配。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种新方法，通过比较候选答案是否同时满足问题的所有约束，来纠正因检索证据分布不均导致的大模型问答错误。

title: SweepANN: A GPU-Accelerated Large-K Approximate Vector Search for Drug Discovery
abstract:
arXiv:2610.27306v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: DrugCLIP places small molecules and protein pockets in one space, turning genome-wide drug discovery into large-K retrieval by vector proximity. A campaign fixes over 20K pockets in advance for one library of over 500M molecules. Each pocket keeps K = 500K candidates, 0.1% of the collection, versus 100 in ANN benchmarks. Missed hits never get tested, so mean recall must reach 99% relative to exact search. Large answers make IVF probe every list holding a result and graph search track K or more candidates, so costs grow with K. On our CPUs and GPUs, neither index family reaches the target without losing most of its edge over scanning.
  SweepANN partitions compressed vectors across GPUs and scans each resident partition. One matrix multiplication scores each block for a whole query batch, reading it once. Several plans perform the K-dependent selection and merging of each query's K answers, each returning an exact top-K under compressed scoring. The window plan retains each query's best K from sampled blocks as its seed, and only rows above each seed's minimum score, shared once across GPUs, enter the buffers.
  Four Blackwell GPUs (RTX PRO 6000) answer all 26,562 pockets with a resident time of about 61 seconds, excluding library loading, and 99.6% mean recall relative to exact FP32 search. DrugCLIP reports roughly 24 hours with eight A100 GPUs in its own campaign. On 500M rows, the window plan runs 1.41x faster than SweepANN's grouped plan in the same memory. Across 25M-500M rows and K of 10K-500K, all GPU IVF configurations meeting the recall target take 8.2-24x SweepANN's resident time. On DEEP1B's 1B vectors across eight GPUs, against SweepANN's exact full-score scan of uncompressed FP32 rows, the window plan cuts resident time by 5.4x and 3.2x at K = 100K and 500K. It also cuts per-GPU peak memory by 6.0x and 5.3x, losing 1.0 and 0.7 mean-recall points.
thinking: 论文提出了一种名为SweepANN的GPU加速大K近似向量搜索方法，针对药物发现场景中的大规模向量检索问题，技术方案新颖且性能提升显著，具有明确的应用价值。然而，作为预印本，其方法细节和实验验证的完备性有待同行评议进一步确认，且其应用场景目前较为专一。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种高效的GPU加速向量搜索算法，能大幅提升药物发现中大规模分子库检索的速度和准确性。

title: Factual Access States in Diffusion Language Models: From Mechanism to Knowledge Editing and Retrieval
abstract:
arXiv:2610.27580v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Factual recall is a lookup: some representation inside the network serves as the key, and what that key is made of decides which queries can retrieve the fact, what an edit must cover, and what a retriever can read. We call it the factual access state. In autoregressive (AR) models the subject position enriches attributes largely independently of the relation, and relation-specific selection happens later, at the readout position. In masked diffusion language models (DLMs) we find the state is assembled differently, and much earlier: in the first attention layer the wording of the relation is routed into the position of whichever entity is visible and the early feed-forward layers look the fact up on this fused representation. The state therefore varies with the relation's surface form and with the query direction, so the queries about one fact occupy a region of state space rather than a point, and an operation on the fact succeeds only for queries that enter it. We treat the state as an interface to a DLM's factual knowledge, and put it to two uses. Writing to the state gives a knowledge editor: from one declarative statement, Multi-View Edit fits one shared value per direction across that region and installs it in the early-MLP block, preserving source-prompt reliability while substantially improving paraphrase and reverse question answering, where AR editors gain near zero. Reading it suggests a complementary use: the state at each entity position can serve as a relation-specific retrieval vector with no training, returning both pieces of evidence for two-entity queries on which pooled, prompted and lexical retrievers almost never return both.
thinking: 该论文深入探讨了扩散语言模型中的事实访问状态机制，提出了基于该机制的知识编辑与检索方法，在技术前沿性和方法严谨性上表现突出。然而，论文主要聚焦于模型内部机制的理论验证与实验，其具体在图书馆、信息机构等实际业务场景中的落地路径和应用价值尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究发现扩散语言模型通过早期融合实体与关系信息形成事实访问状态，并基于此提出了无需训练的知识编辑与检索新方法。

title: GARRET: Generative Feedback for Region Retrieval in Visual Documents
abstract:
arXiv:2610.27829v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Multimodal retrieval-augmented generation over visually rich documents requires evidence at a finer granularity than entire pages. Existing visual retrievers typically index or return full pages, whereas training region-level retrievers often requires costly query-to-region annotations or noisy model-generated labels. We introduce GARRET, a region-retrieval framework trained from (page, question, answer) triplets through differentiable generative feedback. A shared context-preserving retriever produces page and region multi-vector representations. During training, their retrieval scores define a soft routing distribution over candidate region crops.
