An auxiliary vision-language model attends to each crop separately, aggregates crop-specific contexts using the routing weights, and predicts the question followed by the answer under a next-token prediction objective. Gradients through the routing distribution assign query-conditioned credit to the indexed region representations, without requiring query-to-region annotations. At inference, the auxiliary model is removed. GARRET also reuses the contextualized region representations, together with page summary tokens, to construct a compact page representation. We introduce ViDoRe-V3-Region, a corpus-wide benchmark containing 200,682 fixed candidate regions across eight domains. GARRET achieves a macro nDCG@10 of 0.4126, outperforming the strongest visual baseline by 2.94 points. On page retrieval, it remains comparable to ColQwen2.5-v0.2 while indexing 47.8% fewer vectors per page.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于生成反馈的区域检索框架GARRET，通过可微分的生成反馈机制，在无需区域级标注的情况下训练细粒度视觉文档检索模型，方法具有创新性。研究引入了新的基准数据集并进行了充分的实验验证，但作为预印本论文，其实际在图书馆或信息机构中的应用场景和部署成本尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种无需精细标注即可训练视觉文档区域检索模型的新方法，并在多个领域的数据集上取得了优于基线模型的效果。

title: DeclineCraft: A RAG Abstention Benchmark for Jointly Measuring Combined Retrieval and Parametric Knowledge
abstract:
arXiv:2610.28340v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Reliable retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) requires recognizing when neither retrieved documents nor parametric knowledge supports an answer. We introduce DeclineCraft, a dynamic abstention benchmark whose unanswerable questions target Minecraft feature additions after a corpus cut-off, with audits of possible parametric exposure. Later cut-offs support evaluation of future models. Across 27 LLMs, we measure Correct Abstention Rate (CAR; how often models acknowledge insufficient knowledge on unanswerable questions), Answerable Attempt Rate and Answer Accuracy. We find that (1) single-shot retrieval significantly raises CAR in 38 of 40 configurations (model and thinking setting) versus no retrieval. (2) Iterative RAG, in which the model self-assesses its context and can request up to two further retrieval rounds, significantly lowers CAR versus single-shot RAG in 30 of 40 configurations (mean 46.4%), with little change in Answer Accuracy (68.5% to 69.3%). Adding query rewriting and reranking to hybrid (dense & sparse) retrieval lowers CAR for all 12 models tested. (3) Larger models answer more accurately (Spearman $\rho = +0.60$ with total parameters), but neither model size nor release date shows a significant association with CAR. (4) Without retrieval, enabling thinking on the same weights lowers CAR significantly for 8 of 13 models (by 14% points on average), and the responses shift from acknowledged uncertainty to premise denial.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于RAG系统在无法回答问题时的可靠弃权能力评估，提出了一个动态基准并进行了广泛的模型测试，方法设计严谨且具有前瞻性。然而，其实践价值主要在于为未来模型评估提供基准，对当前图书馆和信息机构的直接应用价值有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究构建了一个评估RAG系统在知识不足时能否可靠“拒绝回答”的基准，发现单次检索能显著提升弃权率，但迭代检索反而可能降低可靠性。

title: Evolving Semantic Indexes for Generative Retrieval
abstract:
arXiv:2610.28568v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Generative retrieval (GR) casts search and recommendation as autoregressive generation of discrete semantic identifiers (SIDs). SID design largely determines GR quality, but its discrete, interdependent components (SID construction, collision handling, decoding, and training) cannot be optimized end-to-end with gradients and remain largely hand-designed. We introduce a framework that improves these components through LLM-driven evolutionary program search, to our knowledge the first application of this approach to GR. A locally served, open-weight 31B model mutates executable GR components, so no proprietary LLM API is used, and a 1M-parameter proxy decoder provides fast feedback in place of repeatedly training the 1B target generator. Across 21 SID programs on NQ320K, proxy and target Recall@100 show strong rank correlation (Spearman $\rho = 0.90$). Guided by this proxy, evolution improves the seed GR on NQ320K, MSMARCO300K, and a multilingual e-commerce dataset under a fixed training recipe. On NQ320K, jointly evolving SID construction and collision handling improves Recall@1 from 55.8% to 59.3% and Recall@100 from 85.8% to 90.6%. A component study shows that proxy reliability depends on what is evolved: improvements transfer reliably for the semantic index but not for the generator's training objective or the full pipeline. LLM-driven evolutionary search is thus a practical tool for GR design, provided proxy reliability is established for the chosen search space.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种利用大语言模型驱动的进化程序搜索来优化生成式检索中语义索引设计的新方法，在方法上具有显著的前沿性，并设计了轻量级代理解码器来提升优化效率，体现了较强的技术创新。研究在多个数据集上验证了方法的有效性，但作为一项偏重算法改进的研究，其直接面向图书馆或信息机构业务场景的落地路径尚不明确，实践应用价值有待进一步挖掘。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究利用大语言模型驱动的进化搜索方法，自动优化生成式检索中的语义索引设计，显著提升了检索效果。

title: KuaFu: Compressing Long User Behavior into Understanding at Billion Scale
abstract:
arXiv:2609.31045v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Learning user preferences from long behavioral sequences is fundamental to large-scale advertising, recommender systems, and conversational agents. In industrial systems, preference modeling is typically task-wise, with different downstream tasks independently processing the same user history to capture different aspects of preference. This repeated processing creates substantial redundancy at billion-user scale, especially as preferences evolve and representations require frequent updates. We present KuaFu, a unified user preference modeling system that replaces repeated user-level sequence encoding with reusable item-level compressed representations. Each behavioral item is encoded once and shared across users and downstream tasks, while a user's history is built chronologically and extended with new item representations as they arrive, letting KuaFu capture evolving preferences without re-encoding the entire history. To reduce inference and storage overhead, KuaFu introduces a two-axis projector: token-axis compression shortens behavior sequences by up to 15x and reduces each item from 150 KB to 10 KB, while width-axis compression reduces the cached representation to 0.5 KB. We further develop a four-stage training pipeline consisting of reconstruction pre-training, preference-understanding post-training, joint compression-generation training, and hallucination-aware reinforcement learning, progressively improving representation fidelity and downstream utility. Across six MRQA and five RecBench benchmarks, KuaFu consistently outperforms existing compression methods at comparable ratios, with gains of up to 17.7 EM and 1.90 AUC points respectively. KuaFu has been deployed and evaluated on the Tencent advertising and recommendation platform for ten months. Over this period, it improves per-GPU throughput by up to 350%, saves 190 GPUs, and increases overall GMV by 1.37%.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种名为KuaFu的统一用户偏好建模系统，通过创新的两级投影器压缩长序列用户行为，并在大规模工业场景中验证了其性能与效率。其优势在于方法严谨，设计了四阶段训练流程并在多个基准测试与真实部署中验证，业务落地价值极高；不足在于其核心技术思想（如压缩表示）虽工程实现出色，但并非全新的基础理论突破。
one_sentence_summary: KuaFu系统通过压缩和复用用户行为表示，在十亿级规模的推荐与广告场景中显著提升了系统效率与业务指标。

title: WeGR: Towards Unified Generative Retrieval via Behavior-aware Tokenization and Preference Alignment
abstract:
arXiv:2610.16979v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Generative retrieval (GR) offers a promising paradigm for industrial search by unifying candidate generation within an autoregressive framework. However, effectively leveraging user behaviors in industrial GR remains challenging: existing SID tokenization methods struggle to preserve collaborative signals while maintaining balanced codebook utilization, whereas reinforcement learning (RL) for prioritizing high-value candidates suffers from sparse rewards when generated SIDs fail to match positive items. To address these challenges, we propose WeGR, a unified GR framework with two complementary components. Specifically, the Collaborative and Collapse-free Tokenizer (CoCo-VAE) injects query-to-item and item-to-item collaborative signals into continuous representations before quantization, preserving behavioral information without disrupting codebook optimization. It further couples first-layer codebook refresh to reactivate underutilized codewords with fidelity anti-collapse regularization, which broadens gradient coverage over relevant codewords and penalizes collisions in deeper layers to yield behavior-aware SIDs with balanced utilization. For preference alignment, Dynamic Horizon Policy Optimization (DHPO) progressively expands reward evaluation and policy optimization horizons to alleviate reward sparsity, enabling coarse-to-fine preference learning from SID prefixes to complete items without auxiliary reward models. Extensive offline experiments validate that WeGR improves retrieval and ranking performance. Moreover, a six-week online A/B test on a large-scale e-commerce search platform achieves relative gains of 2.539% in orders, 1.508% in CTR, and 1.381% in CVR, while reducing CPU and GPU usage by 25.5% and 26.1%. These results highlight the effectiveness and efficiency of WeGR in industrial deployment, supporting multiple search scenarios and tens of millions of daily page views.
thinking: 论文提出了一种结合协同信号注入和动态策略优化的生成式检索框架，在工业级电商搜索场景中验证了其检索性能和资源效率的提升。方法设计具有创新性，并通过大规模在线A/B测试证明了实用价值，但作为预印本论文，其方法细节和长期稳定性仍需同行评议进一步检验。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种新的生成式检索框架，通过改进的编码方法和训练策略，在电商搜索中显著提升了订单量和点击率，同时降低了计算资源消耗。

title: From Crawled to Published: A Publisher-Controlled Web Architecture for an AI-Native Internet
abstract:
arXiv:2511.18354v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: AI agents, not humans, are becoming the web's primary consumers, yet the web still ships content structured for human browsing, with no native way for publishers to expose the semantic units within it. Access is therefore mediated by a handful of AI providers that crawl, chunk, and index content unilaterally, leaving publishers little control over how their content is represented, retrieved, or attributed. We argue this is a structural problem, not one better chunking or retrieval algorithms can solve. The web lacks a native layer for publisher-controlled semantic discovery and retrieval. We propose AISTRAL, an AI-Native Internet architecture that supplies this layer. Publishers expose semantically meaningful units (e.g., passages, claims, tables) through explicit, policy-governed interfaces they control, and a web-native semantic resolver, analogous to DNS but operating over meaning rather than location, lets agents discover relevant sources before retrieving fine-grained content directly from publishers. Our end-to-end prototype matches or exceeds representative centralized retrieval pipelines in answer quality, with up to 4.2x higher accuracy on large, specialized document collections. Against a public web-search agent, it answers up to 4.2x more questions correctly, while moving 2.9-41x less data per query. Because retrieval terminates at publisher-operated servers, attribution, provenance, and usage policies travel with the content, realigning incentives across the web ecosystem.
thinking: 该论文针对AI成为网络主要消费者而内容仍为人类浏览设计的结构性矛盾，提出了AISTRAL这一AI原生互联网架构，通过引入类似DNS的语义解析层和出版商控制的语义接口，在技术上具有显著前沿性。其原型系统在答案质量和数据效率上表现优异，但作为架构性提案，其业务落地依赖于广泛的行业采纳和标准制定，短期内实践价值受限。
one_sentence_summary: 论文提出了一种让出版商直接控制内容语义单元、供AI智能体检索的新型网络架构，旨在解决当前AI抓取网络内容时的控制权与归属问题。

title: Deep learning enables urban change profiling through alignment of historical maps
abstract:
arXiv:2602.02154v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Prior to modern Earth observation technologies, historical maps provide a unique record of long-term urban transformation and offer a lens on the evolving identity of cities. However, extracting consistent and fine-grained change information from historical map series remains challenging due to spatial misalignment, cartographic variation, and degrading document quality, limiting most analyses to small-scale or qualitative approaches. We propose a deep-learning-based framework for fine-grained urban change analysis from large collections of historical maps, built on a modular design that integrates spatial map alignment, multi-temporal object extraction, and change estimation. This framework shifts the analysis of historical maps from ad hoc visual comparison toward systematic, quantitative characterization of urban change. Experiments demonstrate the robust performance of the proposed alignment and object extraction methods. Applied to Paris between 1868 and 1937, the framework reveals the spatial and temporal heterogeneity in urban transformation, suggesting its potential relevance for research in the social sciences and humanities. The modular design of our framework provides flexibility for future adaptation to different cartographic contexts and downstream applications.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于深度学习的框架，用于从历史地图中提取细粒度的城市变化信息，技术方法具有前沿性，特别是在空间对齐和多时序对象提取方面。其模块化设计增强了方法的严谨性和可复现性，但作为一项技术验证研究，其直接在图情业务中的落地应用场景尚不明确，实践价值更多体现在为历史地理或数字人文研究提供工具支持。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究利用深度学习框架，实现了对历史地图的自动对齐与对象提取，从而系统量化了城市的长时段变迁过程。

title: Simpler Logarithmic Approximation Algorithms for the Optimal Decision Tree and Adaptive Set Cover
abstract:
arXiv:2604.12036v4 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: We study the problem of constructing a decision tree that identifies an unknown hypothesis from a given ground set, under both average- and worst-case cost. The Optimal Decision Tree (ODT) problem has been extensively studied in the literature, and $\mathcal{O}(\log n)$-approximation guarantees are known for each criterion, including a simultaneous guarantee for both (here $n$ is the number of hypotheses) [ICML]. Although most of the existing algorithm use simple greedy strategies, their analyses rely on intricate arguments. Since ODT is a fundamental problem with wide-ranging applications, we are interested in developing algorithms that are both effective and easy to understand.
  We present a new greedy algorithm with a simplified analysis that simultaneously achieves approximation factors below $3.65\log_2 n$ for worst-case cost and $7.3\log_2 n$ for average-case cost. Our algorithm for the Optimal Decision Tree behaves greedily with respect to the hereby introduced Separating Subfamily problem which asks for the cheapest subfamily of tests which partitions the hypotheses into pieces of small enough size. We show that the Separating Subfamily can itself be reduced to an instance of the well-known Maximum Coverage problem. At the core of our approach lies exploiting properties of cutting a clique into small pieces, where edges represent pairs of hypotheses to be separated. In the spirit of simplicity, we also provide a new and straightforward application of ODT: an $\mathcal{O}(\log (k\cdot n))$-approximation for the Adaptive Set Cover problem, where $k$ is the number of possible realizations.
thinking: 该论文针对最优决策树问题提出了新的贪心算法，简化了分析过程并改进了近似比，在信息检索领域具有理论价值。然而，论文更侧重于算法理论分析，与图情领域的实际业务场景（如图书馆系统、信息服务）的直接关联较弱，方法严谨性体现在理论证明上而非实证研究。
one_sentence_summary: 这篇论文提出了一种分析更简洁的贪心算法，用于构建近似最优的决策树，以高效识别未知假设。

title: A Geometric Principle for Path Selection in Directed Acyclic Graphs
abstract:
arXiv:2610.27025v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: There are many types of path between nodes of a Directed acyclic graph (DAG), including the shortest and longest paths. Here, we ask whether the choice of path used in any analysis reflects the geometry of the latent space in which the DAG is embedded. To do this we define L_p-cube spacetimes, a family of continuous ordered spaces in which a single parameter p determines whether the ordered distance satisfies the ordered triangle identity when p>1, or the reverse ordered triangle identity when 0

<1 or p<0, both of which are rarely studied. The forward connection kernel in the p<0 case has infinite hyper-volume, yet it is a well defined model. We then construct random geometric DAGs embedded in our L_p-cube spacetime and study their geometry. For p>1, where the ordered triangle identity holds, the shortest paths provide the closest approximation to the continuum ordered geodesic while for 0

<1 and p<0, where the reverse ordered triangle identity holds, this role is instead taken by the longest weighted path. We also test the robustness of this relationship in a geometric citation model in which the random geometric DAG is supplemented by a preferential-attachment-type mechanism allowing connections beyond the strict geometric cut-off. The same broad correspondence between latent geometry and ordered geodesic path type is recovered. Our results show that the preference for shortest or longest paths in a DAG is closely connected to the geometry assumed for its latent space, and suggest that path structure can provide information about latent geometry, even when that geometry is not directly observed.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于几何原理的路径选择方法，通过定义L_p-cube时空模型，揭示了有向无环图中最短路径与最长路径的选择与潜在空间几何特性的内在关联。其方法在理论建模上较为严谨，构建了随机几何DAG并进行了验证，但作为纯数学模型研究，在图情领域的直接业务落地价值有限。
one_sentence_summary: 论文发现，在有向无环图中选择最短路径还是最长路径，取决于其嵌入的潜在几何空间的特性。

title: mapping-bioimage-software: data and code for Mapping bioimage-analysis software adoption in microscopy
abstract: Data and code for Mapping bioimage-analysis software adoption in microscopy. title: Weakly Supervised Adaptation of Scientific Embeddings for Exploratory Literature Mapping
abstract:
arXiv:2610.25413v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Scientific document embeddings such as SPECTER2 are optimized for retrieval over large, heterogeneous corpora. On a small specialized corpus their similarity distributions can become highly compressed, which limits their usefulness for exploratory literature mapping. We study whether weakly supervised in-domain adaptation, using only metadata already available in open citation databases, changes this geometry. On ArtCon, a curated corpus of 704 publications on artificial and machine consciousness, we adapt the SPECTER2 proximity model with a lightweight LoRA adapter trained on positive pairs derived from bibliographic coupling in OpenAlex, using no manually annotated similarity labels. We compare the adapted embeddings with lexical (TF-IDF), citation-based (bibliographic coupling) and generic semantic (SPECTER2) representations under thresholded, fixed-density and symmetric k-nearest-neighbour graph constructions. Adaptation substantially decompresses the similarity distribution (mean pairwise cosine similarity 0.9104 to 0.8663, standard deviation 0.0259 to 0.0594) and yields graphs with markedly higher Louvain modularity and better connectivity than the base encoder under matched edge and neighbourhood budgets. The effect is stable across all three graph constructions and is therefore not an artefact of a single sparsification choice. We report this as a case study on one corpus, and we are explicit about what it does not establish: the clustering indices used here are computed against community labels derived from each representation's own similarity graph, so they measure internal geometric self-consistency rather than agreement with an external topical ground truth, and adaptation and evaluation use the same documents. Evaluation against independent labels, on held-out documents, and against geometric controls is ongoing work.
thinking: 该论文针对专业小语料库中科学文档嵌入相似度分布压缩的问题，提出了一种仅利用开放引文元数据进行弱监督自适应的方法，技术方案前沿且方法严谨。其核心贡献在于通过轻量级适配器有效改善了嵌入的几何结构，提升了文献探索性图谱的质量，但研究目前仅为单语料库的案例研究，缺乏外部主题标签的验证，因此实践应用价值尚待后续工作证实。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种无需人工标注、仅利用引文数据的方法，有效优化了科学文档嵌入模型在小规模专业文献库中的探索性图谱绘制能力。

title: MATCH: Multi-stage Article Tagging to Concept Hierarchies
abstract:
arXiv:2610.25948v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: The increasing specialization of scientific research calls for fine-grained representations of publication content that can be applied at scale. SCALE extends the OpenAlex taxonomy with approximately 114,000 Scientific Concepts derived from author keywords, but assigning these Concepts to individual publications remains challenging. We introduce MATCH (Multi-stage Article Tagging to Concept Hierarchies), a framework that assigns SCALE Concepts using article titles, abstracts, and author keywords. MATCH combines multi-view embedding retrieval, deterministic taxonomy-aware filtering, and language-model reranking to select relevant Concepts while preserving their hierarchical paths. Its modular design supports both API-based and self-hosted inference. In a blind evaluation involving 22 domain experts across 11 fields and 110 articles, the self-hosted and API-based configurations achieved Precision of 81.5% and 83.3%, respectively, and Precision@5 of approximately 89% for both, with no statistically significant difference detected. These findings support the practical viability of the evaluated self-hosted configuration for large-scale Concept assignment without per-token API charges. Deployed on over two million MDPI publications, MATCH assigns a median of five Concepts per article, covers approximately 94% of the SCALE Concepts, and supports daily indexing of newly available publications. By operationalizing the SCALE taxonomy at publication level, MATCH provides a foundation for fine-grained scientometric analysis and monitoring of scientific developments.
thinking: 论文提出MATCH框架，结合多视图嵌入检索、确定性分类法过滤和语言模型重排序，实现了对大规模科学文献的细粒度概念标注，方法设计严谨且经过专家盲评验证。其模块化设计支持API和本地部署，已在超过200万篇MDPI出版物上应用，具有较高的实践价值，但技术层面虽整合了前沿的嵌入和语言模型方法，创新性更多体现在工程化集成而非算法突破。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究开发了一个多阶段框架，能高效、准确地将细粒度科学概念标签自动标注到海量学术论文上。

title: SQuIREL: A Context-Relative Framework for Measuring Entity Richness in Wikidata
abstract:
arXiv:2610.24709v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Wikidata is a large, heterogeneous knowledge graph and applying data quality metrics requires context-specific approaches. The "richness" quality metric is currently under-researched and typically restricted to the ontology level, which fails to capture entity-specific structural depth. To address this gap, we introduce SQuIREL, a method that measures richness directly at the entity level using six dimensions: Semantic Specificity, Qualifier Density, Internal Connectivity, Reference Provenance, External Network Connectivity, and Linguistic Accessibility. These dimensions are kept disaggregated to preserve actionability for targeted editorial intervention. We apply this metric to two case studies of oil paintings (Brazilian vs. French) and writers (grouped by citizenship and gender) to demonstrate how it surfaces representational inequalities that may indicate systemic bias. Our metric successfully distinguishes between highly tailored and basic entity profiles, revealing nuances that raw counts and existing aggregate scores obscure. Specifically, it identifies structural imbalances, such as 48% of Brazilian paintings clustering as low-richness stubs against 0% in the French cohort, as well as intersectional patterns, including contrasting gender gaps between UK and Nigerian writers.
thinking: 论文提出了一种针对维基数据实体丰富度的多维评估框架，方法设计清晰且维度划分具有可操作性，通过具体案例验证了其揭示结构性偏差的能力。然而，研究基于特定实体类型的案例分析，样本的代表性和方法的普适性有待进一步验证，且技术方法本身未采用最前沿的AI模型。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一个从六个维度评估维基数据实体信息丰富度的框架，并通过案例揭示了不同群体知识表示的结构性不平等。

title: EpiLens: Lightweight RAG for Epidemiological Knowledge Acquisition
abstract:
arXiv:2610.26730v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: To prepare for future outbreaks, researchers need to know what studies have been done and what data they use. Mapping a large literature by hand is slow, while large language models alone can misstate or conflate sources. We present EpiLens, a lightweight, open-source retrieval-augmented generation package that applies a fixed retrieval template and output schema to every paper in a corpus and links outputs to source passages. We build a corpus of 2,297 papers from the sources of a multi-pathogen parameter study and evaluate EpiLens's paper-classification workflow against 214 manually labelled papers. Without task-specific training data, the classifier matches or exceeds the tested supervised and zero-shot baselines across four tasks. The study's early extraction sheets cite published sources for 327 estimates. We link each estimate to a cited document or to corpus studies included by a review. Then, we use the classifier's labels to compare the papers associated with different parameters and pathogens. EpiLens labels more papers linked to reproduction numbers than fatality risks as model-based (54% versus 22%, compared with 62% versus 24% in the manual labels). The gap is consistent with the frequent use of transmission models to estimate reproduction numbers and persists within each of five pathogens compared. Beyond the contrast between parameters, the model-based share of papers linked to incubation-period estimates differs by pathogen: 55% for SARS-CoV-2 versus 6% for mpox.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种轻量级检索增强生成（RAG）工具EpiLens，用于流行病学文献的知识获取，其核心创新在于将固定检索模板与输出模式相结合，并链接到原文，在无任务特定训练数据的情况下，分类性能达到或超过了基线模型，方法严谨性较高。然而，其技术架构（轻量级RAG）虽应用了前沿范式，但并非该领域最尖端的技术突破；其应用场景（流行病学文献分析）虽具有明确价值，但直接移植到通用图书馆业务场景仍需适配。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究开发了一个轻量级工具，能有效自动分类和分析流行病学文献，并揭示了不同疫情参数研究方法的差异。

title: Metadata conflicts and their impact on DataCite metadata completeness in disciplinary research data repositories
abstract:
arXiv:2603.25468v3 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: This paper presents results from a study that investigates how eight disciplinary research data repositories from the geosciences and social sciences navigate metadata conflicts - conflicts in implementations of the same standard and inter-standard conflicts - and how these conflicts affect the completeness of DataCite metadata. It combines results from analyzing DataCite metadata records, structural differences between three disciplinary metadata schemas and the DataCite Metadata Schema, and a direct comparison of two metadata records describing the same dataset. The results show that both conflicts in implementations of the same standard and inter-standard conflicts contribute to incomplete DataCite metadata. In addition to inherent differences between the metadata schemas, workflows and conscious decisions by the repositories also contribute to these conflicts. Some of these conflicts could be resolved by updated metadata crosswalks, emerging initiatives for retroactive collaborative metadata enrichment, the implementation of metadata application profiles or schema updates. Other conflicts can't be resolved or are strongly connected to the repository mission. The results also highlight that metadata completeness is multifaceted, and assessment requires careful consideration of context.
thinking: 论文聚焦于学科数据仓储中元数据冲突对DataCite元数据完整性的影响，研究问题具有现实针对性，方法上结合了元数据分析、模式结构比较和个案对比，较为严谨。但研究主要基于对八个仓储的案例分析，样本量有限，且技术方法上未涉及当前最前沿的AI或自动化技术，属于对现有标准和实践问题的深度剖析。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，学科数据仓储中元数据标准的实施差异和标准间冲突是导致DataCite元数据不完整的主要原因，并提出了可能的解决路径。

title: From Code Archival to Knowledge Graph: Bridging Software Heritage, COAR Notify and Wikidata
abstract:
arXiv:2609.21667v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Software is a first-class scientific object, yet validated links between source code and the scholarly record remain largely absent from the Linked Open Data (LOD) cloud, isolating archived artefacts from semantic discovery. This paper presents an end-to-end reconciliation pipeline that harvests, validates, and models publication-to-repository pairs from sources where the link between a paper and its source code is explicit and editorially verified: the software-centric journals JOSS, SoftwareX, and IPOL, together with the reproducibility reports of the SIGMOD Availability and Reproducibility Initiative (ARI). This yields a curated corpus of 4,397 $\langle$DOI, repository-URL$\rangle$ pairs. We design two distinct application profiles grounded in Wikidata classes (one for scholarly articles, one for software instances) aligned with the schema.org and CodeMeta vocabularies. This architectural separation enables rule-based reconciliation at two granularities: lightweight, inline publication references or standalone, first-class Wikidata software nodes equipped with SWHIDs, Software Heritage's content-addressed identifiers. A read-only lookup against Wikidata shows that only 82 of the harvested repositories were already modelled there; human-reviewed batches have since created 4{,}182 new software items cross-linked to their articles. We further show that payloads of the emerging COAR Notify protocol, an external effort we do not develop, map natively onto our input format, so the same backend could later serve a live enrichment stream. Our core contribution is a pair of application profiles that turn Wikidata into a connector between the scholarly record and archived source code; we openly release all code, application profiles, and harvested datasets.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种将软件源代码与学术记录连接的知识图谱构建方法，结合了Software Heritage、COAR Notify和Wikidata等前沿基础设施，技术方案具有创新性。其贡献主要在于设计了可操作的应用配置文件并构建了高质量数据集，为开放科学实践提供了具体工具，但作为一项技术实现研究，其方法论的严谨性主要体现在数据处理流程上，而非对用户行为或系统效果的实证检验。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究设计了一套方法，利用知识图谱将学术论文与其对应的源代码存档系统地关联起来，并发布了可用的工具和数据集。

title: When Does Evidence-Graph Structure Predict Answer Correctness? Label-Free Abstention for Structured Retrieval
abstract:
arXiv:2610.24030v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Retrieval systems return scored answers, but a high score does not show that an answer should be trusted. The proposed training-free abstention method applies the boundary cut to the selected evidence in an evidence graph. The signal is the weighted cut between selected and unselected candidates and requires no correctness labels or confidence-model training. On MemoryAgentBench (MAB) FactConsolidation multi-hop, with unresolved queries ranked last for every selector, it raises area under the precision-coverage curve from 0.736 for the best score baseline to 0.785 (+0.049, 95% CI [+0.008, +0.092]); under the native evaluation, where score baselines keep their unresolved values, the gap is +0.108. A zero-cut subset contains 71 of 400 queries at 100% observed precision. In this pipeline, the subset corresponds to structural closure; controlled analyses attribute much of the remaining separation to resolution status, with little benefit from continuous edge weights. Across external benchmarks, usefulness varies with graph construction, edge semantics, and relation; typed structure alone does not ensure useful confidence. A supervised gradient-boosted selector achieves 0.814 versus the boundary cut's 0.785 when the retrieval stack matches. These findings provide empirical guidance for using available evidence graphs for lightweight, auditable post-retrieval abstention without additional model inference.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种无需训练、基于证据图边界切割的检索结果置信度评估方法，属于信息检索领域的前沿探索。其方法新颖且无需额外标注数据，具有较好的方法严谨性，通过多个基准测试和对比实验进行了验证。然而，其实际应用价值受限于特定类型的结构化检索系统（如证据图），在通用检索场景下的直接落地性有待进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种无需训练的方法，通过分析证据图的结构来预测检索答案的正确性，从而决定是否应信任该答案。

title: Location, Location, Generation: Where You Ask Matters for Generative Engine Optimization
abstract:
arXiv:2610.24081v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Generative search engines answer local and commercial questions with a written answer and a few cited sources. A growing practice of generative engine optimization (GEO) monitors which sources and brands these answers show, typically from a single place. In this paper, we present a controlled audit of how the user's location changes the sources that generative engines cite. We ask 300 questions of ChatGPT with 19 declared locations, and of ChatGPT and Gemini from five network locations, each twice to measure run-to-run noise (31,200 answers). The engines take location from different channels. ChatGPT follows the location an application declares, down to the city: it writes the place into its own searches, and its search backend localizes results even when the queries name no place. It ignores the network. Gemini ignores the declared location and follows the country of the network, changing most of its sources even for questions that do not depend on place. The businesses the answers recommend change with the sources. Thus, visibility in generative search is specific to the user's location, and audits must control both channels.
thinking: 该论文采用大规模、多轮次的实验设计，对生成式搜索引擎（ChatGPT、Gemini）的地理位置响应机制进行了系统审计，方法严谨，样本量充足。研究揭示了地理位置对检索结果和商业推荐的显著影响，对信息检索的公平性和透明度具有直接警示意义，但其技术核心仍是对现有商业系统的测试，而非提出新的前沿技术模型。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，生成式搜索引擎的答案和推荐会因用户地理位置的不同而产生显著差异，这对搜索引擎的透明度和公平性提出了挑战。

title: Candidate-dependent residual routing trades top-of-list accuracy for recall in sequential recommendation
abstract:
arXiv:2610.24200v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Candidate-dependent routing lets a sequential recommender weight a user's past behaviors differently for each item it scores. We test whether this flexibility helps by adding a small residual routing module to a self-attentive baseline, in two versions that differ only in what sets the routing weights: the user's history representation or the candidate item's embedding. Across five paired seeds on the REES46 cosmetics-shop dataset, with matched training for all three models, candidate-dependent routing leaves the primary metric, normalized discounted cumulative gain at cutoff ten (NDCG@10), essentially unchanged (mean relative change +0.003%). Secondary and exploratory analyses show that this flat average hides two effects that cancel. The candidate-dependent model places more relevant items in its top ten (recall +1.81%) but ranks the first one lower (mean reciprocal rank -1.09%), and most of its new hits land at positions six to ten. Its gains come from queries with at least one target among the user's last 50 events, while queries whose targets all lie outside that window get worse. In this form, candidate-dependent routing trades accuracy at the top of the list for recall further down.
thinking: 该论文在推荐系统领域探索了候选依赖路由机制对序列推荐性能的影响，通过严谨的对比实验设计验证了其在提升召回率与牺牲列表顶部准确性之间的权衡关系，方法学较为规范。然而，其技术方案是对现有自注意力模型的增量改进，前沿性有限，且研究基于单一数据集，实践普适性有待进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 研究表明，在序列推荐模型中引入候选依赖路由机制，会以略微降低列表顶部排名准确性为代价，换取整体召回率的提升。

title: Optimal Fusion Weights Form Intervals, Not Points: A Latency-Aware Study of Query-Adaptive WRRF
abstract:
arXiv:2610.24341v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) is widely used to combine sparse and dense retrievers in hybrid information retrieval, but a critical limitation is that it assigns a fixed, uniform weight to each retriever regardless of the query. Query-aware methods treat the per-query optimal weight as a single point, an assumption whose empirical validity has not been examined. We present an empirical study of eight dynamic fusion weight prediction strategies across four datasets and four sparse--dense retriever pairs. When we compare these approaches to static fusion and a per-query oracle that bounds achievable performance, several findings emerge. First, the per-query optimal fusion weight is typically an interval rather than a point. Queries can have multiple optimal intervals, and these can take on a variety of shapes. Second, 74 of 128 dynamic fusion methods tested were significantly better than standard RRF after false discovery rate correction. Third, dynamic fusion methods exhibit differing quality and latency characteristics that should be considered when choosing an appropriate fusion method. To address this last finding, we present a tiered decision framework that maps practitioner constraints, dataset properties, label availability, hardware, and latency budget to an appropriate method class. We release the code for our experiments at https://github.com/thomsonreuters/query-based-rrf.
thinking: 该论文对混合检索中的动态权重融合方法进行了深入的实证研究，揭示了查询最优融合权重通常是一个区间而非单点的关键发现，并提出了一个考虑质量与延迟的决策框架，方法严谨且具有直接的应用指导价值。然而，其技术核心仍围绕传统检索模型的融合策略，未涉及当前最前沿的大语言模型等生成式检索技术。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，在混合检索中，针对不同查询的最优融合权重通常是一个区间，而非单一数值，并据此提出了一个权衡检索效果与响应速度的实用决策框架。

title: DuoLM: Fast and Effective Personalized Recommendation with Language Models
abstract:
arXiv:2610.24481v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Language models can make personalized recommendations from rich item content, user history, and feedback. However, evaluating many candidates with full-text inputs incurs substantial online computation and limits serving throughput. We introduce DuoLM, a framework for fast and effective personalized recommendation that integrates a compact recommendation model with an efficient serving runtime. An encoder LLM learns compact item representations for offline reuse, while a personalized ranker LLM combines them with user history and feedback for recommendation. We train both models end to end with recommendation supervision and teacher distillation. The runtime further accelerates inference through virtual token IDs for embedding access, shared history computation, and CUDA Graph replay. Benchmark results show that our framework achieves recommendation quality comparable to that of the expert teacher model. On a single H100, it delivers approximately 26,400 candidate scores per second, about $60\times$ the throughput of the teacher served with vLLM and automatic prefix caching.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种结合紧凑型推荐模型与高效服务运行时的框架，显著提升了基于语言模型的个性化推荐系统的推理速度，技术方案具有创新性。然而，论文主要聚焦于模型架构与性能优化，其业务落地价值高度依赖于特定硬件环境与工程实现，对一般图书馆或信息机构的直接可迁移性有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一个名为DuoLM的高效框架，通过优化模型结构与推理过程，在保证推荐质量的同时，大幅提升了基于大语言模型的个性化推荐系统的服务吞吐量。

title: RAGit: Turning Document Preprocessing into an Experimental Variable for RAG
abstract:
arXiv:2610.24659v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Document preprocessing choices can substantially affect retrieval in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, yet they are often selected heuristically and are difficult to compare under consistent conditions. We present RAGit, an open-source experimentation workbench for the systematic and reproducible evaluation of document preprocessing choices through downstream retrieval. RAGit represents parsing, chunking, indexing, retrieval, and evaluation as configurable experimental stages, enabling controlled comparisons while the remaining downstream settings are kept fixed. It preserves provenance from retrieved chunks to source pages and maps heterogeneous retrieval units to a common page-level ranking for evaluation. The current implementation supports multiple parsers and chunking strategies, dense and late-interaction retrieval, reusable intermediate artifacts, and multi-configuration benchmarking. We demonstrate RAGit through controlled experiments comparing alternative preprocessing configurations under a fixed retrieval setup, illustrating how preprocessing can be treated as an explicit experimental variable. RAGit and its documentation are publicly available on GitHub (https://github.com/OmarElbachyr/ragit). A demonstration video is available at https://youtu.be/tsst-Bhfz4I.
thinking: 该论文提出了RAGit这一开源实验平台，将文档预处理作为RAG流程中的可控实验变量进行系统评估，方法设计具有创新性和可复现性。其核心贡献在于提供了标准化的评估框架，但作为方法工具类研究，其直接业务落地价值依赖于后续的具体应用场景。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究开发了一个开源工具RAGit，用于系统化地评估和比较检索增强生成（RAG）流程中不同文档预处理策略的效果。

title: MemRevise: A Self-Revising Memory for Conversational Search
abstract:
arXiv:2610.24672v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: In conversational search, users correct misun-derstandings, revise their requests and return to earlier topics, so part of the history no longer reflects what they want. Existing benchmarks do not isolate such turns. Current search methods either re-read the history or keep a record of every turn, and none of them marks earlier content as dropped. We introduce CONVREVISE, a benchmark of 4,429 test questions in six tiers of returns and revisions over TopiOCQA, CORAL and OR-QuAC. We also propose MEMREVISE, which combines a revisable memory graph, a 3B writer distilled from teacher memories, and a search guided by the memory. The writer reads each turn once and adds a node that records its topic, its facts and the operations it performs, such as adding, abandoning or reactivating a topic. Topic status follows from these operations, so a dropped topic keeps its facts and can be restored. With a frozen retriever, MEMREVISE reaches a mean MRR@10 of 0.701, against 0.589 for the best competitor, ConvSearch-R1-FT, and 0.617 for a writer distilled the same way without the memory, so the memory and the steps built on it add 0.084. MEMREVISE is significantly better on Topi- OCQA and OR-QuAC, statistically tied with prompted 32B rewriters on CORAL, and never significantly behind the strongest competitor of any tier.
thinking: 论文提出了一个可修订的记忆图模型（MEMREVISE）和配套的基准测试集（CONVREVISE），用于解决会话搜索中用户意图动态修正的核心难题，方法设计新颖且实验验证充分。其不足在于模型规模（3B参数）和基准数据集虽具代表性，但在工业级大规模真实场景下的泛化能力仍有待验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究为会话搜索系统设计了一种能动态标记和恢复被用户放弃话题的记忆机制，显著提升了对话历史理解的准确性。

title: VisR-RAG-Fin: Benchmarking Multimodal RAG over Visually Rich Financial Documents
abstract:
arXiv:2610.24822v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Enterprise documents such as financial reports are increasingly processed by automated systems, yet they are primarily designed for human reading and exhibit complex visual structure, combining dense text with tables, charts, diagrams, and rich layouts. These characteristics pose significant challenges for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, which must retrieve relevant pages and leverage visual and structural information during answer generation. Despite recent advances in multimodal retrieval and vision-language models, there remains a limited understanding of how design choices across retrieval and generation components affect end-to-end RAG performance on visually rich documents. In this paper, we present a comprehensive empirical study of multimodal RAG for page-level Question Answering (QA) over financial documents. We introduce VisR-RAG-Fin (Visually Rich RAG for Finance), an open-source benchmark constructed through a general pipeline for visually rich documents that preserves original layout and visual content. Using this benchmark, we systematically analyze retrieval and generation behavior under text-only, multimodal, and hybrid configurations, providing a foundation for rigorous evaluation of RAG systems on complex enterprise document collections. Overall, this work provides actionable insights for practitioners designing and evaluating multimodal RAG pipelines over complex, visually rich enterprise documents.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于视觉丰富文档的多模态RAG基准构建与评估，技术前沿性突出，方法上通过构建开源基准和系统实验设计展现了较强的严谨性。然而，论文主要贡献在于评估框架和实证分析，其提出的具体技术方案或优化策略在业务场景中的直接落地路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究构建了一个针对视觉丰富金融文档的多模态RAG评估基准，并通过系统实验分析了不同配置对问答性能的影响。

title: Structure-Aligned History Learning with Subspace-Structured Semantic IDs for Generative Recommendation
abstract:
arXiv:2610.25093v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Generative recommendation constructs semantic IDs for catalog items and predicts the next ID from user interaction histories. However, existing methods face limitations in both stages. First, conventional quantizers may produce imbalanced code assignments and lack coherent intermediate semantic units between individual tokens and complete items, limiting history reconstruction. Second, recommendation models remain dominated by next-item prediction, treating historical interactions mainly as conditioning context and providing limited supervision for recovering persistent preferences across the historical path, particularly when relevant preference signals are distributed over distant interactions. To address these limitations, Structure-Aligned History Learning (SAHL) reconnects the two stages by using the structure created during quantization directly for history reconstruction. Its Semantic Residual Balanced Quantization (SRBQ) forms a balanced token-subspace-item hierarchy, and SAHL reconstructs history at these same granularities. Predictive entropy prioritizes uncertain transitions, while curriculum optimization progressively shifts training to inference-aligned next-item prediction. On four Amazon Review categories, SAHL improves NDCG@10 by 18.6%-30.0% over RPG and 2.7%-6.0% over strong method MHL. Controlled analyses verify balanced code use, the benefit of following quantizer-defined groups during reconstruction, and dependence on user history. The relevant code is available at https://github.com/CQU-MM-Intelligent-Lab/SAHL.
thinking: 该论文针对生成式推荐中的语义ID构建和历史序列建模问题，提出了结构对齐的历史学习方法，在量化阶段构建了平衡的层次结构，并在重建阶段直接利用该结构，方法设计具有创新性。其方法在多个数据集上取得了显著性能提升，并通过控制实验验证了关键设计，论证较为严谨。但作为预印本，其实际在图书馆或信息机构业务场景中的应用路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种新的生成式推荐方法，通过构建平衡的语义ID层次结构并与之对齐进行历史学习，有效提升了推荐准确性。

title: When Semantics Fall Short: Persona-Guided Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation with Large Language Models
abstract:
arXiv:2610.25221v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Cross-domain sequential recommendation (CDSR) alleviates data sparsity by transferring user behaviors across domains. Recent advances increasingly leverage large language models (LLMs) to bridge domains through global item semantics. However, this paradigm is inherently limited by two issues: I. semantic domain isolation, where item semantics remain domain-specific and hinder transferable modeling, and II. semantic-behavior inconsistency, where local semantic relations are more consistent with behavioral transitions, whereas such consistency often breaks down globally across domains. To this end, we propose PerCDR, an LLM-enhanced CDSR framework that shifts the focus from global semantic bridging to persona-guided behavioral modeling. Specifically, PerCDR leverages LLM-inferred personas to globally guide transferable cross-domain behavioral patterns, while exploiting local semantic relations to enhance intra-domain behavioral modeling, followed by domain preference adaptation for recommendation refinement. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of PerCDR and validate its effectiveness.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于跨域序列推荐中的语义局限性问题，创新性地引入大语言模型推断的用户画像来指导跨域行为建模，技术方案具有前沿性。研究通过大量实验验证了框架的有效性，方法较为严谨，但其在图书馆等具体业务场景的直接落地路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种利用大语言模型推断用户画像来改进跨域序列推荐的新框架，以解决传统语义方法在跨域场景中的局限性。

title: MEMORA: A Memory-Enhanced Multimodal Committee Reranking Agent for Reasoning-Intensive Retrieval
abstract:
arXiv:2610.25282v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Reasoning-intensive retrieval is fundamentally challenged when queries demand deep semantic inference and arrive in multimodal form. Existing systems treat each query in isolation, rely on monolithic rerankers, and lack retrievers trained for cross-modal reasoning. We introduce MEMORA, a Memory-Enhanced Multimodal Orchestrated Reranking Agent built around three contributions: (1) Collaborative Factor-Committee Reranking, which decomposes queries into intent factors, extracts factor-specific evidence into a structured matrix, and synthesizes judgments via a memory-conditioned meta-verdict model; (2) an Episodic Memory Module that tracks factor outcomes across queries and dynamically adjusts priorities at inference time; and (3) a Reasoning-Aware Dense Retriever fine-tuned with chain-of-thought augmentation on 20k+ reasoning-intensive pairs. Evaluated on MM-BRIGHT across 29 domains, MEMORA achieves nDCG@10 of 41.5 (text-to-text) and 38.9 (multimodal query-to-text), outperforming the strongest agentic text-only baseline by +8.3 points and the strongest agentic multimodal baseline by +7.9 points. Code and data are available at https://github.com/HarnessLab/MEMORA.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种结合记忆增强和多模态协同的检索重排序智能体，在推理密集型检索任务上取得了显著性能提升，方法创新性强且实验设计较为严谨。然而，其前沿技术主要集中于特定检索架构的优化，对更广泛的图情业务场景的直接落地价值尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种融合记忆模块和多模态协同推理的智能检索重排序方法，显著提升了复杂查询下的检索效果。

title: Selling in the Wild: Benchmark and Randomized Field Evidence for a Sales Agent Trained on Commercial Conversations
abstract:
arXiv:2610.25461v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We test whether Javo, a sales agent fine-tuned on 4.6 million consented, de-identified commercial conversations, sells better than a frontier general-purpose model and better than human sales associates. The evaluation has four parts. Study 1 scores the agent on two public sales benchmarks, SalesLLM and SmartSalesBench, against 10 frontier and open-weight models. Study 2 is a randomized controlled trial on 100 live websites in 14 industries (e-commerce, travel and hospitality, and high-consideration services), run from 1 May to 30 September 2026, in which 14.8 million visitors were randomized to no agent, Javo, or a frontier-model agent with an identical interface, catalog tools and guardrails. Study 3 isolates the effect of the model by comparing those two agent arms. Study 4 compares Javo with each site's own human associates on 20 sites with staffed live chat. Relative to no agent, Javo changed revenue per visitor by +10.0% (95% CI +5.1 to +14.9). Among engaged visitors, it changed conversion by +21.6% relative to the frontier-model agent (95% CI +16.9 to +26.3). Against human associates, its engaged conversion was 11.26% versus 11.20% (non-inferior, margin -7%, one-sided p = 0.004; no significant superiority), at 1.8% of the cost per conversation. Return rates, unsupported product claims and complaint rates met the prespecified safety guardrails.
thinking: 论文采用大规模商业对话数据微调销售代理，并在公开基准和真实网站上进行随机对照试验，方法严谨且样本量充足。研究聚焦于商业销售场景，虽技术前沿，但与图书馆和信息服务的核心业务关联较弱，实践应用价值有限。
one_sentence_summary: 研究表明，基于海量商业对话微调的销售AI在提升网站转化率和收入方面，效果优于前沿通用模型，且成本远低于人工客服。

title: Knowledge Manifold Optimization for Scientific Discovery
abstract:
arXiv:2610.25662v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: The rapid expansion and specialization of scientific literature make it increasingly difficult to identify not only what is known, but where new and still supportable knowledge may emerge. We introduce Knowledge Manifold Optimization (KMO), a discovery-oriented extension of the Knowledge Manifold framework that treats scientific discovery as a multiobjective search over a continuous, literature-derived knowledge space. Candidate locations are evaluated using four complementary objectives: persistent knowledge-regime boundary strength, band-pass white-space novelty, semanticgradient magnitude, and evidential support. Rather than collapsing these criteria into a single weighted score, KMO identifies Pareto-optimal Supported Knowledge Gaps, defined as corpus-relative unoccupied regions that remain sufficiently supported by surrounding literature. The method is demonstrated on a 99-paper corpus in aerodynamics and aerodynamic design. On a 21 x 21 grid, exact Pareto analysis produced 19 non-dominated points, of which 16 formed the practical front after excluding points with zero white-space score. These solutions exhibited distinct discovery modes, including methodology bridges, aero-structural topology/FSI integration, functional aerodynamic-device integration, and rear-wake/vehicle flow-control integration. A distance-maximization baseline preferentially selected extrapolative regions with substantially lower support and reliability, demonstrating why emptiness alone is insufficient. Representative Pareto locations were converted into auditable evidence packages and then verbalized by a constrained large language model into candidate research hypotheses. The results show that scientific discovery can be formulated as structured multi-objective search in an explicit knowledge space, while keeping novelty corpus-relative and separating numerical discovery from downstream language generation.
thinking: 论文提出了一种基于知识流形优化的科学发现方法，将科学发现建模为知识空间中的多目标搜索问题，方法设计新颖且具有理论深度。其方法在小型语料库上进行了演示，验证了可行性，但样本量较小，且作为预印本尚未经过同行评议，方法严谨性有待进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种将科学发现视为知识空间中多目标搜索任务的新方法，能自动识别有文献支撑的潜在研究空白。

title: Cross-Pollination Retrieval: Finding Transferable Ideas Across Fields in Scientific Literature
abstract:
arXiv:2610.25678v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Many scientific advances come from cross-pollination, carrying an idea from one field over to a problem in another. Yet retrieving papers across fields remains underexplored, with existing benchmarks confined to a narrow range of fields. We study cross-pollination retrieval, the problem of identifying transferable ideas across research fields, and introduce CPR-Dataset, a large-scale dataset constructed by mining cross-topic citations. Its evaluation split CPR-eval has 1,300 queries in 26 fields, and its training split CPR-train has 10,573 pairs. On CPR-eval, the best of eleven existing retrievers reaches a Recall@10 of only 0.26, whereas an LLM reranker reaches 0.81. Standard contrastive fine-tuning on CPR-train raises Recall@10 to as high as 0.70. The gain carries over to domains held out from training and to analogy and reasoning-intensive retrieval. On AnaloBench, it raises nDCG@10 by up to 33% over the untrained retriever, whereas training on three existing retrieval datasets lowers it. On BRIGHT, it raises nDCG@10 by up to 70%, more than twice the gain from those datasets. CPR-Dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/CPR-Dataset, and the code at https://github.com/SeokwonJung-Jay/Cross-Pollination-Retrieval.
thinking: 论文针对跨领域科学文献中可迁移思想的检索问题，提出了一个大规模数据集CPR-Dataset，并验证了LLM重排序和对比微调方法的显著效果。其方法严谨，实验设计充分，在信息检索领域具有明确的技术前沿性。然而，其研究目前侧重于算法验证和数据集构建，与图书馆等机构的直接业务落地场景结合尚不紧密。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究构建了一个用于跨领域科学思想检索的大规模数据集，并证明大语言模型重排序和对比学习能大幅提升检索效果。

title: MAPS: A Multi-Agent Personalized Script-Driven Video Advertising System Enhanced by Reinforcement Learning
abstract:
arXiv:2610.25748v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: With the rapid growth of online video consumption, video advertising has become a dominant component of digital advertising. Most personalized video advertising systems follow a retrieval-based paradigm, which matches ad content with user preferences in a feature space and recommends the most similar candidates. However, since the candidate creatives are pre-produced, this paradigm limits the granularity of personalization and leads to performance disparities across diverse user groups. To address this limitation, we propose a multi-agent personalized script-driven video advertising system (MAPS). We design four collaborative agents that form a closed-loop pipeline of user profile modeling, script generation, video synthesis, and feedback-driven iterative refinement. To train the Scripter Agent, we develop a reinforcement learning framework equipped with a multi-dimensional reward function, which steers the agent toward producing scripts that simultaneously align with user content preferences and target product information. Extensive offline experiments on representative datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves encouraging performance in generating and integrating personalized creatives. Online A/B experiments in a specific scenario in the Kuaishou advertising system show that MAPS improves CTR by 2.87%, CVR by 2.74%, and ARPU by 9.85% over the generative baseline.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于多智能体强化学习的个性化视频广告生成系统，在技术层面结合了生成式AI与强化学习，具有较高的前沿性。其在线A/B测试展示了明确的业务提升效果，方法上采用了离线与在线实验结合，验证较为充分。但论文场景聚焦于快手广告平台，其方法在图书馆等传统图情机构的直接迁移性有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一个多智能体系统，利用强化学习生成个性化视频广告脚本，并在实际平台中有效提升了广告点击和转化率。

title: Learning Complementary Agent Groups via Task Hypergraphs for Next-POI Recommendation with Missing Modalities
abstract:
arXiv:2610.25801v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Next point-of-interest (POI) recommendation uses visit histories and POI content, but text and images are often missing. Large language model agents have been applied to recommender systems for preference modeling and evidence acquisition. The challenge is to select agents that can jointly analyze the available evidence for each request. We propose \textsc{CATH} (\emph{Complementary Agents via Task Hypergraphs}), which learns to select agent groups for tasks such as comparing candidates or analyzing a POI with missing content. Agents with distinct processing roles are the task hypergraph nodes; each hyperedge connects the selected group and records its analysis goal and target POIs. The policy selects members conditioned on the request, task, and agents already selected. During execution, members share candidate-linked results that guide their subsequent operations. Completed tasks update candidate states and agent memories within the request. A shared ranking head converts candidate states into corrections to a fixed base ranking. Supervised ranking trains the executor, followed by policy optimization that accounts for computation cost. Experiments under natural missingness on Gowalla-CA, Foursquare-NYC, and Foursquare-TKY show 8.4--9.1\% relative NDCG@20 gains over HyperAgent4POI, the strongest prior baseline evaluated. Additional analyses compare group-selection and execution designs, test ranking under additional masking, and characterize quality--cost tradeoffs.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于任务超图的大语言模型智能体协作框架，用于解决多模态数据缺失下的POI推荐问题，方法新颖且实验设计较为严谨。但其技术前沿性主要体现在对现有LLM智能体范式的工程化整合，而非底层技术突破，且未在真实图书馆或信息服务机构场景中验证落地可行性。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究通过任务超图动态组建大语言模型智能体小组，有效提升了在文本和图像信息缺失情况下的下一个兴趣点推荐准确率。

title: OneChord: Distill What You Rank, Recommend in One Pass
abstract:
arXiv:2610.25805v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Accurate product discovery on the Web requires recommendation models that rank catalog candidates within tight inference budgets. In semantic-ID recommendation, deployment can fuse code probabilities with item similarities, making the final ranking depend on their normalization and relative weights. This motivates a direct training principle: \emph{distill what you rank}. We present OneChord, which uses one learned, catalog-normalized fusion for next-item supervision, refinement distillation, and inference. A shared parallel decoder produces joint SID evidence and item-matching scores. During training, a frozen denoiser supplies legal partial SIDs; the student evaluates these states to construct refined fused targets. Matching direct and refined predictions on shared hard candidates transfers refinement into one-pass recommendation. We characterize the fusion weights induced by candidate conditioning and establish sufficient conditions for preserving the refined predictor's full-catalog Top-$K$ selection. Across six Amazon datasets, OneChord achieves the highest Recall@5 and NDCG@5 among the compared methods on every dataset, with average relative gains of 6.30\% and 7.12\% over the strongest baseline. It also achieves a 1.04--1.18$\times$ full-test generation speedup over the fastest baseline. OneChord makes the served ranking distribution the common object of recommendation learning and distillation.
thinking: 论文提出了一种名为OneChord的推荐系统新方法，将排序、蒸馏和推理融合在一个统一框架中，在多个数据集上取得了显著的性能提升和推理速度优势。其方法在技术上有创新性，但研究场景聚焦于电商推荐，与图情领域的直接业务关联度有限，方法论的严谨性体现在充分的实验对比上。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种将排序、蒸馏和推理一体化的新推荐模型，在多个数据集上实现了更高的推荐准确率和更快的推理速度。

title: Multimodal Decoupling for Diversified Recommendation through Semantic and Structural Shaping
abstract:
arXiv:2610.26024v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Recommender systems often suffer from over-concentrated results when optimized for accuracy, limiting recommendation diversity. While diversity has become an important objective, existing methods still face fundamental limitations from both semantic and structural perspectives. On the one hand, multimodal recommender systems provide rich semantic signals, yet are often treated as auxiliary to ID embeddings, leading to ineffective semantic utilization for diversity. On the other hand, the accuracy--diversity trade-off persists during training, where accuracy gains often come at the cost of diversity. We show that this phenomenon is fundamentally governed by both the structural properties of learned representations and the dynamics of optimization. To address these challenges, we propose MOSS, a unified framework for multimodal decoupling through semantic and structural shaping. Specifically, we first introduce an MLLM-based Decoupled Feature Extraction module to disentangle multimodal content into informative representations. To enhance semantic utilization, we design a Category-aware Embedding Selection module that extracts compact, category-aware semantic features. To address structural limitations, we propose two complementary modules: Alternating Dual-Graph Propagation, which alleviates representation collapse by integrating collaborative and multimodal propagation, and Entropy-based Diversity Regularization, which mitigates optimization bias by promoting balanced category exposure. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that MOSS consistently achieves a superior accuracy--diversity trade-off over strong baselines.
thinking: 该论文针对推荐系统多样性不足的问题，提出了一个融合多模态语义解耦与图结构优化的统一框架MOSS，在方法设计上具有创新性，并进行了充分的实验验证。其不足在于作为预印本尚未经过同行评议，且技术方案较为复杂，在图书馆等实际业务场景中的直接部署成本可能较高。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种通过解耦多模态语义和优化图结构来提升推荐结果多样性的新方法，在多个数据集上实现了准确性与多样性的更好平衡。

title: Don't Rewrite the SID Map: Topology Preservation for Generative Retrieval in Dynamic E-Commerce Search
abstract:
arXiv:2610.26105v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Generative retrieval assigns each item a discrete semantic identifier (SID) and retrieves items by autoregressively generating SID sequences. In dynamic environments such as e-commerce, new items arrive continuously, requiring periodic updates to the SID-to-Item mapping and model to maintain retrieval timeliness. Each update, however, can invalidate search paths already learned by the retriever, and the quantitative relationship between mapping change and retrieval quality has not been systematically characterized. We study this problem with extensive controlled experiments over 67 days of large-scale e-commerce search logs and obtain three core findings. (1) SID semantic drift causes severe retrieval degradation that may be masked by large beam sizes: mapping updates reduce HitRate by 41.78-62.05% at beam size 1 but only 8.33-10.85% at beam size 1000, as redundant candidate generation conceals the true severity of drift. (2) The fraction of changed SIDs is strictly monotonically related to retrieval quality: as the remapped fraction increases from 0% to 72.75%, HitRate decreases monotonically, dropping up to 42.66% at beam size 1. Full remapping remains substantially worse than the preservation policy under warm-start training, indicating that short-budget continued training alone cannot repair topology disruption. (3) The SID topology-preserving principle makes even the simplest warm-start strategy highly effective: fixing old-item SIDs, inserting new-items, and warm-starting from the previous model improves old-item HitRate by 10% and new-item HitRate by 109%, validated across two non-overlapping update cycles. These findings distill into a concise deployment principle: insert new-items, freeze old-items; warm-start when possible, otherwise freeze; never change SIDs the model has already learned. A three-week online A/B test on TmallAPP shows UCTCVR +0.29% and GMV +1.16%.
thinking: 该论文聚焦生成式检索在动态电商环境中的核心挑战，即语义标识符映射更新导致的检索质量下降问题，并通过大规模日志实验和在线A/B测试进行了系统性验证。其优势在于问题定义清晰、实验设计严谨且结论具有直接的工程指导价值；不足在于所提策略相对直观，技术新颖性更多体现在对现有方法的深入剖析而非架构创新。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现在动态电商搜索中，保持已有商品语义标识符不变并采用热启动训练，能有效维持生成式检索系统的性能。

title: FLMNet: Self-Ensemble Distillation from Masks to Seeds for Single-Tower CTR Prediction
abstract:
arXiv:2610.26143v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Click-through rate (CTR) prediction underpins recommender systems and online advertising, where high-dimensional categorical features interact in combinatorially many ways. Several recent CTR models, such as FinalNet and QNN, report higher accuracy when a network also learns from its own averaged predictions, for example by running the same network under different dropout patterns and training each run toward the average. Why this self-distillation helps, and whether its random sampling is needed, remains unclear. This work shows that as the number of dropout patterns grows without bound, the objective reduces exactly to the label loss of the logit-averaged prediction plus a penalty on how much the dropout copies of the network disagree. When dropout does not affect how a network gates its features, this penalty can be approximated in closed form, and FLMNet is designed on this principle and trains without sampling. Networks trained from different seeds disagree in the same form, and distilling several of them into one network recovers part of their ensemble gain. On five benchmarks against seventeen baselines, the resulting models take the top two places in accuracy with a single network at inference, and the gains of the penalty and of distillation, where measurable, largely add up.
thinking: 论文提出了一种基于自蒸馏和惩罚项设计的CTR预测新方法，在多个基准测试中表现优异，技术思路具有创新性。但作为预印本，其方法严谨性尚未经过同行评议验证，且研究场景偏向通用推荐系统，在图情领域的具体落地路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种无需采样的自蒸馏方法，通过理论推导的惩罚项提升单个点击率预测模型的精度，在多个基准测试中取得领先效果。

title: Babbar26 main x genre
abstract:
arXiv:2610.26220v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We introduce Babbar26, a multilingual dataset of 1111 web pages from 1006 domains in five languages (English, French, German, Spanish, Italian), jointly annotated for genre, following a compact five-class taxonomy, and for main content and boilerplate, as main/noise regions anchored to the DOM. We describe the annotation guidelines and report double-annotation agreement on both tasks (97.1% on genre; content-level Cohen's k = 0.766 for main content). Compared with the classic KI-04 genre benchmark, a median page has 2.3x more DOM elements and 1.9x more readable text.
thinking: 该论文构建了多语言网页数据集Babbar26，并采用DOM锚定的方式标注了体裁和主要内容/噪声区域，方法较为新颖且标注一致性较高。然而，数据集规模相对有限，且研究更侧重于数据集构建本身，在信息检索领域的直接应用路径和前沿技术融合度上尚有提升空间。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究发布了一个新的多语言网页数据集，用于联合标注网页体裁和识别主要内容区域，为信息检索任务提供了基础资源。

title: Preference Is Not Position: Evaluating Reranking on NevIR in Fixed Hybrid Candidate Pools
abstract:
arXiv:2610.26260v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Near-identical passages can differ in a decisive condition, such as negation. A ranker may order such a pair correctly while placing the preferred passage far down the retrieved list. We examine this distinction using official NevIR pairs jointly covered by fixed candidate pools from dense, learned sparse, and BM25 retrieval. On 2,736 Test query directions, a pairwise-trained ranker improves strict per-query preference over fixed fusion (56.62% versus 52.30%) while reducing preferred-passage mean reciprocal rank (MRR) from 0.5764 to 0.3055. An exploratory fixed-model replay of a variant with background sampling and revised supervision yields MRR of 0.5859 and strict preference of 54.53%. Bounded pointwise reranking of the fusion top 20 improves both outcomes. Qwen3-14B-AWQ with fusion tie-breaking reaches 77.45% strict preference, 58.99% NevIR-style paired accuracy across 1,363 complete pairs, and preferred-passage MRR of 0.7509. A BGE cross-encoder reaches 69.77% strict preference and MRR of 0.7404. A post-hoc analysis finds that the branch where equal Qwen grades for the two designated passages trigger fusion tie-breaking accounts for 27% of evaluated directions and contains most remaining strict-preference failures. These findings support joint evaluation of pairwise preference, designated-passage position, and computational cost, while distinguishing model judgments from the combined ranking procedure.
thinking: 该论文聚焦信息检索中的重排序问题，通过构建固定混合候选池，系统比较了点对点排序、固定融合及大语言模型（Qwen3-14B）等方法在严格偏好与平均倒数排名（MRR）指标上的表现。其优势在于方法设计严谨，对排序模型的内在行为进行了深入剖析，并提出了联合评估框架；不足在于研究场景较为特定（NevIR数据集），其结论在通用检索任务中的直接落地价值有待进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，在信息检索中，模型对相似文本对的偏好判断与其在最终列表中的排名位置可能不一致，需要联合评估。

title: AGR: Agentic Generative Retrieval with Tool-Augmented Search
abstract:
arXiv:2610.26831v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large-scale search and recommendation systems derive much of their retrieval quality from rich, heterogeneous features, yet existing generative retrieval (GR) methods struggle to exploit such feature ecosystems efficiently. Static feature injection either encodes all available signals or places them according to predetermined schemes, increasing serving cost and introducing irrelevant or conflicting evidence. More fundamentally, existing methods cannot adaptively determine when a feature is needed, which feature to select, or where it should influence hierarchical Semantic ID (SID) generation. We propose Agentic Generative Retrieval (AGR), a tool-augmented paradigm that interleaves SID generation with on-demand feature acquisition. Conditioned on the request and decoded SID prefix, AGR decides whether to invoke a tool, which feature to acquire, and where its observation should influence subsequent decoding, thereby steering generation toward feature-consistent SID branches. To supervise this behavior, we construct tool-augmented trajectories based on feature applicability and information gain along the SID hierarchy, and train the model through SID pretraining followed by tool-augmented fine-tuning. Experiments on an industrial dataset and three public benchmarks, together with an online A/B test, consistently demonstrate the effectiveness of AGR.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种结合智能体决策与工具增强的生成式检索新范式，通过动态、按需的特征获取来优化语义ID生成，在方法上具有显著的前沿性。其基于工业数据集和在线A/B测试的验证，以及面向大规模检索系统的设计，体现了较强的实践潜力和方法严谨性。然而，其技术复杂度较高，对现有系统架构的改造要求可能影响其快速落地。
one_sentence_summary: 论文提出了一种让检索系统像智能体一样，根据需要动态调用外部工具来辅助生成检索结果的新方法，提升了检索质量。

title: Cache2LoRA: Understanding and Improving Context Internalization
abstract:
arXiv:2610.24107v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Context-to-LoRA methods encode documents as low-rank parameter updates, allowing language models to answer without retaining the source text in their decoding context. How reliably do these updates preserve facts and support their use under different instructions? Controlled diagnosis of existing context-to-LoRA methods separates fact discrimination, target retention, and response adaptation. Competing sources influence answers, while target-only construction and memory-state optimization improve recovery at fixed update size. Recovering facts also does not ensure that answers follow response instructions. We introduce Cache2LoRA, which uses each query to aggregate evidence from a reusable frozen document cache before generating LoRA updates. Trainable encoding operates only on the query and memory-token suffix, and multi-style supervision teaches both evidence preservation and answer expression. Across 17 tasks, Cache2LoRA improves on existing context-to-LoRA methods and achieves macro F1 of 0.663, approaching full-context in-context learning at 0.671. For 32K documents and 256-token outputs at batch size 16, its decoding throughput is 5.9$\times$ that of full-context ICL. At matched memory size, generated LoRA preserves answer accuracy more reliably than the learned-KV variant under long, diverse intervening text and combines more effectively with retained document KV, yielding higher hybrid F1 and EM.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种改进的Cache2LoRA方法，通过可复用的文档缓存和查询驱动的证据聚合机制，有效提升了上下文内部化的性能，在多项任务中接近全上下文学习的效果并显著提升推理效率。其技术方案新颖且实验设计系统全面，但作为预印本，其方法在真实图书馆或信息检索系统中的具体落地路径和成本效益仍需进一步探讨。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种名为Cache2LoRA的新方法，通过优化低秩参数更新机制，使大语言模型在无需保留原文的情况下，能更可靠地记忆事实并遵循指令回答问题。

title: Learning to Program Retrievals: Composing Search Primitives via Reinforcement Learning
abstract:
arXiv:2610.24854v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Retrieval-augmented language models increasingly use multi-step search to solve knowledge-intensive tasks, yet existing systems typically expose retrieval through fixed pipelines or collections of atomic tools. We introduce Retrieval Program Learning (RPL), a programmable search framework that allows a policy to compose search primitives into executable programs with local state and control flow. This enables adaptive search that can retrieve broadly, process intermediate results, and selectively construct model context without tying retrieval breadth to context consumption. However, the resulting flexibility creates a difficult exploration problem: useful programs may require several coordinated decisions, while reinforcement learning often supplies only sparse feedback. To address this challenge, we propose program mutation, a grammar-constrained and execution-verified procedure that generates local variants of suboptimal programs sampled during RL, converts them into training trajectories, and distills them back into the policy. We evaluate RPL on open-domain question answering and corpus-level reasoning tasks, comparing it with a range of retrieval and reasoning baselines. RPL consistently improves open-domain QA performance across model sizes and in- and out-of-domain benchmarks, with particularly large gains on multi-hop tasks. Notably, a 4B model trained with RPL outperforms all 8B model baselines. On corpus-level reasoning, RPL achieves the highest answer F1 and document-coverage F1 for both model sizes while substantially reducing context consumption and retrieval turns. Our results show that programmable search expands the retrieval strategies that agents can learn, while program mutation provides an effective mechanism for exploring useful program structures beyond direct on-policy sampling.
thinking: 该论文提出了一个基于强化学习的可编程检索框架（RPL），通过组合检索原语来构建具有本地状态和控制流的可执行程序，在开放域问答和语料级推理任务上取得了显著性能提升。其方法创新性强，将强化学习与程序合成结合，技术前沿性突出；实验设计严谨，在多模型规模和任务上进行了充分验证。然而，论文目前主要发表于预印本平台，其框架在真实图书馆或信息检索系统中的具体部署路径和工程成本尚不明确，因此业务落地价值暂时受限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种让智能体通过强化学习自动组合检索步骤的新方法，显著提升了复杂知识问答任务的准确性和效率。

title: Toward Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Enterprise Retail Workflows over Heterogeneous Data Sources
abstract:
arXiv:2610.25096v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Enterprise retail workflows require agents to chain evidence across heterogeneous sources, from structured product and order records to unstructured inquiries and reviews, yet existing agentic RAG benchmarks rarely capture this challenge. To enable controlled evaluation of such workflows, we introduce RetailBridge, a compositional retail benchmark built from persona-driven simulations. Its questions are constructed by linking entities and intermediate answers across heterogeneous sources, requiring agents to identify the relevant sources, carry evidence between them, and produce a grounded answer. To systematically evaluate LLMs on these retail workflows, we develop RetailRAG, a retail-aware framework equipped with auto-schema briefing, source-routed plan chaining, and diagnostic plan revision. RetailRAG consistently outperforms existing agentic RAG baselines across all evaluation axes, serving as a strong reference system for assessing LLM agents on retail workflows. On RetailBridge, evaluating ten LLM backbones with RetailRAG reveals multi-source chaining as the dominant bottleneck across providers and model scales, suggesting that reliable retail agents require explicit cross-source orchestration rather than scaling alone. Code and data are publicly available at \url{https://github.com/DISL-Lab/RetailBridge}.
thinking: 论文针对企业零售场景中异构数据源的智能检索与生成问题，提出了一个模拟基准和框架，采用了当前主流的智能体与RAG技术，技术前沿性较强。其提出的框架具有明确的模块化设计，并通过系统实验验证了效果，方法较为严谨。然而，其研究更侧重于技术框架的构建与评估，直接面向图书馆或信息机构的落地应用场景尚不明确，实践应用价值相对受限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究为处理企业零售异构数据的智能问答系统构建了一个评估基准和框架，并发现跨数据源的信息串联是当前大模型应用的主要瓶颈。

title: RemoteANN: A Native Vector Search Engine for Cloud Object Storage
abstract:
arXiv:2610.25172v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Vector search engines built on cloud object storage have drawn growing attention from both academia and industry. These systems typically adopt a disaggregated storage-compute architecture, persisting the primary vector payload in object stores (e.g., Amazon S3) while retaining compact index metadata on compute nodes. However, conventional vector indexing structures are not natively tailored to the pronounced network latency and per-request access costs of cloud object stores, resulting in network I/O amplification, degraded query throughput, and higher API expenses.
  To resolve these challenges, we present RemoteANN, a vector search engine explicitly co-designed for cloud object storage across indexing and querying. To mitigate the dominant network I/O bottleneck, RemoteANN couples an Inverted File (IVF) index with RaBitQ quantization, further optimized by inter-cluster and intra-cluster data reordering for improved data locality. Building on this tailored data layout, RemoteANN's query engine combines cluster pruning, fine-grained Range-GET requests, request merging, and local NVMe SSD caching, dramatically reducing discrete storage requests and network transfer volume without sacrificing accuracy. To address the index construction bottleneck, we further develop QGKMeans, which substantially reduces construction latency without compromising clustering quality. Extensive evaluations on real-world datasets demonstrate that, compared with representative baselines, RemoteANN achieves up to a $5.9\times$ throughput speedup while issuing up to $16.1\times$ fewer object storage requests at 97% target recall.
thinking: 该论文针对云对象存储环境下的向量检索系统进行了深度优化，提出了RemoteANN引擎，通过索引结构、查询引擎和构建算法的协同设计，显著提升了检索效率和降低了网络开销。研究在技术层面具有较强的前沿性和创新性，方法严谨，实验验证充分，但其业务落地价值更偏向于特定技术架构下的性能优化，对一般图书馆或信息机构的直接适用性有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出了一种专为云对象存储设计的向量搜索引擎，通过优化索引和查询流程，在保证准确率的同时大幅提升了检索速度并降低了网络请求成本。

title: Bridging Concepts: Multi-Agent Reasoning over Scientific Concept Graphs for High-Impact Research Prediction
abstract:
arXiv:2610.25281v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Within a research community, new topics often emerge when previously unconnected concepts are first studied together. We construct scientific concept graphs (SCGs)--domain knowledge graphs whose nodes are fine-grained research concepts extracted from paper text by LLMs and whose edges capture their co-occurrence in papers--and study the task of forecasting high-impact concept pairs, i.e., discovering concept pairs that are currently unconnected but will have high impact when connected. To this end, we introduce new benchmark datasets constructed from CIKM, KDD, and SIGIR conference papers, with varied prediction settings, including impact forecasting for emerging concepts unseen during training. We propose MiroGraph, a Multi-agent reasoning framework with scientific concept Graphs, in which a feature designer agent designs predictive features for a given concept pair from structural, semantic, and trend perspectives, and then three LLM agents compute the actual feature values from the enclosing subgraph of the concept pair. Using these feature values, a classifier designer agent constructs a classifier that predicts the final impact labels. MiroGraph outperforms various impact forecasting and temporal link prediction methods.
thinking: 该论文采用大语言模型构建科学概念图谱，并引入多智能体框架进行高影响力研究预测，技术前沿性突出。方法设计严谨，在多个会议数据集上验证了有效性，但预测结果的直接业务落地场景尚需进一步明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种基于多智能体框架和科学概念图谱的方法，用于预测未来可能产生高影响力的新兴跨学科概念组合。

title: Where and Why Search-Augmented LLMs Fail When Reasoning over Rapidly Evolving Knowledge
abstract:
arXiv:2610.25323v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: As the world changes, new information is published while older records remain online. This complicates reasoning for large language models (LLMs), which must retrieve evidence and resolve conflicts to determine which information remains valid. Existing evaluations treat information seeking as a black box, revealing little about where and why LLMs fail. To address this gap, we introduce TREK, a suite of three components: TREKTRACE is a plug-and-play framework that attributes failures to specific stages of retrieval and reasoning. We apply it to TREKBENCH-WILD, a meta-benchmark of real-world questions that require complex reasoning over rapidly evolving knowledge. Surprisingly, the main bottleneck is post-retrieval reasoning rather than retrieval: frontier models are often misled by conflicting evidence even after retrieving all the information needed to answer. To study this bottleneck, we build TREKBENCH-CTRL, a controlled benchmark with distractors spanning temporality, relevance, and trustworthiness, and show that benchmarks dominated by outdated distractors substantially underestimate task difficulty. Together, TREK provides a testbed for diagnosing and improving reasoning over rapidly evolving knowledge.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于检索增强大语言模型在处理快速演化知识时的推理瓶颈，通过构建TREK框架和基准测试，揭示了前沿模型在检索后推理阶段的失败原因。其方法设计严谨，包含真实世界和受控基准，但实践应用价值主要面向技术改进而非图书馆业务直接落地。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，大语言模型在处理快速变化知识时，主要瓶颈在于检索后的推理阶段，而非检索本身。
