Abstract: Agentic knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) requires large language models (LLMs) to solve complex questions through multi-turn interactions with a knowledge graph (KG). Outcome-supervised reinforcement learning derives verifiable outcome rewards from final answers but uniformly assigns each rollout's outcome-level advantage to all policy-generated tokens, creating a trajectory-to-operation mismatch since KG operations within a rollout can have varying effects on the search process and final answer. To address this, we propose Outcome-Anchored Credit Reallocation (OACR), which employs a training-only KG-state outcome model to estimate outcome-reward changes between adjacent KG search states and converts them into operation credit, from which token-wise weights are derived. These multiplicative weights reallocate token-level update magnitudes while preserving the sign of the outcome-level advantage at every generated token. Across three benchmarks, OACR achieves stronger overall performance than existing KGQA methods while using fewer inference-time LLM calls and tokens.
thinking: 该论文针对知识图谱问答中的强化学习奖励分配问题，提出了基于结果锚定的信用再分配方法，在技术层面结合了当前前沿的大语言模型与知识图谱交互，方法设计具有创新性。然而，作为一篇预印本论文，其方法严谨性尚未经过同行评议的全面检验，且其业务落地价值目前主要体现在提升特定任务的算法性能上，与图书馆、信息机构等具体业务场景的直接关联性较弱。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种新的信用分配方法，能更有效地指导大语言模型在知识图谱问答任务中的多步推理过程。

title: Budgeted Attack Scheduling for LLM Red-Teaming: The Roles of Static Priors, Semantic Guidance, and Online Feedback
abstract:
arXiv:2610.25897v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: As jailbreak attacks against large language models (LLMs) become increasingly diverse, red-teaming has come to rely on large libraries of jailbreak prompts and attack strategies to evaluate the robustness of victim models and their defense settings. However, attack effectiveness is highly condition-dependent: an attack that succeeds under one victim-defense setting may fail under another, while exhaustively evaluating the full attack library for each setting incurs substantial token and monetary costs. This motivates studying how jailbreak attacks should be prioritized under a limited attempt budget for efficient robustness evaluation. In this work, we formalize this problem as budgeted attack scheduling over a fixed attack library and investigate three complementary signals under a fixed victim-defense condition: (1) static historical attack success rate (ASR) priors; (2) semantic guidance from LLMs; and (3) online feedback from earlier queries. Building on these signals, we design four scheduling strategies and evaluate them across three victim models and three defense settings on GPT-5.2. Extensive experiments clearly characterize the conditions under which each signal is most effective. Historical ASR provides a strong initialization, but its reliability degrades under defense-induced distribution shifts. Semantic guidance consistently improves or matches static prior-based scheduling in the cold-start regime, while online feedback becomes particularly valuable when transferred priors become stale. Semantic guidance and online feedback can also partially compensate for missing historical priors. Taken together, these findings characterize budgeted red-teaming as an attack scheduling problem in which historical priors, semantic guidance, and online feedback play complementary roles.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于大语言模型红队测试中的攻击调度优化问题，提出了结合静态先验、语义引导和在线反馈三种信号的调度策略，方法设计严谨，实验充分。其技术思路具有前沿性，但研究成果主要面向模型安全评估这一特定技术环节，在图情领域的直接业务落地价值有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究通过结合历史成功率、语义引导和在线反馈三种信号，优化了在有限尝试次数下对大语言模型进行红队测试的攻击调度策略。

title: Enriching Patent Claim Generation with European Patent Dataset
abstract:
arXiv:2505.12568v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Drafting patent claims is time-intensive, costly, and requires professional skill. Therefore, researchers have investigated large language models (LLMs) to assist inventors in writing claims. However, existing work has largely relied on datasets from the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO). To enlarge research scope regarding various jurisdictions, drafting conventions, and legal standards, we introduce EPD, a European patent dataset. EPD presents rich textual data and structured metadata to support multiple patent-related tasks, including claim generation. This dataset enriches the field in three critical aspects: (1) Jurisdictional diversity: Patents from different offices vary in legal and drafting conventions. EPD fills a critical gap by providing a benchmark of European patents to enable more comprehensive evaluation. (2) Quality improvement: EPD offers high-quality granted patents with finalized and legally approved texts, whereas others consist of patent applications that are unexamined or provisional. Experiments show that LLMs fine-tuned on EPD significantly outperform those trained on previous datasets and even GPT-4o in claim quality and cross-domain generalization. (3) Real-world simulation: We propose a difficult subset of EPD to better reflect real-world challenges. Results reveal that all tested LLMs perform substantially worse on challenging samples, which highlights the need for future research.
thinking: 该论文通过构建欧洲专利数据集（EPD）来丰富专利权利要求生成的训练数据，弥补了现有研究过度依赖美国专利数据的不足，体现了数据多样性的价值。研究采用LLM微调实验验证了EPD在提升生成质量和跨领域泛化能力上的优势，方法较为严谨，但作为数据集构建类研究，其前沿技术应用主要体现在数据资源的贡献上，而非方法论的突破。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究构建了一个高质量的欧洲专利数据集，用于训练大语言模型，能显著提升自动生成专利权利要求的质量和实际应用能力。

title: The Super Emotion Dataset
abstract:
arXiv:2505.15348v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Despite the wide-scale usage and development of emotion classification datasets in NLP, the field lacks a standardized, large-scale resource that follows a psychologically grounded taxonomy. Existing datasets either use inconsistent emotion categories, suffer from limited sample size, or focus on specific domains. The SuperEmotion dataset addresses this gap by harmonizing diverse text sources into a unified framework based on Shaver's empirically validated emotion taxonomy, enabling more consistent cross-domain emotion recognition research. This report describes version 2 of the dataset. We also report baseline results for a fine-tuned ModernBERT encoder.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于构建一个基于心理学验证分类法的大规模标准化情感数据集，采用现代BERT模型进行基线实验，技术方法较为前沿。然而，作为数据集构建报告，其直接应用于图书馆等业务场景的路径尚不明确，且方法论部分主要描述数据整合过程，对样本代表性、偏差控制等严谨性细节的讨论有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究构建了一个基于心理学分类的大规模标准化文本情感数据集，为跨领域情感分析研究提供了统一资源。

title: Reasoning for Hierarchical Text Classification: The Case of Patents
abstract:
arXiv:2510.07167v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Hierarchical text classification (HTC) assigns documents to multiple levels of a pre-defined taxonomy. Automated patent subject classification represents one of the hardest HTC scenarios because of professional difficulties and extensive labels. Prior approaches only output a flat label set, which offers little insight into the reason behind predictions. Therefore, we propose Reasoning for Hierarchical Classification (RHC), a novel framework that reformulates HTC as a step-by-step reasoning task to sequentially deduce hierarchical labels. RHC trains large language models (LLMs) in two stages: a cold-start stage that aligns outputs with chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning format and a reinforcement learning (RL) stage to enhance multi-step reasoning ability. RHC demonstrates four advantages in our experiments. (1) Effectiveness: RHC surpasses previous baselines and outperforms the supervised fine-tuning counterparts by approximately 3% in accuracy and macro F1. (2) Explainability: RHC produces natural-language justifications before prediction to facilitate human inspection. (3) Scalability: RHC scales favorably with model size with larger gains compared to standard fine-tuning. (4) Applicability: Beyond patents, we further demonstrate that RHC achieves state-of-the-art performance on other widely used HTC benchmarks, which highlights its broad applicability.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于大语言模型的层次文本分类推理框架，在专利分类这一复杂场景中取得了优于基线方法的性能，并具备良好的可解释性。其方法结合了思维链对齐和强化学习，技术路径前沿且设计严谨，但作为预印本论文，其实际在图书馆或信息机构业务中的落地路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种让大语言模型通过逐步推理来完成专利等复杂文档层次分类的新方法，效果优于传统方式且能提供解释。

title: PaperAudit-Bench: Benchmarking Error Detection in Research Papers for Critical Automated Peer Review
abstract:
arXiv:2601.19916v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent peer reviews but often miss sparse, subtle, and document-level scientific errors. We introduce PaperAudit-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating paper-level error detection and error-aware automated review. It comprises (1) PaperAudit-Dataset, 220 high-quality AI/ML papers containing more than 2,200 controlled synthetic errors across eight categories, and (2) PaperAudit-Review, an evidence-aware framework that links structured error detection to review generation. Experiments across models, error categories, paper sections, and analysis depths show that sparse long-context auditing remains challenging for current LLMs. Conditioning review generation on explicit, manuscript-grounded error evidence produces more conservative and discriminative assessments that align more closely with human judgments than representative automated-review baselines. The dataset also supports post-training compact detectors through SFT and RL; Qwen3-14B achieves 55.8% F1 at Detection@1 under a fixed held-out protocol. A PubPeer transfer study and deployment in ScienceOne, a scientific foundation-model platform led by the Chinese Academy of Sciences, further illustrate practical applicability.
  Code and Dataset Page: https://github.com/TU2021/PaperAudit
  ScienceOne Manuscript Review: https://www.scienceone.cn/lit/#/assistant
affiliations: Academy of Sciences, further illustrate practical applicability.
thinking: 该论文构建了用于评估论文级错误检测的基准数据集和框架，采用了前沿的大语言模型技术，并设计了严谨的实验验证方法。其不足在于基准数据集规模相对有限，且主要针对AI/ML领域，在其他学科的泛化能力有待验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究构建了一个用于评估大语言模型检测科研论文错误能力的基准，并证明基于明确错误证据的审稿生成更接近人类判断。

title: Multi-Perspective Evidence Synthesis and Reasoning for Unsupervised Multimodal Entity Linking
abstract:
arXiv:2604.20283v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Multimodal Entity Linking (MEL) is a fundamental task in data management that maps ambiguous mentions with diverse modalities to the multimodal entities in a knowledge base. However, most existing MEL approaches primarily focus on optimizing instance-centric features and evidence, leaving broader forms of evidence and their intricate interdependencies insufficiently explored. Motivated by the observation that human expert decision-making process relies on multi-perspective judgment, in this work, we propose MSR-MEL, a Multi-perspective Evidence Synthesis and Reasoning framework with Large Language Models (LLMs) for unsupervised MEL. Specifically, we adopt a two-stage framework: (1) Offline Multi-Perspective Evidence Synthesis constructs a comprehensive set of evidence. This includes instance-centric evidence capturing the instance-centric multimodal information of mentions and entities, group-level evidence that aggregates neighborhood information, lexical evidence based on string overlap ratio, and statistical evidence based on simple summary statistics. A core contribution of our framework is the synthesis of group-level evidence, which effectively aggregates vital neighborhood information by graph. We first construct LLM-enhanced contextualized graphs. Subsequently, different modalities are jointly aligned through an asymmetric teacher-student graph neural network. (2) Online Multi-Perspective Evidence Reasoning leverages the power of LLM as a reasoning module to analyze the correlation and semantics of the multi-perspective evidence to induce an effective ranking strategy for accurate entity linking without supervision. Extensive experiments on widely used MEL benchmarks demonstrate that MSR-MEL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art unsupervised methods. The source code of this paper was available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MSR-MEL-C21E/.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种融合多视角证据的无监督多模态实体链接框架，并利用大语言模型进行推理，在技术前沿性和方法创新性上表现突出。然而，作为一篇计算机领域的技术论文，其与图书馆情报领域的具体业务场景结合不够紧密，实践应用价值有待进一步转化和验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种结合大语言模型与图神经网络的无监督多模态实体链接框架，通过融合多视角证据提升了链接准确性。

title: Trust Before Fusion: QIMG-7 and Source-Aware Resolution for Polluted Multimodal RAG
abstract:
arXiv:2607.10798v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is often evaluated with clean evidence, yet real retrieval can return topically relevant but unreliable content: false text and misleading images from corrupted metadata, entity swaps, typographic overlays, semantic edits, adversarial patches, blends, or style transfer. We introduce QIMG-7, a controlled benchmark for multimodal retrieval pollution in multi-sentence factual QA, spanning four datasets, seven image-attack families, and 16 paired clean/polluted regimes, for 1,760 evaluation rows per method. Across four generator/gate stacks, naive multimodal fusion is brittle: in the main gpt-4o-mini stack, Full-MM support drops from 0.908 with clean text to 0.490 with polluted text, often making Parametric fallback safer than retrieval. We propose source-aware trust resolution (SATR), a training-free approach that compares Parametric, Text-only, and Full-MM candidate answers and selects among candidate answers or falls back based on source reliability. The Field-Selector variant achieves the best balanced score, 0.816, improving over Full-MM by 11.7 points and over the Cascaded Router by 2.7 points. Ablations show that, in this text-first setting, explicit text-reliability modeling is the dominant driver of these gains. Overall, in text-first factual QA with multimodal retrieval conflict, our results support selective trust rather than unconditional fusion. Artifacts are available at https://github.com/SaadElDine/Trust_Before_Fusion.
thinking: 该论文针对多模态检索增强生成中的信息污染问题，提出了一个系统性的基准测试集QIMG-7和一种免训练的源感知信任解决方案，在方法上具有创新性和严谨性。其研究聚焦于大模型应用中的现实痛点，技术前沿性高，方法论通过构建多样化污染场景和对比实验得到了充分验证。然而，其实践价值目前主要体现在为未来的检索系统或RAG框架设计提供理论参考和评估工具，直接面向图书馆等传统信息机构的落地路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种在信息被污染的多模态检索场景中，通过评估来源可信度来选择或回退答案的方法，以提升大模型事实问答的可靠性。

title: Toward Automated Detection of Documentation Inconsistencies in Electronic Health Records
abstract:
arXiv:2607.22954v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Objective:To characterize the kinds of internal documentation inconsistencies a general-domain large language model (LLM) can surface from real-world discharge summaries, and to identify recurring failure modes that limit reliability at scale. Materials and Methods: We applied a two-stage LLM pipeline---open-ended candidate identification (Gemini 2.5 Pro) followed by context-grounded verification (Gemini 2.5 Flash)---to 3000 MIMIC-IV-Note discharge summaries drawn as three contiguous 1000-note batches from distinct positions in the corpus. Two clinicians independently reviewed a domain-stratified sample of 268 retained candidates; a third adjudicated disagreements.
  Results: Stage~1 proposed 11333 candidates; 3461 were retained after Stage~2 verification---machine-generated candidates---with at least one in 69.7% of admissions. Medication (43.2%) and diagnosis or clinical-finding (25.3%) candidates predominated. In the reviewed sample, reviewers agreed on 91.0\% of candidates, and 253 of 268 (94.4\%) were judged valid after adjudication. Representative examples from all seven domains carried direct implications for clinical reasoning or patient safety. Review also revealed recurring failure modes involving temporal reasoning, evolving diagnoses, and outpatient-prescribing conventions.
  Discussion: Detection is highly context-dependent: judging a flagged pair requires locating each statement and assessing whether the conflict reflects a true contradiction or missing context. We propose a graded ontology spanning strict contradiction, ambiguity, and gap, with a schema characterizing each flagged case by type, section, scope, domain, attribute, and inconsistency axis.
  Conclusion: This formative study establishes a methodological foundation and conceptual framework to guide subsequent validated, large-scale EHR-inconsistency analysis.
thinking: 该论文采用两阶段大语言模型流水线（Gemini 2.5 Pro/Flash）对真实电子健康记录（EHR）进行文档不一致性检测，技术方法具有前沿性。研究基于大规模临床文本（MIMIC-IV-Note）并引入临床专家人工评审验证，方法严谨，其构建的分类本体和框架对后续研究有指导意义。然而，其应用场景（EHR）虽与信息组织相关，但更偏向临床信息学，在图情领域的直接业务落地场景有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究利用大语言模型流水线，在电子健康记录中自动检测出大量药物、诊断等方面的文档不一致问题，并构建了分类框架。

title: Security and Privacy Taxonomy Generation from Mobile App Reviews
abstract:
arXiv:2608.09049v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Mobile app reviews are a rich, continuously renewing source of how users experience privacy and security, yet existing taxonomies of these concerns are hand-crafted and cannot keep pace with the evolving nature of the data. Automating taxonomy construction is the natural response, but scalability is the core challenge: current LLM- and clustering-based methods are developed for scientific corpora of a few thousand documents and do not extend to app review collections numbering in the hundreds of thousands. We address this gap in two ways. First, we filter app reviews for privacy- and security-related content, yielding a comprehensive corpus of over 600K reviews. Second, we introduce TaxoScale, a pipeline that handles taxonomy construction at this scale by extending an expert-defined taxonomy via Recursive Hierarchical Clustering and LLM-based node naming. TaxoScale outperforms strong automatic-taxonomy baselines on path, level, coverage, and novelty metrics, and discovers novel branches absent from prior taxonomies. We publicly release our code and data to support reproducibility and future research.
thinking: 论文提出了一种自动化构建移动应用隐私安全分类法的方法，通过大规模数据处理和LLM辅助节点命名，展现了较强的技术前沿性。方法在超过60万条评论上验证，具有较好的严谨性和可复现性，但其业务落地价值主要面向应用开发者或安全分析人员，对图书馆等传统信息机构的直接应用场景有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种能自动从海量应用评论中构建和扩展隐私安全分类法的新方法，并发现了现有分类中未涵盖的新类别。

title: Move by Move: Measuring and Steering How LLMs Conduct Psychotherapy
abstract:
arXiv:2608.21325v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: As the demand for mental health services outpaces clinical workforce capacity, users are increasingly turning to large language models (LLMs) for accessible and private support. Although recent evaluations suggest LLM care can reduce clinical symptoms, how models actually conduct therapeutic interactions compared to trained human clinicians remains largely unknown. Drawing on established clinical psychology frameworks that conceptualize therapy as a sequential decision-making process, we can systematically analyze the conversational interventions used in AI-driven sessions. To achieve this, we introduce an original, clinically validated ontology of ten distinct therapeutic moves to descriptively categorize strategies LLMs favor or neglect. Applying this ontology at scale reveals that models drastically over-use probing, disregard common CBT-favored techniques and are strongly context-anchored. Moreover, we propose exposing these categories as callable tools, bringing models significantly closer to the human clinical baseline.
thinking: 该论文创新性地将临床心理学框架与自然语言处理技术结合，构建了经过临床验证的治疗干预本体，用于系统评估大语言模型在心理治疗对话中的行为模式，方法严谨且具有跨学科前沿性。然而，研究聚焦于通用LLM在模拟治疗场景中的行为分析，其发现如何转化为图书馆或信息服务机构可落地的具体应用（如开发合规的AI咨询工具或制定服务指南）尚不明确，实践路径有待进一步阐述。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究通过一套临床治疗干预本体，系统揭示了大语言模型在模拟心理治疗对话中过度使用探查、忽视标准技术等与人类临床实践存在显著偏差的行为模式。

title: LoGRA: Scaling LLM Reinforcement Learning with Low-Rank Gradient Sketches
abstract:
arXiv:2610.06647v3 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Reinforcement learning has greatly advanced the capabilities of large language models, but its memory demands remain a barrier to broader adoption. We introduce LoGRA, an approach to RL post-training that reduces memory by retaining useful learning signals in low-rank gradient sketches. These compact representations support both model updates and efficient policy synchronization. To prevent overly large updates from disrupting learning, we complement gradient compression with predicted-KL step control, which estimates policy changes before applying each update and adjusts its magnitude accordingly. With all techniques combined, LoGRA reduces average training memory usage by up to 45.7% across reasoning tasks without compromising performance. It also enables stable training of a 27B-parameter model for over 1,100 steps on a single eight-GPU node, where dense Adam runs out of memory, making previously memory-infeasible RL training practical. Code is available in the \href{https://github.com/skzhang1/labs-molt/tree/logra/examples/scripts/logra}{Molt library}.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种用于大语言模型强化学习的低秩梯度压缩方法，在保持性能的同时显著降低了内存消耗，技术方案具有创新性。然而，论文主要聚焦于算法层面的优化，并未讨论其在图情领域的具体应用场景，因此其实践价值在本领域内尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种名为LoGRA的低秩梯度压缩方法，能大幅降低大语言模型强化学习训练的内存需求。

title: Toollery: Scaling LLM Agents to Thousands of Skills and Tools
abstract:
arXiv:2609.22218v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: As LLM agents are exposed to hundreds to tens of thousands of skills, tools, and API functions, full-library prompting becomes costly, slow, and less reliable: each added candidate increases prompt tokens and latency, while longer candidate lists introduce more distractors for LLM selection. We present Toollery, a training-free candidate-compression framework for scalable LLM skill/tool selection. Following established document-side query expansion, Toollery generates user-intent queries from each skill/tool specification and builds a retrieval index that maps real user requests to compact candidate sets before final LLM decision-making. By treating high-level skills and atomic tools as selectable capabilities, Toollery can be applied to both skill libraries and tool registries. We evaluate Toollery on the roughly 79K-capability SkillRouter benchmark, BFCL-V4 with over 440 atomic tools, and 3,396 proprietary smart-cockpit requests over 220 tools. Across these settings, Toollery keeps online selection bounded to a compact top-K candidate set and improves recall over ordinary specification retrieval. At a fixed top-10 budget, Toollery improves end-to-end selection on the cockpit dataset, and maintains comparable AST Accuracy on BFCL-V4. These results support Toollery as a practical candidate-compression framework for large and evolving agent capability libraries, while showing that quality and cost gains depend on workload coverage and provider caching.
thinking: 论文提出了一种面向大规模技能/工具库的LLM智能体候选压缩框架，通过生成用户意图查询并建立检索索引来提升选择效率，方法新颖且针对性强。研究在多个大规模数据集上进行了评估，方法严谨性较好，但其前沿技术度因未涉及模型训练而略有不足，且业务落地值受限于特定应用场景。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种无需训练的框架，通过检索索引压缩候选集，有效提升了大型语言模型在超大规模技能库中选择工具的效率和准确性。

title: Understanding Personalization Gains in Whisper ASR
abstract:
arXiv:2610.17019v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Whisper-style ASR models provide strong zero-shot transcription, but their residual errors are not evenly distributed across datasets, recording conditions, and metadata-based groups. We study when lightweight low-rank adaptation (LoRA) improves Whisper and whether observed gains require group-specific adapters. Across Common Voice, LibriSpeech, and VoxPopuli, we compare zero-shot Whisper, pooled LoRA, and group-specific LoRA under matched within-group splits. We find that adaptation is not uniformly beneficial: gains are concentrated in difficult Common Voice groups, are consistent on VoxPopuli, and largely disappear on low-error LibriSpeech. Crucially, pooled LoRA often matches, and sometimes clearly outperforms, group-specific LoRA. Gains over zero-shot should therefore be tested against matched pooled adaptation before being interpreted as evidence of personalization.
thinking: 该论文针对Whisper ASR模型，系统研究了轻量化LoRA适配在不同数据集和条件下的效果，方法设计严谨，通过控制组内分割进行公平比较。其核心发现——池化适配常与分组适配效果相当——对实际应用中的模型优化策略具有直接指导意义，但所采用的技术（LoRA微调）虽属前沿，在NLP领域已较为常见。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，对Whisper语音识别模型进行轻量微调时，一个通用适配器的效果常常与为不同群体定制多个适配器的效果相当。

title: Causal overclaiming is common, rising over time, and difficult to avoid
abstract:
Academic scholarship is meant to proportion claims to evidence, yet scholars can and do oversell their findings. Is it possible for authors and journals change?

The post Causal overclaiming is common, rising over time, and difficult to avoid first appeared on LSE Impact.
thinking: 该资讯探讨学术研究中因果性夸大宣称的现象及其趋势，虽然主题涉及学术诚信和出版实践，与图情领域的研究评估、学术传播有一定关联，但直接针对图书馆核心业务（如资源建设、信息服务）的关联度较弱。其信息价值在于提示图情从业者关注学术成果的质量评估问题。
one_sentence_summary: 一篇博客文章指出，学术研究中夸大因果关系的现象普遍且呈上升趋势，并探讨了改变的难度。

title: Algorithmic Hegemony and the Coding of Gender: An Integrative Review of Artificial Intelligence Translucency in the Brazilian Scientific Ecosystem
abstract: ENGLISH RESEARCH INFORMATION Systematized research materials produced as part of a study on gender bias in Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems and its implications for the Brazilian scientific ecosystem. The study was conducted through an integrative literature review using the OpenAlex database and covering publications from 2023 to 2026. After applying the selection criteria, 23 publications were analyzed, focusing on manifestations of algorithmic bias, the technical and sociocultural factors associated with its emergence, and strategies proposed to mitigate bias and promote greater equity in AI systems. The research identified manifestations of gender bias across different AI application contexts, including healthcare, education, financial systems, and natural language processing. The factors discussed include historically biased datasets, limited diversity within development teams, reproduction of sociocultural structures, and limitations in the representation of different identities. Mitigation strategies identified in the literature include diversity, equity, and inclusion approaches; participatory design; curricular reforms; critical algorithmic literacy; and the development of technological and legal governance mechanisms. SCIENTIFIC OUTPUT Complete content of the scientific paper produced from the research, including its theoretical foundations, integrative review methodology, results, discussion of the evidence, and conclusions. The findings are organized around three research questions concerning manifestations of gender bias in AI applications, their technical and sociocultural origins, and strategies proposed for their mitigation within the Brazilian context. REPRODUCIBILITY AND PROVENANCE The research materials are made available to promote reproducibility, provenance, transparency, and scientific traceability throughout the research process. Their availability contributes to documenting the review procedures, the evidence analyzed, and the scientific outputs derived from the study. DECLARATION OF THE USE OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE TOOLS Generative Artificial Intelligence tools were used exclusively for operational support: ChatGPT for the selection and evaluation of Boolean operators; Gemini for spelling and grammatical revision; and Claude for confirming, validating, and structuring references according to ABNT standards. All other stages, including analysis, interpretation, synthesis, and conclusions, were developed by the authors, who assume full responsibility for the scientific content. ACKNOWLEDGMENTS AND ADDITIONAL INFORMATION This study was financed in part by the Coordenação de Aperfeiçoamento de Pessoal de Nível Superior – Brasil (CAPES) – Finance Code 001. This paper was approved through peer review for the 3rd National Congress of Education and Scientific Production (III CONAPEC), held from October 19 to 22, 2026, and organized by the Sociedade Brasileira de Eventos Científicos (SOBREC). Although approved through the scientific peer-review process, the paper was not subsequently incorporated into the official conference proceedings because the financial requirements associated with formal publication could not be met. Documentation confirming the peer-review approval is provided as an attachment. HOW TO CITE CLARO FREIRE, Evandro; COUTO, Weslley de Souza. Algorithmic Hegemony and the Coding of Gender: An Integrative Review of Artificial Intelligence Translucency in the Brazilian Scientific Ecosystem. In: 3rd National Congress of Education and Scientific Production (III CONAPEC), [online], 19–22 Oct. 2026. Sociedade Brasileira de Eventos Científicos (SOBREC), 2026 DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23091322. Algorithmic Hegemony and the Coding of Gender: An Integrative Review of Artificial Intelligence Translucency in the Brazilian Scientific Ecosystem. Zenodo, 2026. DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23091322. PORTUGUÊS INFORMAÇÕES DA PESQUISA Materiais sistematizados da pesquisa desenvolvida sobre vieses de gênero em sistemas de Inteligência Artificial (IA) e suas implicações no ecossistema científico brasileiro. O estudo foi conduzido por meio de revisão integrativa da literatura, com consulta à base OpenAlex e recorte temporal entre 2023 e 2026. Após aplicação dos critérios de seleção, foram analisadas 23 publicações, considerando manifestações de vieses algorítmicos, fatores técnicos e socioculturais associados à sua formação e estratégias propostas para mitigação e promoção de maior equidade nos sistemas de IA. A pesquisa identificou manifestações de viés em diferentes contextos de aplicação da IA, incluindo saúde, educação, sistemas financeiros e processamento de linguagem natural. Entre os fatores discutidos estão conjuntos de dados historicamente enviesados, baixa diversidade nas equipes de desenvolvimento, reprodução de estruturas socioculturais e limitações na representação de diferentes identidades. Como estratégias de mitigação, a literatura analisada apresenta abordagens relacionadas à diversidade, equidade e inclusão, design participativo, reformas curriculares, letramento crítico em algoritmos e desenvolvimento de mecanismos de governança tecnológica e jurídica. PRODUÇÃO CIENTÍFICA Conteúdo integral do artigo científico produzido a partir da pesquisa, incluindo fundamentação teórica, metodologia da revisão integrativa, resultados, discussão das evidências e conclusões. O trabalho organiza os resultados em torno de três questões de pesquisa relacionadas às manifestações dos vieses de gênero em aplicações de IA, às suas origens técnicas e socioculturais e às estratégias propostas para sua mitigação no contexto brasileiro. REPRODUTIBILIDADE E PROVENIÊNCIA Os materiais associados à pesquisa são disponibilizados com o objetivo de favorecer a reprodutibilidade, proveniência, transparência e rastreabilidade científica do processo de investigação. A disponibilização dos materiais permite documentar os procedimentos de revisão, as evidências analisadas e os produtos científicos derivados do estudo. DECLARAÇÃO DE USO DE FERRAMENTAS DE INTELIGÊNCIA ARTIFICIAL Foram utilizadas ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial Generativa exclusivamente como suporte operacional: ChatGPT na seleção e avaliação dos operadores booleanos; Gemini para revisão ortográfica e gramatical; e Claude para confirmação, validação e estruturação das referências segundo as normas ABNT. As demais etapas, incluindo análise, interpretação, síntese e conclusão, foram desenvolvidas pelos autores, que assumem integral responsabilidade pelo conteúdo científico produzido. AGRADECIMENTOS E INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS O presente trabalho foi realizado com apoio da Coordenação de Aperfeiçoamento de Pessoal de Nível Superior – Brasil (CAPES) – Código de Financiamento 001. O artigo foi aprovado por meio de processo de avaliação por pares (peer review) para o III Congresso Nacional de Educação e Produção Científica (III CONAPEC), realizado entre os dias 19 e 22 de outubro de 2026, sob realização da Sociedade Brasileira de Eventos Científicos (SOBREC). Embora aprovado no processo de avaliação científica, o trabalho não foi posteriormente incorporado aos anais oficiais do evento em decorrência da inviabilidade de atendimento aos encargos financeiros requeridos para a formalização de sua publicação. title: Star Light, Star Bright: Can Multimodal Models Parse an Astronomy Visual Question Answering Dataset Right?
abstract:
arXiv:2610.22474v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Figures are essential for scientific communication, and the field of Visual Question Answering (VQA) aims to test the figure understanding capabilities of large multimodal models (LMMs). Here, we investigate the accuracy of several low-cost LMMs on domain-specific VQA tasks for astronomical images of the sky. As instrument for this task we build a domain-specific VQA dataset comprising 2001 partially-synthetic figures divided evenly between contour plots, real telescope images drawn from NASA's SkyView, and "fake" sky images which share the axes and angular scales of the real images but draw their colors from a gaussian mixture model, alongside 47357 questions. Each figure is released as pristine and with realistic page-aging degradations mimicking the historical astronomical corpus. Testing three low-cost proprietary LMMs, we find models frequently fail to answer domain-specific questions at high accuracy. An initial comparison with 104 human-verified, astrometrically tagged figures from historical journal publications shows similar median errors in angular extent. All code is available on GitHub: https://github.com/jnaiman/SkyImagesWASP2026 and dataset is available on HuggingFace: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ReadingTimeMachine/astro_sky_image_vqa.
thinking: 该论文构建了天文学领域的视觉问答数据集，并评估了低成本多模态模型在专业图像理解任务上的表现，方法严谨且数据公开。然而，研究聚焦于特定领域模型的局限性，其技术方法本身（使用现有LMMs进行评估）并非最前沿，且研究成果直接转化为图书馆或信息机构业务实践的应用路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，当前低成本的多模态大模型在理解专业天文学图像并回答相关问题时，准确率仍然有限。

title: NoveltyScope: A Multi-Agent Research Assistant for Evidence-Grounded Novelty Assessment of Scientific Papers
abstract:
arXiv:2610.22703v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: NoveltyScope is a prototype that compares a scientific paper with retrieved prior work and produces a structured report and a five-level novelty score. The system extracts the core task and at most two author-claimed contributions, then searches a closed local corpus using BM25 and dense retrieval with reciprocal rank fusion. Contribution comparisons request paired passages for potential refutations, and quotations are checked against cached source text. Four scoring roles (Prosecutor, Defender, Judge, and Critic) use the resulting evidence, with at most one revision of the Judge's score. Evaluation uses 50 class-balanced RINoBench samples whose idea-level labels are retained for full-paper input. Mean absolute error is 1.48 and 1.26 for single-LLM and multi-agent scoring with Gemini, respectively, and 1.22 and 1.16 with Qwen3. The vector-similarity baseline has an error of 1.68. A HiCLIP case study illustrates the contribution comparisons and paired evidence passages. Overall, the results demonstrate the feasibility of evidence-grounded novelty assessment and show that the multi-agent configurations achieve lower scoring errors than their single-LLM counterparts across both evaluated models.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于多智能体框架的学术论文新颖性评估系统，采用了检索增强生成（RAG）和智能体协作等前沿技术，方法设计较为系统。其评估基于人工标注的基准数据集，并进行了基线对比，方法严谨性较好。然而，该系统目前为原型，其检索范围限定于本地封闭语料库，在真实、开放的学术评估场景中的直接落地应用价值尚需进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究开发了一个基于多智能体框架的系统，能够通过检索和比对相关文献，为科学论文提供证据支持的新颖性评估报告和评分。

title: Reasoning Reranking with Semantic IDs as the Sole Item Representation
abstract:
arXiv:2610.22797v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Reasoning rerankers write a rationale before ranking a candidate slate, and existing systems read item metadata to do so, even though generative recommenders increasingly represent items as compact Semantic IDs (SIDs). Ranking from SIDs alone has two appeals: SID prompts are far shorter than the matched item text, and although item codes are fixed from content, the backbone learns their token embeddings in part from user-item interaction sequences, so the tokens can carry behavioral signal that item text lacks. That training targets next-item generation, and whether it supports ranking a supplied slate from SIDs alone is untested. We build ReRankID, a controlled testbed in which models reason and rank from a history and slate shown only as SIDs, varying item rendering, history length, and slate size one at a time. On this testbed, such models often copy the input order instead of reranking, and readable metadata does not repair the failure. We compare supervised fine-tuning, rejection-sampled self-training, on-policy distillation, and verifier-based reinforcement learning as post-training methods and find that they elicit the missing behavior. The strongest post-trained model, the 8B model trained with a graded ranking reward, gives the best SID-only ranking and matches strong text-reading LLMs whose prompts are about 20x longer. It ranks above random with no history at all, where a caption-reading reference does not, and it keeps its gains at long histories, where text prompts pass 50k tokens and the caption-reading reference stops improving. In a paired rationale audit, this model argues trade-offs better than that reference but describes items less accurately. The common post-training methods we test thus elicit ranking from SIDs but not faithful item descriptions, which calls for post-training that improves the reasoning itself, not only the ranking it produces.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于使用语义ID作为唯一项目表示进行推理重排，探索了生成式推荐系统的新范式，技术前沿性突出。研究设计了严谨的对比实验框架，评估了多种后训练方法，方法学上较为规范。但其核心贡献在于方法论的验证与比较，直接面向图书馆或信息机构的具体业务场景的实践价值尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，通过特定后训练方法，仅使用紧凑的语义ID就能实现与阅读长文本相当的推荐排序效果。

title: Jev-as-a-Judge for Brazilian Portuguese Information Retrieval: Relevance Assessment and Reranking
abstract:
arXiv:2610.23346v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: This study investigates Jev, a System One model designed for fast, structured decision-making, in information retrieval. We use Jev-as-a-judge to generate relevance judgments for four Brazilian Portuguese IR collections covering different domains and compare them with the official relevance judgments of each collection. We also evaluate Jev as a reranker. For relevance assessment, exact agreement ranged from 52.9% to 64.9%, while quadratic weighted Cohen's kappa ranged from 0.52 to 0.82. Most disagreements involved adjacent relevance levels, with at least 94.5% of annotations matching exactly or differing by only one relevance level. Despite differences at the individual query--document level, Jev-generated qrels produced similar retrieval system rankings, with Kendall's tau ranging from 0.90 to 0.93 for NormasTCU and Ulysses-RFCorpus across the two evaluation metrics. For reranking, Jev reordered the top 1,000 BM25 candidates for each of the 50 Quati test queries, increasing nDCG@10 from 0.3329 to 0.6331 (+90.2%) and MRR from 0.6852 to 0.9033 (+31.8%). These findings support Jev as a relevance assessor and show improved ranking effectiveness over BM25 in the evaluated reranking setting.
thinking: 该论文将前沿的System One模型Jev应用于巴西葡萄牙语信息检索，在相关性评估和重排序任务上进行了实证检验，方法规范且结果显著。其局限性在于评估的语料库和查询集规模有限，且未与其他先进的LLM-as-a-judge方法进行充分比较。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，Jev模型能有效评估巴西葡萄牙语检索结果的相关性，并能显著提升BM25检索结果的排序质量。

title: QD-Rec: Open-Ended Evolution of Recommendations via Quality-Diversity
abstract:
arXiv:2610.23470v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Open-ended search combined with foundation models has produced advances such as faster algorithms, new results on open mathematical problems, and self-improving agents. We extend this paradigm to recommendation for decision-making, focusing on decisions where the set of possible choices is fixed but the reasons for choosing them are not. In high-stakes decisions, e.g., which company to acquire or which customer to target, comparing diverse, well-reasoned options can be more useful than a single ranked list. We formalize open-ended recommendation as building a diverse, high-quality set of recommendations, each an item together with a hypothesis, a natural-language reason why the item fits the needs of a decision maker. We propose QD-Rec, a quality--diversity method that selects items with a contextual bandit and generates hypotheses with a foundation model from earlier ones kept in an archive as stepping stones. A new recommendation enters the archive if it is novel or better than its nearest neighbor. Across M&A, customer targeting, and paper and book recommendation, QD-Rec gives the highest mean quality and builds the largest archive in most settings.
thinking: 该论文将质量-多样性优化与基础模型结合，应用于推荐系统，技术方法具有前沿性。研究聚焦于高价值决策场景，提供了可操作的推荐生成框架，但实验验证主要基于模拟数据，在真实业务环境中的落地效果仍需进一步检验。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种结合质量-多样性优化与基础模型的方法，为高价值决策生成附带自然语言理由的多样化推荐选项。

title: LSNR: Learned Sparse News Recommendations with Attentive User Modeling
abstract:
arXiv:2610.23510v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Current learned sparse approaches for recommender systems, such as STAR, represent a user by concatenating their interaction history into a single query string. For news, this creates two bottlenecks: concatenation collapses a user's distinct reading interests into one flat query, and, because news articles are long-form text, concatenating several news articles quickly overruns the context window of the language model used as backbone and forces quality-degrading truncation.
  To address both bottlenecks, we introduce learned sparse news recommendations (LSNR). LSNR encodes each article independently and constructs a sparse user vector by combining learned, attention-based weighting of the per-article sparse representations with a dense-projected expansion at the user level. Experiments on the MIND and EBNeRD datasets show that LSNR significantly outperforms STAR, with these gains holding even in short-history settings where truncation is not a factor. Compared to state-of-the-art dense recommenders, LSNR is competitive in standard settings and it outperforms them when the user history is short. An ablation of the user encoder confirms that learned attention-based aggregation outperforms simpler pooling alternatives. Beyond effectiveness, an additional advantage of LSNR is that it serves from an index an order of magnitude smaller than an uncompressed dense baseline.
thinking: 该论文针对新闻推荐场景中现有学习稀疏方法存在的用户兴趣表示瓶颈和上下文窗口限制问题，提出了LSNR模型，通过独立编码文章并引入注意力机制进行加权聚合，方法设计具有创新性。实验在标准数据集上进行验证，结果显著优于基线模型，方法严谨性较好，且其生成的小规模索引具有实际部署优势。但模型核心仍基于现有语言模型架构，技术突破性有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种新的学习稀疏新闻推荐模型，通过注意力机制更好地建模用户兴趣，并在保持高性能的同时大幅减小了索引规模。

title: Humanity's Last Choice: A Common Evaluation Standard for Generative Engine Optimization
abstract:
arXiv:2610.23541v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Humanity's Last Choice describes the idea that the last choice people need to make is which AI system they entrust with the decisions that follow. These systems rely on external sources that content providers can edit through generative engine optimization (GEO) to increase source visibility and influence recommendations. Choosing among these systems therefore requires comparable evidence of how well they carry out user requests when exposed to GEO. Benchmarks have made progress in standardizing tasks, models, and metrics, but they often define their own spaces of GEO strategies and use different editing constraints. These differences can conflate gains from better optimization algorithms with those from greater freedom to edit sources, while making evaluation coverage difficult to compare across benchmarks. We therefore call for a common evaluation standard and propose a meta-taxonomy that describes where sources are edited, how they are edited, and what signals those edits target. Drawing on representative literature, we map existing strategies into a searchable space and outline a protocol for controlled comparisons with explicit coverage reporting. This provides a foundation for common leaderboards that can inform which systems people choose to rely on.
thinking: 该论文聚焦生成式引擎优化（GEO）这一新兴领域，提出了建立通用评估标准的元分类法和比较协议，具有显著的前沿性。其提出的标准化框架对评估和比较不同AI系统在GEO影响下的表现有直接指导意义，实践价值较高。但作为一篇概念性/框架性论文，其方法严谨性主要体现在理论构建和文献梳理上，缺乏实证数据或具体算法验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出了一套用于评估和比较不同AI系统在生成式引擎优化影响下表现的通用标准与分类框架。

title: AuditKIT: A Unified Evaluation Spine for Benchmarking, Judging, and Comparing Large Language Models and Agentic Systems
abstract:
arXiv:2610.22511v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Evaluating language models and agents requires combining benchmark accuracy, judge-based assessment, runtime performance, tool-use behavior, and retrieval quality. Differences in interfaces, metric semantics, and trace formats complicate these comparisons and can hide failures in agentic workflows. We present AuditKIT, a source-available evaluation library that records these measurements in one result representation, with direction-aware metric contracts, configuration fingerprints, and extensible metrics and backends. For agents, it provides turn-aware tool-call matching, separates parallel from sequential execution, and distinguishes verified task outcomes from trajectory-level diagnostics. Missing or unobservable evidence is marked unscored rather than counted as failure. For retrieval-augmented generation, it combines ranked retrieval metrics, judged grounding, and deterministic evidence checks. Seven case studies spanning model comparison, serving runtimes, retrieval, tool calling, and interoperability show how answer extraction, runtime behavior, and metric selection change evaluation outcomes.
thinking: 该论文提出的AuditKIT是一个用于统一评估大语言模型和智能体系统的框架，其核心贡献在于整合了多种评估维度并设计了标准化的结果表示，这直接回应了当前LLM评估领域方法分散、难以比较的痛点，具有较高的方法学创新性。然而，论文主要聚焦于评估框架本身的技术设计与实现，其与图书馆、信息机构等传统图情业务的直接结合点尚不明确，实践应用价值有待具体场景的转化和验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一个名为AuditKIT的统一评估框架，旨在解决大语言模型和智能体系统在准确性、性能和工具使用等多维度评估中标准不一、难以比较的问题。

title: Improving OCR Accuracy Through Multi-Classifier Verification of Visually Similar Characters
abstract:
arXiv:2610.22726v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Distinguishing visually similar characters is a persistent challenge for optical character recognition (OCR) systems, causing errors in critical applications of text digitization. While preprocessing techniques improve image quality and word-level post-processing corrects spelling errors, neither addresses character-level visual ambiguity, an intrinsic property of certain character pairs that limits even state-of-the-art OCR models. We present the Character Verification Model (CVM), a character-level post-processing framework that verifies and corrects ambiguous characters in OCR outputs using specialized binary classifiers trained on visually confusable pairs such as 'O'/'0', 'Z'/'2', and 'S'/'5'. CVM operates independently of dictionary validation, making it suitable for non-lexical data including serial numbers, alphanumeric codes, and license plates. Experiments on three OCR engines (Tesseract, EasyOCR, TrOCR) and ten fonts with low to high complexity demonstrate accuracy improvements of 3.95-14.81 percentage points, with an 87.3% correction rate for visually similar character errors and a false-correction rate of only 2.3%. The modular architecture integrates with existing OCR pipelines without modification to underlying recognition models.
thinking: 该论文针对OCR中视觉相似字符识别难题，提出了一种基于专用二分类器的字符级后处理框架，在三个主流OCR引擎上验证了其有效性，方法严谨且实验设计全面。然而，其技术方案虽有效但非革命性前沿，且主要针对特定字符对，在通用文本识别场景下的直接应用价值相对有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种字符验证模型，能有效纠正OCR输出中视觉相似的字符错误，提升识别准确率。

title: Code Skill Server: A Large-Scale Search Engine for Code Generation Skills
abstract:
arXiv:2610.23186v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Agent skills have proven to be an effective technique for improving agent ability on specific tasks, including software engineering, natural science, and mathematics. During such a process, using agent skills often involves manually discovering and organizing skills from heterogeneous sources, while existing skill retrieval methods mainly focus on selecting relevant skills from established skill libraries. However, with the rapidly increasing number and variety of reusable agent skills, manually searching for relevant skills across heterogeneous sources is becoming impractical at scale. In this paper, we introduce the Code Skill Server (CSS), a large-scale search engine for finding the most useful code generation skills for a target task. CSS consists of a skill server that incrementally collects and indexes publicly available code generation skills from multiple sources, with 993 skills included in the corpus used in this work. Extensive experiments across different retrieval methods and code generation benchmarks show that the best CSS configuration improves Pass@1 by up to 13.91% and consistently improves all evaluated models by at least 4.21% in the cross-model evaluation. These results demonstrate that CSS can effectively search for and serve relevant skills, improving code generation quality and enhancing models' code generation capabilities. Code and the CSS-993 corpus are available at {https://github.com/haoyuli-sdu/CodeSkillServer}.
thinking: 论文提出一个面向代码生成技能的大规模搜索引擎，采用增量收集和索引技术，并进行了跨模型评估实验，方法较为严谨。但该研究主要聚焦于代码生成这一特定领域，在图情领域的直接业务落地价值有限，且技术前沿性更多体现在检索系统构建而非底层算法创新。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究构建了一个大规模代码生成技能搜索引擎，通过检索和提供相关技能，能有效提升多种大语言模型的代码生成质量。

title: Tool Recommendation for Multi-Step Agents: Finding Every Tool a Task Needs
abstract:
arXiv:2610.23707v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: A multi-step agent task fails when a single tool it needs is missing, yet the tools an agent may need are too many to list: the roughly 8,200 tools on the platform we study have definitions that together exceed the context window of any model we evaluate. We present Tool Recommendation, a deployed system that gives an agent all of them, hundreds of times more than a typical MCP server exposes, through a fixed interface of three tools. It runs at the gateway between agent and tools, executing every call under the end user's own credentials and checking it against the user's consent for each service and the tools the agent may use. We evaluate it on both a public retrieval benchmark and billed end-to-end session cost. On ToolRet, Tool Recommendation places every tool a query needs in the top ten 57% more often than BM25, a lexical ranking that commercial tool search offers, and compares favorably with published systems up to nine times its size. In paired multi-step workflows, its first recommendation covered every required tool in 93% of Codex sessions, and against a fixed list of 100 tools it cut input tokens by 17% with Codex and 40% with Claude Code and the total bill in all 14 runs, by up to 40%, with no change in task completion.
thinking: 论文提出了一种面向多步智能体任务的工具推荐系统，通过固定接口高效提供海量工具，解决了传统方法因上下文窗口限制而无法枚举所有工具的痛点。研究在公开检索基准和实际计费会话成本上进行了评估，方法较为严谨，但其技术核心仍属于检索与排序的优化，前沿性相对有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一个能高效为多步任务智能体推荐所需全部工具的系统，显著提升了工具发现的覆盖率和成本效益。

title: Advertising to Agents: Measuring Description-Framing Bias in LLM Tool Selection
abstract:
arXiv:2605.23916v3 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: AI agents often pick tools from registries, where each provider writes its tool's description; we ask whether sales language there changes which tool an agent picks. We built pairs of listings that differ in one way (praise, a verifiable specification, or list order) and asked two OpenAI models to call one tool. In a preregistered study, stacked praise (four kinds) raised a tool's pick rate by about 43 percentage points, matching or beating a verifiable specification. Praise also pulled some picks toward tools whose numeric limit was too small. With identical listings, the first-listed tool was picked about 72 points more often. Structured fields helped agents pick the capable tool; sales text beside them reduced or erased that gain. An exploratory study of five models shows the same direction; a "Sponsored" label dampened it, and a system-prompt warning moved one model. Registries could list limits as fields, hide sales text from agents, and randomize order. Stacked praise replicated on held-out domains; no single kind did after correcting for multiple tests. Preregistered results are provisional until blind phrase ratings are complete, and cover two small models.
thinking: 该论文采用实验方法系统评估了LLM工具选择中的描述性偏差，研究设计规范且进行了预注册，方法严谨性较高。研究聚焦于AI代理工具选择的实际偏差问题，对工具注册平台的设计具有直接指导意义，但技术前沿性相对有限，主要基于现有模型的测试。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，销售性赞美语言和列表顺序会显著影响大语言模型对工具的选择，甚至可能使其忽略工具的实际功能限制。

title: KGVoyager: Knowledge Graph Agnostic Question Answering via Agentic Navigation
abstract:
arXiv:2609.01780v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Knowledge Graph Question Answering (KGQA) over RDF graphs remains challenging in domain-specific settings, where formal ontologies and curated text-SPARQL pairs are often unavailable. We present KG Voyager, a KG-agnostic agentic architecture that generates SPARQL queries from natural language questions by dynamically discovering graph structure and semantics, requiring only a query endpoint of the underlying graph. Using a think-act-observe loop with search, exploration, and execution tools, KG Voyager maps terms to graph Internationalized Resource Identifiers (IRIs), uncovers structure, and refines queries through execution feedback -- all without pre-existing ontologies or examples. Unlike the prior state of the art, KG Voyager requires only a lightweight class index which renders it applicable for far more real-world endpoints. Across four benchmarks, KG Voyager improves F1 by $\sim$4 points on average compared to the state of the art while cutting cost by $\sim$38% and runtime by $\sim$24%.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种无需预定义本体和训练数据的知识图谱问答方法，通过智能体导航动态探索图谱结构来生成SPARQL查询，在技术方法上具有显著创新性。其实验在四个基准测试中验证了性能提升和效率优势，但作为arXiv预印本尚未经过同行评审，方法细节和可复现性需进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种无需预定义本体即可自动探索知识图谱并回答问题的智能体方法，在多个测试中提升了准确率和效率。

title: UniRec: Cross-stage Multi-Task Fusion with Preference Optimization for Cascaded Recommender Systems
abstract:
arXiv:2609.11052v3 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Industrial recommender systems use cascaded stages with different candidate spaces, data distributions, and latency constraints. Independently optimizing their multi-task fusion (MTF) modules can cause cross-stage preference inconsistency, while existing cross-stage methods mainly transfer supervision to upstream scoring models and leave fusion modules jointly unoptimized.
  We propose UniRec, a Unified Cross-stage Recommendation Fusion framework that jointly optimizes pre-ranking and ranking fusion agents. UniRec employs a coupled dual-agent architecture with partially shared embeddings and stage-specific fusion functions. It further introduces Dual-Axis Preference Optimization to combine stage-local preferences with downstream-to-upstream preference transfer. Attribute Group-Relative Regularization (AGRR) mitigates reward-induced distribution drift by normalizing preference advantages within attribute groups. To improve efficiency, Compact Pairwise Preference Aggregation (CPPA) reduces the objective-dependent pairwise complexity, while Confidence-Aware Pair Pruning (CAPP) further reduces the evaluated pair space.
  Extensive offline and online experiments on a production short-video system demonstrate consistent gains over single-stage fusion and cross-stage coordination baselines. In a nine-week online A/B test, UniRec improves total watch time by $0.675\%$ and app usage time by $0.616\%$, and has been fully deployed in production.
thinking: 论文提出了一种面向工业级级联推荐系统的统一跨阶段融合框架，在架构设计和优化目标上具有创新性，并经过了大规模线上实验验证。其方法严谨，但技术本质仍是对现有深度学习推荐范式的优化，前沿突破性有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种新的跨阶段推荐融合框架，通过联合优化多个推荐阶段，有效提升了工业级短视频系统的用户观看时长和应用使用时间。

title: EKLAV: Elicited Key CoT Learning via Answer only superVision
abstract:
arXiv:2607.25182v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Reasoning distillation trains a student to reproduce both the teacher's chain-of-thought trace and its final answer. We ask whether the trace is better used as privileged training context than as an imitation target. EKLAV keeps the teacher's reasoning in the input sequence but supervises only the final task answer, applying a task-dependent placement that moves part or all of the trace into the prompt. On BRIGHT passage reranking, EKLAV improves average nDCG@10 at all four tested checkpoints across two model families, winning 41 of 48 model-domain comparisons while reducing training compute by up to 31.6% and inference time by up to 32.7%. On four held-out table-reranking benchmarks, it is the best of four conditions on three, exceeding full-trace distillation by 3.0 points and answer-only training without reasoning by 5.5 points on average. Analysis of generated traces reveals that EKLAV students defer their first verbalized verdict later (0.76 vs. 0.44 relative position), reverse fewer decisions (5% vs. 16%), and produce reasoning more predictive of their own rankings than STD-COT's, though less predictive than the base model's. The recipe reuses a fixed teacher corpus, requires no student rollouts or iterative teacher feedback, and applies to both pointwise and listwise formulations. Code and Data are at https://github.com/AdarshSingh7647/Eklavya
thinking: 该论文提出了一种新颖的推理蒸馏方法EKLAV，将教师模型的思维链作为上下文而非模仿目标，在提升信息检索任务性能的同时显著降低了计算成本，方法设计巧妙且实验验证充分。但其研究场景（段落和表格重排序）相对具体，在图书馆与信息科学领域的直接应用路径尚需进一步探索。
one_sentence_summary: 这项研究提出了一种更高效的推理蒸馏方法，能在提升大语言模型检索性能的同时，显著减少训练和推理的计算开销。

title: HeRE: A Novel Benchmark for Hebrew Relation Extraction via LLM-Guided Denoising of Knowledge Graph Alignments
abstract:
arXiv:2610.22542v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: While LLMs demonstrate strong capabilities in English Relation Extraction (RE) tasks, a significant gap remains in assessing their RE performance in low-resource languages, due to a lack of standardized benchmarks. Creating native, language-specific annotated RE benchmarks is expensive and requires human expertise, while relying on translation yields suboptimal, inaccurate datasets that introduce English-centric biases. To tackle this, we propose a scalable, language-agnostic methodology to create RE data by denoising naturally occurring yet noisy alignments of knowledge bases and corresponding texts. We define a proper alignment via a Natural Language Inference (NLI) task, where a relation triplet is entailed by an input text. We empirically assess five denoising strategies, and demonstrate that multilingual models outperform language-specific models in the few-shot LLM setting, while Hebrew-specific encoders remain competitive under NLI fine-tuning and are strongest in the label-free cross-training setting. We further find that prompting in the native language achieves performance on par with or slightly exceeding English prompts, confirming that the pipeline operates naturally in the target language. The best open-weights model, Gemma-4-31B-it (F1\,=\,0.915), matches the best API model, GPT-5.4 (0.921), and reaches F1\,=\,0.844 on a fully held-out, dual-annotated test set. Applying the optimized pipeline, we release HeRE: a novel, massive, 1.5-million-instance silver dataset for Hebrew RE, designed to support data-intensive experimentation and model fine-tuning. HeRE bridges a critical gap in standard Hebrew RE evaluation, while providing the NLP community with a reproducible, language-agnostic pipeline for RE dataset construction in other low-resource settings.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种利用大语言模型去噪知识图谱对齐来构建低资源语言关系抽取数据集的方法，技术路线具有前沿性，特别是对LLM在不同语言提示策略下的性能评估。其贡献在于提供了一个可复现的、语言无关的数据集构建流程，并发布了希伯来语大规模数据集，对低资源语言NLP研究有直接应用价值。研究方法严谨，通过多种去噪策略对比、不同模型设置下的性能评估以及独立测试集验证，确保了结论的可靠性。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种利用大语言模型去噪知识图谱对齐来构建低资源语言关系抽取数据集的新方法，并发布了大规模希伯来语评测数据集。

title: Explore Separately, Adopt Selectively: Execution-Guided Tool Use over Large Tool Libraries
abstract:
arXiv:2610.22688v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language model agents must discover relevant tools from large libraries, e.g., thousands of tools, as new needs arise during task execution. When several candidates could satisfy the same need, execution may be required to identify the relevant one. Investigating candidates in a shared trajectory can leave alternatives unexplored or allow failed attempts to influence subsequent reasoning. To address this, we present BRIA (BRanch-Inspect-Adopt), a simple yet effective agent that temporarily isolates candidate investigations in separate branches. Each branch retrieves and executes tools to investigate its candidate; a task agent inspects the resulting execution evidence and adopts only useful results into its continuing trajectory. BRIA retrieves additional tools as new capability needs arise during task execution. We evaluate BRIA on PlanBench-XL and MCP-Atlas using a shared pool of 1897 tools, three language models, and static and adaptive retrieval baselines. Across all settings, BRIA matches or exceeds the strongest retrieval baseline. On MCP-Atlas, it achieves an average claim score of 89.77, compared with 75.40 for MCP-Zero, a gain of 14.37 percentage points. BRIA also lies on the Pareto frontier for task performance and input-token cost.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种新颖的大语言模型工具调用方法，通过分支隔离机制优化了从海量工具库中探索和选择工具的过程，在技术方法上具有创新性。然而，作为一篇计算机领域的技术论文，其研究场景和方法论与图书馆情报学的具体业务实践（如编目、检索、数据管理）的直接关联性较弱，因此其实践应用价值在本领域内有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种让大语言模型智能体更高效地从数千个工具中探索和选择合适工具的新方法。

title: Thunder-DeID+: Boundary-Aware Korean De-identification from Court Judgments to Broader Sensitive Documents
abstract:
arXiv:2610.22733v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: This study examines the transferability of a de-identification model developed for Korean court judgments to a broader range of sensitive documents, focusing on boundary precision, label granularity, and recall. The agglutinative structure of Korean causes Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) tokenizers to frequently merge Personally Identifiable Information (PII) with adjacent particles, which complicates accurate span recovery. Furthermore, current PII taxonomies lack sufficient granularity for legal texts. To address these issues, this study introduces Thunder-DeID+, which integrates a refined three-tier PII taxonomy with a boundary-aware tokenizer. The tokenizer enhances a pretrained BPE vocabulary by incorporating N-gram and boundary-scoring components to better align token and PII span boundaries. The proposed approach is evaluated using a tokenizer-independent word-segment-level protocol. On full-length judgments, the tokenizer consistently improves W. Strict Typed F1-score from 0.76-0.77 to 0.87-0.88 across four model sizes (150M, 395M, 750M, and 1B), mainly by increasing precision rather than model scale. With fine-tuning on 1,000 broader sensitive documents, the judgment-trained model further achieves 0.93 W. Strict Typed F1-score, indicating effective transfer beyond court judgments.
thinking: 该论文针对韩语文本去标识化中的边界对齐问题，提出了一种结合改进的PII分类体系和边界感知分词器的技术方案，在多个模型规模上均显著提升了性能，方法严谨且具有明确的工程价值。然而，其核心技术（BPE、N-gram）并非当前最前沿的NLP范式，且应用场景（韩语法律文书）相对特定，限制了其前沿技术度和在更广泛业务场景的普适性。

title: Bengali Hallucination Detection with Retrieval and Programs: A System Study
abstract:
arXiv:2610.22892v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Bengali hallucination detection must distinguish unsupported factual claims from incorrect reasoning, often without a supplied reference passage. We present and characterize an inference-only system that combines response-conditioned query rewriting, hybrid retrieval, and task-specific language-model judging. Six retrieval routes search question-answer and passage collections; a router directs each example to a 27B textual judge or a 14B agent that can compare retrieved answers, reason directly, or generate and execute Python. We characterize the system using version-specific code, saved predictions, execution traces, and corpus metadata from the Olikbochon challenge. Kaggle associates a displayed private macro-F1 of 0.956 with Version 2; its saved run processes 2,516 examples in 220.99 minutes on two T4 GPUs. Of 253 math-routed examples, 88 terminate through candidate matching, while execution traces expose 49 stderr-bearing run events across 35 examples. A later run changes six predictions despite identical core worker code. A bounded audit of 1,090 benchmark-related corpus records finds exact question or context overlap for 38 processed evaluation inputs, precluding an unqualified claim of corpus-independent generalization. The contribution is a concrete retrieval-and-computation judging architecture with an auditable operational characterization, not a controlled estimate of component gains. We distinguish the reported leaderboard result from independently recomputed diagnostics and identify the evidence needed for stronger effectiveness and reproducibility claims.
thinking: 该论文针对孟加拉语幻觉检测任务，提出了一种结合查询重写、混合检索和任务特定语言模型判断的系统架构，并进行了详细的系统性能与可审计性分析。其优势在于构建了包含多种检索路径和计算代理的复杂系统，并提供了版本控制、执行追踪等可审计的元数据，方法上较为严谨；不足在于其研究场景（特定语言、特定挑战赛）较为具体，对图书馆与信息科学主流业务的直接落地价值有限，且其前沿性主要体现在NLP工程架构层面，而非图情领域的方法论创新。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究构建并分析了一个用于检测孟加拉语文本幻觉的、结合检索与程序执行的可审计AI系统。

title: MuninAI: A Self-Hosted Agentic Framework for Independent Research Groups
abstract:
arXiv:2610.23480v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Research groups that want a language model grounded in their own literature face a choice between hosted services that receive their unpublished work and self-hosted deployments that keep the data local but give the model no access to the corpus. Munin is an open-source framework for a self-hosted scientific assistant that indexes a group's corpus and its citation graph, and wraps whichever open-weight model the group can serve in an agent harness with specialised reading, search, and computation tools. We claim that the harness, rather than the specific model, is what makes the system useful on domain literature, and we ship the evaluation suite that tests this claim with the software.
  On 199 paired literature questions, the harness more than doubles the accuracy of the base model, from 0.387 to 0.874 (+0.487, 95% CI [0.407, 0.568]), while naive retrieve-then-answer scores below the unaided model on every backbone tested. Under the harness, roughly twice as many answer claims trace to a passage the model read itself as with fixed top-5 retrieval. When the source paper for a question is removed from the corpus, the system abstains on about nine in ten of the questions it had answered correctly on the Qwen backbones and eight in ten on gpt-oss-20b, and it produces no fabricated local citation across 300 fabricated references.
  The pattern holds on three backbones from two developers, including a 20-billion-parameter model that runs on a single consumer-grade GPU. With all outbound network access disabled, both Qwen backbones still exceed the published PaperQA2 accuracy. The evaluation suite runs as a single command, so an adopting group can re-run it on its own corpus and model.
thinking: 该论文提出了一个面向独立研究小组的自托管智能体框架，通过构建本地文献索引和引用图谱，并结合特定工具链，显著提升了开源基础模型在专业文献问答任务上的性能。其方法严谨，通过多模型、多场景的对比实验验证了框架的有效性，且开源评估套件增强了可复现性。不足在于其应用场景目前主要聚焦于科研辅助，在更广泛的图书馆或信息服务机构中的具体落地路径尚需进一步探索。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究开发了一个自托管框架，能让研究小组使用本地开源大模型，通过结合专业工具链，使其在回答本领域文献问题时的准确率提升一倍以上。

title: EduWild: How Teacher-Configured Chatbots Fail in Real-World Use and How to Fix Them
abstract:
arXiv:2610.23530v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Teachers increasingly configure educational chatbots through natural-language instructions, but how these bots fail in real-world use remains poorly understood. We introduce EduWild, a dataset of 1,726 conversations with 217 teacher-configured chatbots, each paired with the instructions and configuration behind it, including 900 conversations from the intended end users of 35 deployed chatbots. We develop a 29-code taxonomy covering factual, workflow, diagnostic, and pedagogical failures and apply it using a human-calibrated LLM judge. The most frequent failures are lapses in following teacher intent --- bots skip required workflow steps (53.8% of end-user conversations), omit expectation setup (33.4%), and overload learners with information or questions (37.1%). Guided by these findings, we design a prompt-based harness targeting the six most frequent failure modes. In a study with 200 college students across ten bots, the harness reduces the mean number of target failure codes per conversation from 1.406 to 0.489, a 65.2% relative reduction with bots weighted equally. These findings show how real-world failure analysis can guide practical improvements to educational chatbots.

title: Bridging the Language Gap in Scholarly Data II: Enhancing Gender Inference for Chinese Names
abstract:
arXiv:2610.23734v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Perceived gender inference from names is important for inclusive scientometrics research, yet existing methods perform poorly on non-Western scholars. We address this gap for Chinese names, which appear in two forms, Hanzi and Pinyin, its Romanized form (e.g., Zhang Wei, Li Na). In international bibliographic records, names are often available only in Pinyin. However, a single pinyin name can correspond to multiple distinct hanzi characters with different gender associations, so gender inference from Pinyin alone is intrinsically ambiguous. To address this, we first develop two hanzi models, a regression model that produces a continuous gender score from 0 (male) to 1 (female), and a classification model that outputs one of three labels (\em{male}, \em{neutral}, \em{female}). We train them on a sample of hanzi names from Chinese-language physics publications, rated by 11 native Chinese speakers. On this sample, the models achieve an RMSE of $0.09$ and an R$^2$ of $0.85$ (regression), and macro-AUC of $0.97$ and a Cohen's $\kappa$ of $0.81$ (classification), demonstrating high performance that is robust to class imbalance. For pinyin names, we propose a pipeline that aggregates hanzi predictions via transliteration and frequency weighting, together with an ambiguity score that flags names whose gender cannot be resolved from Pinyin alone. Benchmarked against three off-the-shelf tools (Namsor, GPT, and Claude), our models achieve the highest agreement with human annotations for both gender scores and gender labels, in both scripts. Applied to an independent sample of Chinese-named authors in APS journals, our models assign a gender to every name, whereas existing Pinyin-based methods leave between 20\% and 100\% of names unclassified. These findings demonstrate the importance of hanzi-level information for reliable gender inference of Chinese names. Code and data are publicly available.
thinking: 该论文针对中文姓名性别推断这一具体问题，提出了结合汉字和拼音信息的创新方法，并进行了严谨的模型训练与验证，方法学上较为扎实。其成果直接提升了科学计量研究中对非西方学者性别识别的准确性和覆盖率，具有明确的实践价值。不足在于其技术核心（回归与分类模型）虽应用得当，但并非当前最前沿的AI技术范式。
