title: Learning to Retrieve and Reason on Knowledge Graph through Active Self-Reflection
abstract:
arXiv:2502.14932v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Extensive research has investigated the integration of large language models (LLMs) with knowledge graphs to enhance the reasoning process. However, understanding how models perform reasoning utilizing structured graph knowledge remains underexplored. Most existing approaches rely on LLMs or retrievers to make binary judgments regarding the utilization of knowledge, which is too coarse. Meanwhile, there is still a lack of feedback mechanisms for reflection and control throughout the entire reasoning path. This paper proposes an Active self-Reflection framework for knowledge Graph reasoning (ArG), introducing for the first time an end-to-end training approach to achieve iterative reasoning grounded on structured graphs. Within the framework, the model leverages special tokens to actively control the reasoning process, achieving on-demand retrieval and multi-dimensional, finer-grained knowledge evaluation. The reasoning paths generated by the model exhibit high interpretability, enabling deeper exploration of the model's understanding of structured knowledge. Ultimately, the proposed model achieves outstanding results compared to existing baselines in knowledge graph reasoning tasks.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种结合大语言模型与知识图谱进行推理的主动反思框架，在方法上具有创新性，引入了端到端训练和细粒度知识评估，技术前沿性较强。然而，论文目前主要基于算法验证，缺乏在真实图书馆或信息服务机构场景下的应用案例，其实践应用价值尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种让大语言模型在知识图谱上进行主动反思与可控推理的新框架，提升了推理过程的可解释性。

title: Automatic Tensor-level Execution of Abstract Interpreters for Neural Networks
abstract:
arXiv:2507.20055v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Developing new abstract interpretation-based DNN certifiers is difficult because their mathematical design is expressed at the neuron level, while implementations must operate at the tensor level. Existing libraries such as auto_LiRPA, IVAN, and ERAN support fixed sets of certifiers; extending them requires expertise in formal methods and tensor programming. Domain-specific languages such as ConstraintFlow let researchers specify certifiers at the neuron level, but cannot run them on real DNNs.
  We present Neuton, a framework that automatically translates neuron-level certifier specifications into tensor-level executables, enabling new DNN certifiers without manual tensor programming. Neuton makes three contributions. First, a stack-based intermediate representation (IR) and shape analysis infer implicit tensor operations, including broadcasts, dimension expansions, and reductions, required for correct execution. Second, domain-specific rewrite rules optimize common tensor operation sequences into more efficient equivalents. Third, gBCSR is a sparse tensor format using variable-sized, layer-aligned blocks over a non-zero default value, tailored to DNN certifier sparsity.
  We prove that translation preserves neuron-level semantics. We evaluate Neuton on 8 certifiers and 32 DNN benchmarks. Neuton compiles four existing certifiers and produces the first executable implementations of four others: two previously specified but never run, and two new designs. These expose precision-runtime trade-offs unavailable in existing libraries. For example, SkipPoly matches DeepPoly's precision on all 32 DNNs while running as fast or faster on half. Neuton's runtime on existing certifiers is competitive with hand-optimized libraries. Code: https://github.com/uiuc-focal-lab/constraintflow.git
thinking: 该论文提出了一种将神经网络验证器从神经元级规范自动编译为张量级可执行代码的框架，在方法上具有创新性，并提供了严格的语义保持证明和实验验证。然而，其技术前沿性主要体现在形式化方法与程序编译的交叉领域，在图情领域的直接应用场景尚不明确，实践价值有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究开发了一个能自动将神经网络验证器的数学设计转化为高效可执行代码的框架，降低了开发新验证器的技术门槛。

title: Speculating LLMs' Chinese Training Data Pollution from Their Tokens
abstract:
arXiv:2508.17771v3 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Tokens are basic elements in the datasets for LLM training. It is well-known that many tokens representing Chinese phrases in the vocabulary of GPT (4o/4o-mini/o1/o3/4.5/4.1/o4-mini) are indicating contents like pornography or online gambling. Based on this observation, our goal is to locate Polluted Chinese (PoC) tokens in LLMs and study the relationship between PoC tokens' existence and training data. (1) We give a formal definition and taxonomy of PoC tokens based on the GPT's vocabulary. (2) We build a PoC token detector via fine-tuning an LLM to label PoC tokens in vocabularies by considering each token's both semantics and related contents from the search engines. (3) We study the speculation on the training data pollution via PoC tokens' appearances (token ID). Experiments on GPT and other 23 LLMs indicate that tokens widely exist while GPT's vocabulary behaves the worst: more than 40% long Chinese tokens (i.e., a token with more than two Chinese characters) are either porn or online gambling. We validate the accuracy of our speculation method on famous pre-training datasets like C4 and Pile. Then, considering GPT-4o, we speculate that the ratio of "Yui Hatano" related webpages in GPT-4o's training data is around 0.5%.
thinking: 该论文通过分析LLM词汇表中的中文污染令牌，推测其训练数据污染情况，方法上结合了语义分析和搜索引擎验证，具有一定创新性。但研究主要依赖GPT等模型的公开词汇表，对训练数据污染的推测仍属间接证据，且样本范围有限，方法严谨性有待加强。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究发现GPT等大语言模型的中文词汇表中存在大量涉黄涉赌污染令牌，并据此推测其训练数据可能受到污染。

title: Measuring AI "Slop" in Text
abstract:
arXiv:2509.19163v3 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: AI "slop" is an increasingly popular term used to describe low-quality AI-generated text, but there is currently no agreed upon definition of this term nor a means to measure its occurrence. In this work, we develop a taxonomy of "slop" through interviews with experts in NLP, writing, and philosophy, and propose a set of interpretable dimensions for its assessment in text. Through span-level annotation, we find that binary "slop" judgments are (somewhat) subjective, but such determinations nonetheless correlate with latent dimensions such as coherence and relevance. Our framework can be used to examine AI-generated text in both detection and binary preference tasks, potentially offering new insights into the linguistic and stylistic factors that contribute to quality judgments. We highlight that fully automated and scalable methods remain an open challenge.
thinking: 该论文针对AI生成文本质量评估中的'Slop'概念，通过专家访谈构建了可解释的维度分类体系，并进行了标注实验，方法较为严谨。其提出的评估框架对检测和优化AI生成内容具有直接应用潜力，但研究本身侧重于概念界定和基础维度探索，未引入最前沿的自动化检测模型。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究通过专家访谈和文本标注，为评估低质量AI生成文本（'Slop'）建立了一个多维度、可解释的分析框架。

title: Beyond Consensus: Perspectivist Modeling and Evaluation of Annotator Disagreement in NLP
abstract:
arXiv:2601.09065v3 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Annotator disagreement is widespread in NLP, particularly for subjective and ambiguous tasks such as toxicity detection and stance analysis. While early approaches treated disagreement as noise to be removed, recent work increasingly models it as a meaningful signal reflecting variation in interpretation and perspective. This survey provides a unified view of disagreement-aware NLP methods. We first present a domain-agnostic taxonomy of the sources of disagreement spanning data, task, and annotator factors. We then synthesize modeling approaches using a common framework defined by prediction targets and pooling structure, highlighting a shift from consensus learning toward explicitly modeling disagreement, and toward capturing structured relationships among annotators. We review evaluation metrics for both predictive performance and annotator behavior, and noting that most fairness evaluations remain descriptive rather than normative. We conclude by identifying open challenges and future directions, including integrating multiple sources of variation, developing disagreement-aware interpretability frameworks, and grappling with the practical tradeoffs of perspectivist modeling.
thinking: 该论文系统综述了NLP中标注者分歧的建模与评估方法，体现了从消除分歧到利用分歧的研究范式转变，具有较高的方法学前沿性。然而，论文作为综述性质的研究，其业务落地价值更多体现在为后续应用研究提供理论框架，而非直接的技术方案；方法严谨性体现在对现有文献的系统梳理与分类上，但本身不涉及实证研究。
one_sentence_summary: 这篇综述论文系统梳理了自然语言处理中如何将标注者的分歧视为有价值信号进行建模与评估的研究进展。

title: FrenchNews-7: Benchmarking Cross-Publisher French News Editorial Desk Classification
abstract:
arXiv:2608.18097v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: We present FrenchNews-7, a cross-publisher France-based French-language news editorial desk classification benchmark combining a large multi-outlet corpus, a URL-derived seven-class taxonomy, and a fine-tuned CamemBERT classifier. Labels are assigned via a hybrid pipeline combining publisher URL slugs with LLM annotation for structurally ambiguous cases, audited through an inter-rater study (2 humans + 2 LLMs; pairwise $\kappa \geq 0.766$, human--human $\kappa = 0.806$). We evaluate lexical, multilingual, and French-specific trained classifiers under both in-distribution and held-out-publisher settings, with additional comparison against zero-shot LLM baselines (GPT-OSS-120B, Mistral Small 3.2, Llama-3.3-70B) on the held-out pool. The strongest model, CamemBERT-base on full article text, outperforms headline-only input, generalizes to unseen outlets, and exceeds all three zero-shot LLM baselines on overall recall (0.799), with the gap concentrated in the ambiguous editorial-boundary categories Economie and Societe. Cross-publisher evaluation reveals uneven boundary stability: Sport, Culture & Loisirs, and International transfer cleanly, while Economie (recall = 0.517) is statistically indistinguishable from blinded human agreement on the same articles (0.55, $n = 40$), and Societe (precision = 0.577) absorbs boundary ambiguity, both suggesting editorial conventions rather than recoverable classifier headroom. The fine-tuned CamemBERT-base model, labeled manifest, reference collection scripts, and a reliability-tier guidance table are available at https://huggingface.co/LeFrenchNewsLab/camembert-base-frenchnews7 (model) and https://huggingface.co/datasets/LeFrenchNewsLab/frenchnews-7 (dataset).
thinking: 该论文构建了一个跨出版商的法语新闻编辑部分类基准数据集，并采用混合标注流程和一致性评估，方法严谨性较高。研究聚焦于法语新闻领域，业务落地价值主要体现在为法语新闻分类任务提供标准化评估工具，但前沿技术应用限于微调预训练模型，未涉及最新的大语言模型架构创新。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究创建了一个法语新闻分类基准，发现微调的CamemBERT模型在跨出版商场景下优于仅使用标题或零样本大语言模型，并揭示了不同新闻类别间的分类难度差异。

title: Beyond Boundaries: A Comprehensive Survey of Transferable Attacks on AI Systems
abstract:
arXiv:2311.11796v3 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Transferable attacks allow adversarial manipulations or learned attack mechanisms constructed in one setting to compromise other AI systems, potentially reducing attack costs and amplifying security and privacy risks. Yet fragmented terminology and evaluation practices hinder understanding of what transfers, why it transfers, and where transfer fails. This survey synthesizes representative research and develops a unified taxonomy spanning six complementary axes: cross-instance, cross-domain, cross-modality, cross-model, cross-task, and cross-deployment. By separating source-target configuration changes from attacker access and adaptation budgets, the taxonomy provides a common framework for comparing transfer across evasion, poisoning, backdoors, privacy inference, model stealing, and prompt-based attacks. We connect transfer mechanisms, including gradient alignment, shared representations, training persistence, and deployment invariances, to enhancement methods based on augmentation, disentanglement, and optimization. Our synthesis identifies inconsistent transfer, incompatible metrics, and gaps between simulated and physical evaluations, and establishes a research agenda for compositional transfer, configuration differences, temporal persistence, and reproducible benchmarking. Together, this work supports systematic investigation of shared vulnerabilities and guides transfer-aware security assessment and defense.
thinking: 该论文是一篇关于AI系统可迁移攻击的综述，系统梳理了跨实例、跨领域、跨模态等六种迁移攻击类型，并建立了统一的分类框架。其优势在于对碎片化研究领域的系统整合与理论提炼，具有较高的方法论严谨性；但作为一篇综述性文章，其本身不涉及具体的技术创新或业务落地实践。
one_sentence_summary: 这篇论文系统梳理了人工智能系统在不同场景间可迁移攻击的类型与机制，为理解AI安全漏洞提供了一个统一的分类框架。

title: Two Minds Better Than One: Collaborative Reward Modeling for LLM Alignment
abstract:
arXiv:2505.10597v3 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Reward models (RMs) are central to aligning large language models (LLMs) with human values, yet noisy preference feedback can induce reward misgeneralization through spurious correlations and overfitting. We characterize the training dynamics of preference pairs and uncover a distinctive optimization signature of noise: persistently high losses, sharp temporal fluctuations, and irregular gradient updates. Our analyses further show that excluding such pairs improves downstream alignment. In practice, however, reliable preferences are not known a priori, and self-filtering based on a model's own training signals can amplify confirmation bias. To address this challenge, we introduce Collaborative Reward Modeling (CRM), an online framework for identifying reliable preferences. CRM couples cross-model peer review with curriculum learning: two RMs evaluate each other's sample selections, while curriculum keeps their learning progress synchronized. Across extensive experiments, CRM improves RM generalization by up to 9.94 points on RewardBench under 40% preference noise. CRM further generalizes to implicit-reward alignment, offering a robust and broadly applicable approach to learning from imperfect feedback.
thinking: 该论文针对大语言模型对齐中的奖励模型噪声问题，提出了一个结合跨模型同行评审与课程学习的协作式训练框架，在技术方法上具有创新性。其核心贡献在于通过实验验证了该框架能有效提升奖励模型的泛化能力，并适用于隐式奖励对齐，但作为预印本论文，其方法在真实业务场景中的落地路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种协作式奖励建模框架，能有效识别并利用噪声偏好数据中的可靠部分，从而提升大语言模型与人类价值观的对齐效果。

title: Actions with Receipts: Jointly Binding Claims, Evidence, and Execution for Replayable Tool-Agent Auditing
abstract:
arXiv:2610.00327v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Tool-using agents can expose citations and execution logs while leaving a critical association unaudited: whether the claim shown to a user is the claim emitted by the committed execution and supported by the cited source. A valid citation and a valid trace can therefore remain individually well formed while being transplanted across claims, actions, runs, or source versions. We introduce a claim-anchored execution contract that jointly binds the emitted claim, its exact source span, the ordered execution prefix that produced it, and the source version and access state observed by that execution. Each receipt contains an emission anchor that deterministically locates the claim inside a committed answer or claim-bearing action, together with source identifiers, offsets, hashes, quotes, and a domain-separated execution commitment. A deterministic integrity verifier reconstructs these bindings before semantic or task labels are joined. We separate this integrity plane from a pluggable support plane, so structural validity is not used as a proxy for entailment. The contract exposes seven independently testable properties: claim-emission binding, source binding, ordered-execution binding, oracle separation, persisted-object replay, execution-rerun consistency, and version/access binding. Across 1,280 cross-object attacks, the joint contract detects 1,275 substitutions (0.9961). Removing a targeted property reduces its attack-detection rate to 0.0156-0.0625. On an independently adjudicated 384-pair split, the conflict-aware support guard reaches F1 0.8865 and false acceptance 0.0729; on unseen failure families, these rates are 0.8679 and 0.0938.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种联合绑定声明、证据和执行轨迹的审计框架，技术上结合了哈希锚定、版本控制和确定性验证等前沿方法，具有较高的技术新颖性。其方法在模拟攻击检测中表现出色，严谨性较高，但作为概念验证框架，在图书馆或信息机构中的直接落地路径尚不明确，实践应用价值有待具体场景验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种可审计的框架，确保AI工具代理的输出声明、所用证据和执行过程三者被不可篡改地绑定在一起。

title: FAER: Auditable Utility-Aligned Trajectory Replay for Language Model Post-Training
abstract:
arXiv:2610.00385v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Replay selectors often rank cached trajectories by format feedback, confidence, freshness, or response length, although cache-level correctness and downstream learner utility are distinct objectives. We formalize this selection-to-learning gap and introduce FAER as an auditable full-trajectory replay framework. Its training-free fixed selector is a protocol baseline; FAER-UTILITY is the learner-aware selector fitted on disjoint calibration blocks. The normalized gradient alignment is reported as a baseline, while a disposable optimizer-aware virtual update supplies a magnitude-aware utility surface. The audit contract freezes observed fields and replay traces before evaluation labels are joined. On GSM8K with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, the matched learner study reports quality 0.6329 for the fixed selector, compared with 0.5482 for uniform and 0.6037 for format-feedback under 128 updates. Metadata-only cross-fitted calibration reaches $0.6476\!\pm\!0.0139$ over eight seeds (median 0.6481; paired 95% interval $[+0.079,+0.122]$) at 63,276 target-run tokens; its recorded full cost is 189,642 tokens and 3.48 GPU-hours including calibration. The completed FAER-UTILITY row reaches 0.6624 at 62,844 target-run tokens and 4.26 GPU-hours. Format-feedback selects records with correctness 0.6953, compared with 0.3594 for the fixed selector, despite the different downstream ranking. The completed comparison surfaces report the learner-aware ablation, same-seed gap, policy-optimization rows, and strict zero-shot transfer.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种可审计的轨迹回放框架FAER，通过引入学习者感知的选择器来弥合选择与学习目标之间的差距，在方法上具有创新性。研究在GSM8K数据集上进行了实证验证，并提供了详细的性能比较和成本分析，方法较为严谨。然而，其研究场景聚焦于大语言模型的后训练技术优化，与图书馆、信息机构等图情领域的直接业务实践关联较弱。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种可审计的、基于效用的轨迹回放框架，以优化大语言模型后训练中的数据选择过程。

title: Beyond homogenization in university rankings: a discipline-structure-sensitive evaluation method
abstract: University rankings have become influential instruments of governance in higher education, yet most institution-level systems apply unified indicators and weighting structures to universities with markedly different disciplinary profiles. This can translate disciplinary breadth and greater visibility in metric-intensive fields into structural advantages, while giving less recognition to institutions with concentrated disciplinary strengths. Existing approaches, including subject rankings and classification-based evaluation, provide valuable field-specific or contextualized comparisons, but do not always produce a common institution-level ordering. This study develops a discipline-structure-sensitive method that incorporates disciplinary heterogeneity directly into the aggregation process. Using 141 universities drawn from China’s Double First-Class initiative, the method constructs a continuous disciplinary structure vector, measures each university’s similarity to six disciplinary prototypes, and uses the resulting similarities to combine the performance scores generated by six discipline-specific indicator systems. An attenuation coefficient, λ, regulates the influence of disciplinary distinctiveness on the final ranking. The results show that leading comprehensive universities remain broadly stable, while specialized universities exhibit heterogeneous responses. The largest upward movements occur when a concentrated disciplinary structure coincides with strong relative performance in the structurally dominant discipline. Sensitivity analysis across different values of λ shows that stronger disciplinary weighting gradually reshapes the overall ordering and tier composition, while rankings remain highly stable under adjacent parameter settings and marginal effects diminish at higher values. Methodologically, the framework introduces a continuous and profile-sensitive form of institution-level comparison by allowing disciplinary structure to shape aggregation weights within a common ranking space. Its transparent and adjustable design provides a new way to accommodate disciplinary heterogeneity while preserving comparability across institutions. More broadly, the framework can help reduce incentives for indiscriminate disciplinary expansion, strengthen recognition of distinctive institutional strengths, and promote greater diversity in higher education development.
affiliations: University rankings have become influential instruments of governance in higher education, yet most institution-level systems apply unified indicators and weighting structures to universities with markedly different disciplinary profiles.

title: Multiplex coupling: Connecting the intellectual base and the topics of a research field
abstract:
arXiv:2610.21858v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Two documents can be close because they cite the same works or because they write about the same things, and the two kinds of proximity often disagree. Science mapping reads them in separate maps or merges them, as hybrid clustering does; either way the disagreement is lost. We introduce multiplex coupling, a framework that couples the same documents by their references and by their terms, keeps the two layers separate and analyses their relation. Similarities are standardised against a null model, and the agreement between the layers is measured on random pairs of documents. Consensus clustering partitions each layer into roots, groups sharing an intellectual base, and themes, groups sharing a topic. A test on the roots $\times$ themes table identifies branching roots and convergent themes, and pairs of roots are followed over time. Every structure is reported with its persistence across numbers of neighbours, which on synthetic data identifies most false branching. Applications to Web of Science, Scopus and OpenAlex collections show that the two layers carry largely complementary information, and reveal substantive and methodological bases that have grown into several topics. The framework is implemented in bibliometrix.
thinking: 该论文提出了“多重耦合”框架，将文献的引用关系和术语关系作为两个独立的网络层进行分析，并测量其一致性，方法设计具有创新性。其方法在合成数据和多个真实数据库上进行了验证，并提供了开源工具，严谨性和应用价值较高，但核心思想属于网络科学在文献计量中的深化应用，并非全新的前沿技术。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种将文献的引用网络与主题网络分开分析并衡量其一致性的新框架，用于揭示研究领域知识基础与主题演化的复杂关系。

title: Faster alone vs. further together: The speed and impact of researchers' responses to societal crises
abstract:
arXiv:2603.19246v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Throughout the 21st century, society encountered numerous crises that demanded quick and widespread action. In the present work, we documented researchers' responses to 25 of these crises, analyzing 1,537,284 published responses from 3,262,152 researchers spanning 225 countries and territories. An analysis of publication speed and citation patterns yielded support for a proverbial claim: "to go fast, go alone; to go far, go together". Solo authors were quicker to publish responses to societal crises -- but their responses received less attention in scholarly, news, and policy venues. Growth towards large-scale collaboration was associated with increased impact; However, this team size advantage was characterized by diminishing returns and significantly varied across sampled crises. Furthermore, pluralistic machine learning modeling highlights the importance of considering additional context, such as government effectiveness and the expertise of team leaders. Taken together, results facilitate evidence-based conversations regarding how researchers optimize speed and impact in the midst of societal crises.
thinking: 该论文基于大规模数据分析（150万篇论文、300余万研究者），探讨研究者在社会危机中的响应模式，方法严谨且样本充足。研究结合了机器学习建模，但技术应用相对常规，未涉及最前沿的AI方法；其发现对科研管理与政策制定具有直接参考价值，但落地实施需结合具体机构情境。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，面对社会危机时，独立研究者发文更快，但大型合作团队的研究成果影响力更广，且这种优势受危机类型和团队领导经验等因素影响。

title: The MPB Corpus: A Dataset of Melody, Rhythm, Harmony, and Melody-Harmony Relationships in Brazilian Popular Music
abstract:
arXiv:2608.13842v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: PLEASE CHECK AND REFER TO THE PUBLISHED VERSION OF THIS PAPER ON https://doi.org/10.5334/tismir.357
  This paper presents the MPB Corpus, a dataset of Brazilian Popular Music (Musica Popular Brasileira, MPB) comprising derived symbolic annotations for 500 pieces across four musical parameters -- melodic contour, melodic rhythm, harmony, and the melody-harmony relationship -- making it the most comprehensive dataset to date for computational musicology of Brazilian music. It is released under a CC-BY-4.0 license in an open, machine-readable tabular format, with documentation and reproducible analysis code. Because the annotations were derived from copyrighted musical scores, the corpus contains no audio recordings or score-level representations such as MIDI or MusicXML; it nonetheless provides a reusable resource for MIR research on a culturally significant repertoire that remains underrepresented in existing datasets. To support the encoding process, we introduce analytical models for capturing rhythmic and melodic information, along with tailored visualizations and summary metrics. Finally, we present a brief exploratory analysis illustrating the dataset's potential for formulating and addressing musicological questions about the genre.
thinking: 该论文构建了巴西流行音乐的符号化标注数据集，填补了特定文化音乐在计算音乐学领域的空白，具有较高的方法严谨性和实践价值，但技术前沿性主要体现在数据集的构建而非算法创新上。
