title: Information-Gain Calibrated On-Policy Distillation for Deep Search Agents
abstract:
arXiv:2610.20664v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has recently emerged as a promising approach for transferring the capabilities of large agents to compact students. In deep search, where agents iteratively retrieve external evidence, a teacher's preference among plausible queries before retrieval may not predict which queries will return useful evidence. Standard OPD nevertheless supervises each student query from the preceding context alone, inducing a failure mode we term \textbf{\textit{evidence-blind supervision (EBS)}}. To understand this, we regroup the OPD objective by interaction turns and reveal two implicit priors: a \textit{budget prior} that allocates supervision by token volume, and a \textit{direction prior} that favors tokens preferred by the teacher, neither of which accounts for the evidence returned by the current query. Our empirical analysis shows that both priors contribute to EBS in practice: the first search turn accounts for 51.1\% of total absolute information gain but receives only 18.0\% of the supervision budget, while 43.7\% of search queries have teacher rewards that disagree in sign with post-retrieval information utility. To mitigate this, we propose \ours, which uses post-retrieval information gain (IG) to calibrate both priors: reallocating supervision toward information-critical turns while calibrating query preferences using the utility of retrieved evidence. Experiments on six multimodal search benchmarks show that \ours improves average accuracy by 3.4 and 1.7 percentage points for 2B and 4B students over standard OPD, enabling the 4B student to surpass its 8B teacher on MMSearch and BrowseComp-VL.
thinking: 该论文针对深度搜索智能体中的策略蒸馏方法提出了信息增益校准机制，有效解决了证据盲监督问题，方法设计严谨并在多个基准测试中验证了效果。然而，其研究场景高度聚焦于前沿的深度搜索与智能体技术，与当前图书馆和信息机构的主流业务实践存在一定距离。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种基于信息增益校准的策略蒸馏方法，能更有效地将大型搜索智能体的能力迁移到小型模型上。

title: Idea2Prior: Auditable Paper Retrieval and Ranking from Research Ideas
abstract:
arXiv:2610.20857v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Finding a paper from an informal research idea requires more than matching topic words: relevant work may use different terminology, and its distinguishing mechanism may be absent from the abstract. We present \system{}, an auditable literature-search system built on PaperArena. It combines multi-source discovery, identity verification, facet-based abstract assessment, semantic citation expansion, and joint Expert ranking. A retrieval-only mode ranks up to five papers from a shortlist of at most 60, using complete available abstracts and locally selected PDF evidence from five fixed acquisition attempts, without generating a long-form report. In a historical comparison covering ten queries from each of EASY, MEDIUM, and HARD, aggregate reported Hit@5 is 53.3\% for \system{}, 43.3\% for ChatGPT web Deep Research, and 36.7\% for Gemini web Deep Research under the documented accounting convention. The advantage is concentrated in EASY and MEDIUM; ChatGPT leads on HARD. Selected \system{} runs average 8 minutes 53 seconds, compared with user-reported web averages of 5.2 and 4.7 minutes. A separate nine-query API sample averages \$0.0945 per task; this is a historical cost observation, not a matched comparison with web subscription costs. Pairwise Top 5 coverage ranges from 6\% to 34\%, showing differing returned evidence sets. The system also exposes optional implementation analysis and citation-evolution tools. These results support targeted idea-to-paper retrieval while leaving general web research, forum search, and broader relevance evaluation open. https://github.com/ystok66/IDEA2PRIOR
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于多源发现、身份验证和语义引文扩展的可审计文献检索系统，在技术方法上结合了前沿的语义检索与专家排名策略，具有创新性。研究通过历史对比实验验证了系统在特定难度查询上的有效性，方法较为严谨，但样本量较小且主要针对arXiv平台，在更广泛的学术数据库中的适用性有待验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究开发了一个能从非正式研究想法出发、通过多步骤语义分析来检索和排名相关学术论文的可审计系统。

title: TransX Technical Report: Scaling Sequence Transduction for Recommendation
abstract:
arXiv:2610.20913v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We present TransX, a sequence-transduction framework and co-designed infrastructure for scaling industrial recommendation with explicit control over model-compute allocation and execution amortization. TransX separates sequence encoding, behavior memory, and candidate-conditioned fusion into independently scalable components. Training amortizes causal trajectory computation across behavioral prefixes and fans out memory states to candidates; serving disaggregates bulk prefill, nearline refresh, and online prediction through compact behavior-memory KV.
  We observe anisotropic scaling returns: encoder scaling may saturate beyond moderate depth at fixed memory resolution and fusion capacity; increasing supervision shifts the allocation frontier toward candidate-conditioned fusion; and the memory resolution needed to preserve quality remains roughly stable as model capacity grows. We train TransX on click and conversion, post-train its shared behavioral interface for retrieval and preference ranking, and explore generative recommendation offline.
  In separate production A/B experiments, the core TransX model improves CTR by 6.02% and conversion by 4.45%, while post-trained retrieval and preference-ranking variants improve CTR by 2.96% and conversion by 1.33%, respectively, over corresponding production baselines. Under matched training conditions, the training infrastructure increases supervised-target throughput by 84%. In serving, disaggregation reduces TransX's total serving cost by nearly 80% versus colocated serving at matched traffic and SLO, enabling approximately 5X the per-request model FLOPs of the HSTU-style production baseline at the same total serving cost. At matched per-request model FLOPs, TransX delivers approximately 4X higher request throughput per H200. These results show that online serving cost need not grow proportionally with recommendation model capacity.
thinking: 该论文提出了一个面向工业级推荐系统的序列转换框架TransX，其核心贡献在于通过解耦架构设计和基础设施协同优化，实现了模型容量与在线服务成本的非线性解耦，具有显著的技术创新性和工程落地价值。研究通过生产环境的A/B测试验证了性能提升和成本降低，方法严谨，但作为技术报告，其理论深度和通用性探讨相对有限。
one_sentence_summary: TransX框架通过创新的解耦架构和基础设施设计，在显著提升推荐效果的同时，大幅降低了在线服务成本。

title: Learning When to Think: Utility-Guided Adaptive Reasoning for Efficient Text Retrieval
abstract:
arXiv:2610.21030v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Reasoning-conditioned embeddings can improve retrieval by progressively refining semantic constraints. However, additional reasoning may introduce over-generalized or semantically noisy abstractions that weaken retrieval specificity. Existing methods largely supervise reasoning through final retrieval outcomes, providing limited guidance over the refinement process itself. We propose AURA, a framework that directly supervises intermediate reasoning states according to how well they separate relevant documents from hard distractors. AURA further trains a lightweight utility estimator over prefix-conditioned embeddings to adapt reasoning depth at inference time. On the reasoning-intensive BRIGHT benchmark, AURA-4B achieves 34.7 average nDCG@10 while using 2.8 reasoning steps and 96 generated tokens per query. Under matched deployment conditions, adaptive stopping reduces latency from 4.6 to 0.76 seconds relative to full-trajectory reasoning. Results on MS MARCO further suggest that this specialization need not substantially degrade conventional in-domain retrieval.
thinking: 论文提出了AURA框架，通过直接监督中间推理状态和训练轻量级效用估计器来指导推理深度，在BRIGHT基准上取得了显著效果并大幅降低了延迟。该方法在技术上具有前沿性，特别是在检索中引入自适应推理机制，但其业务落地价值目前主要体现在提升检索系统效率上，对图书馆等机构的直接应用场景尚不明确。研究方法基于标准基准测试，论证严谨，但未涉及实际业务环境中的部署验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种自适应推理框架，能在保持检索精度的同时动态调整推理深度，显著提升文本检索效率并降低延迟。

title: RecSoup: Efficient Model Merging Approach for Controllable Multi-Objective Recommendation
abstract:
arXiv:2610.21220v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Recommender systems often need to balance multiple conflicting objectives. Controllable Multi-Objective Recommendation (CMOR) enables dynamic adjustment of objective trade-offs at inference time without retraining, adapting to shifting user or system requirements. Existing CMOR approaches typically rely on output-level reranking or parameter-generating modules, which either limit the scope of feasible trade-offs or incur substantial training and inference cost. Model merging provides a promising alternative by reusing multiple objective-specific models via parameter combination. However, its direct application to recommender systems is challenging due to the lack of a shared linear regime and cross-objective interference. To address these issues, we propose RecSoup, a lightweight two-stage approach for effective CMOR via specialized model merging. RecSoup first mitigates parameter interference across objectives through a pruning strategy that jointly considers objective-specific importance and cross-objective relevance. It then performs adaptive parameter merging via a learnable preference-to-coefficient mapping, allowing dynamic trade-off control at inference time without joint retraining or additional generative modules. Theoretically, we prove that RecSoup outperforms the parameter generation paradigm in effectiveness and efficiency, as it can fully navigate the Pareto front without smoothness constraints. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that RecSoup achieves improved Pareto front quality and effective controllability while delivers 165--228x faster inference-time latency than parameter generation approaches. Code is available at https://github.com/35798642/RECSOUP.git.
thinking: 论文提出了一种基于模型融合的可控多目标推荐方法RecSoup，通过剪枝策略和自适应参数合并，在推理时动态调整目标权衡，无需重新训练。该方法在多个基准测试中展现出优越的帕累托前沿质量和可控性，且推理速度显著提升，技术方案新颖且实验验证充分。但作为信息检索领域的预印本论文，其具体在图书馆或信息机构中的直接落地场景尚不明确，实践应用价值有待进一步观察。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种高效的模型融合方法，使推荐系统能在运行时动态平衡多个目标，无需重新训练且大幅提升推理速度。

title: VoteGEO-Bench: Measuring the Impact of Generative Engine Optimization on Electoral Visibility
abstract:
arXiv:2610.21330v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for election information, yet little is known about how external web content shapes the political information they present. Generative engine optimization (GEO) rewrites web content to improve its visibility in generated responses. To investigate its potential risks in voting scenarios (VoteGEO), we introduce VoteGEO-Bench, a benchmark covering the 2024 U.S. presidential election and the 2026 Japanese House of Representatives election, combining election-related queries, historical webpages, and voter personas. We first analyze sources cited by generative engines and find that many citations come from lower-cost owned and open-platform sources, while some webpages remain visible across days. We then evaluate 11 rewriting strategies in 4 categories, examining target specification, effectiveness across engines and elections, and the role of voter personas. Rewriting without specifying a target rarely increases target exposure, whereas target-specified rewriting more often does. Strategies that improve page organization or strengthen a position through argumentation yield greater gains than adding supporting evidence or changing wording. For the two strongest strategies, gains remain broadly positive across evaluated U.S. personas, but persona conditioning shows no consistent effect on these gains. Explicit partisan identities can create baseline exposure gaps larger than the gain from rewriting one webpage. When partisanship is implicit in the voter profile, baseline shifts depend on how strongly the engine responds to that signal.
thinking: 该论文构建了VoteGEO-Bench基准，系统评估生成式引擎优化（GEO）在选举信息场景下的影响，方法设计较为严谨，结合了查询、网页和用户画像。研究揭示了GEO策略的有效性差异及党派身份对信息可见性的基线影响，对理解AI生成内容的潜在操纵风险具有重要警示意义，但其技术核心（GEO策略）虽前沿，直接应用于图书馆等机构的业务场景路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，针对生成式AI的网页内容优化策略能影响选举信息的可见性，但效果因策略和用户党派身份而异。

title: Aligning LLMs with Sparse Retrieval via Adaptive Sparse Supervision
abstract:
arXiv:2610.21877v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: While large language models (LLMs) offer strong semantic representations, their application to first-stage retrieval incurs substantial latency and storage costs. Neural sparse retrievers such as SPLADE provide efficient retrieval but rely on relatively compact encoders with limited representational capacity. To bridge this gap, we propose an LLM-based sparse retrieval framework with input-adaptive sparse alignment. Specifically, we introduce a dynamic $\alpha$-truncation strategy that selects input-specific supervision supports based on the cumulative activation mass of SPLADE representations. This strategy guides the LLM to preserve salient lexical signals while suppressing less informative activations, without relying on a fixed support budget. Subsequent retrieval fine-tuning combines contrastive learning, knowledge distillation, and sparsity regularization to improve retrieval effectiveness. Experiments on MS MARCO and six selected BEIR datasets demonstrate improvements over SPLADE++ while maintaining competitive effectiveness against LLM-based sparse retrievers. Compared with Lion-sp, our method reduces index storage by 6.4-fold and end-to-end query latency by over 11-fold, achieving a favorable effectiveness-efficiency trade-off.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于大语言模型的稀疏检索框架，通过自适应稀疏监督来平衡检索效果与效率，方法设计具有创新性，实验验证较为充分。然而，其前沿性主要体现在对现有技术（LLM与SPLADE）的优化集成上，而非开创全新范式；其应用场景目前主要面向信息检索研究社区，直接移植到图书馆等业务系统的路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种新方法，让大语言模型在信息检索时既能保持高精度，又能大幅降低存储和查询的延迟。

title: GACC-Bench: Benchmarking Goal-Adaptive Context Compression Ability across Large Language Models
abstract:
arXiv:2610.21893v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Context compression in long-running applications of large language models (LLMs) must preserve goal-relevant information, often before specific downstream questions are known. We introduce GACC-Bench, a benchmark for Goal-Adaptive Context Compression that evaluates how reliably LLMs adapt information retention to specified high-level goals. For each source context, we derive one or more high-level goals by grouping source-grounded questions according to shared downstream objectives. The benchmark contains 500 goals and 2,571 questions over 281 document and agent-trace contexts from seven collections spanning diverse domains, with all instances reviewed by human experts. The compressor receives a source context, a goal, and a context-length budget, with the associated evaluation questions withheld. A fixed reader answers these questions individually using the same compressed context. Our evaluation of ten LLM compressors reveals substantial gaps to full-context performance even for the best-performing model, particularly in supporting correct answers to every question associated with a goal. Compared with goal-agnostic compression, target-goal conditioning consistently improves accuracy, whereas mismatched-goal conditioning reduces it. GACC-Bench is available at https://github.com/weiting24/GACC-Bench.
thinking: 该论文提出了一个面向目标自适应上下文压缩的基准测试GACC-Bench，其核心是评估大语言模型根据高层目标选择性保留信息的能力，这属于LLM在长上下文处理中的前沿技术问题。研究构建了覆盖多领域、经专家评审的数据集，并系统评估了十种LLM压缩器，方法严谨。然而，其作为基准测试研究，当前更侧重于模型能力评估与方法论验证，直接转化为图书馆或信息机构可部署的落地应用尚需后续工程开发。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究创建了一个新基准，用于系统评估大语言模型根据指定目标压缩长文本并保留关键信息的能力。

title: ReviewPilot: A Multi-Agent System for Screening and Data Extraction in Systematic Reviews
abstract:
arXiv:2610.21042v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Systematic literature reviews follow the PRISMA process of screening scholarly works and extracting evidence from included studies. Deep research tools based on large language models (LLMs) can search and summarize the literature but do not record which studies are excluded or where extracted values come from. We develop a conversational multi-agent system called ReviewPilot that automates the PRISMA workflow from paper screening to information extraction. Researchers can tailor criteria and schemas through dialogue, and a project memory keeps their configurations and revisions. Each screening decision comes with its reason and each extracted value with its source. On epidemiological expert reviews, ReviewPilot outperforms a single-prompt LLM and AgentSLR across three LLMs, with screening macro F1 up to 0.776 and extraction F1 up to 0.788. Case studies in biomedicine and human-computer interaction show close agreement with human annotators, suggesting that ReviewPilot can transfer beyond epidemiology. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhaoqianXue/ReviewPilot.
thinking: 该论文开发了一个基于大语言模型的多智能体系统ReviewPilot，用于自动化系统综述中的文献筛选与数据提取流程，技术方案具有前沿性。其通过对话配置、项目记忆和可追溯的决策记录，显著提升了方法的严谨性和实践应用潜力，尤其在生物医学和流行病学领域展示了良好的效果。然而，其跨领域迁移能力仍需更多实证研究验证，且系统对LLM性能的依赖可能带来稳定性挑战。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究开发了一个基于大语言模型的多智能体对话系统，能够自动化完成系统综述中的文献筛选与数据提取任务，并保证决策过程的可追溯性。

title: SSR: Structural Signal Retriever for Scalable Agent Discovery in LLM-Orchestrated Multi-Agent Systems
abstract:
arXiv:2610.21113v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Large-scale multi-agent ecosystems require mechanisms for discovering suitable agents without exposing entire registries to a large language model (LLM) orchestrator. The challenge is not only to retrieve relevant Agent Cards from a growing registry, but also to maintain a compact candidate context, since each additional candidate increases prompt size, inference cost, latency, and the risk of exceeding the model context window. We formulate this problem as candidate-context scalability and propose the Structural Signal Retriever (SSR), our deterministic and training-free retrieval method designed for Agent Card discovery. SSR derives structural lexical signals from capability-bearing Agent Card fields, weights them using inverse document frequency (IDF), and uses an Inverted Signal Index (ISI) for selective candidate scoring. We evaluate SSR using a synthetic agent benchmark, a public MS MARCO adaptation, and end-to-end LLM orchestration. At 1,000 agents, SSR reduces LLM input by 98.8% and orchestration latency by 70.9% relative to full-catalog orchestration. On MS MARCO, IDF improves retrieval effectiveness within the structural representation, while the ISI preserves retrieval effectiveness and reduces explicitly scored passages by 96.8%. End-to-end experiments show that candidate pre-selection maintains a compact candidate context as registry size grows and avoids the operational failures observed with full-catalog orchestration. These results support SSR as an Agent-Card-native, traceable retrieval mechanism for candidate-context scalability.
thinking: 该论文针对大语言模型编排的多智能体系统中智能体发现的可扩展性问题，提出了基于结构信号检索的确定性、免训练方法，在检索效率上表现突出，具有明确的工程应用价值。其方法设计严谨，通过合成基准、公共数据集和端到端实验进行了多角度验证，但技术核心仍基于传统的信息检索技术（如IDF、倒排索引），前沿性相对有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种免训练的结构信号检索方法，能大幅缩减大语言模型编排多智能体系统时的输入量和延迟，提升系统可扩展性。

title: TRACER: Trajectory-Aware Tool Retrieval for LLM Agents
abstract:
arXiv:2610.21267v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Modern agents select tools from registries, but exposing entire registries incurs high token costs and can impair selection as they grow. We present TRACER, a retrieval front-end that indexes observed tool-call sequences in a trie and ranks continuations using a learned blend of empirical and contextual priors. On a mixed retail-and-telecom $\tau^2$ environment, TRACER improves GPT-5.4's tool-selection accuracy by 4.7 points while reducing input tokens per step by 80%, exposing just 5 of 128 tools. In autonomous full-turn execution, it matches GPT-5.4's full-registry task success with 61% fewer input tokens per step. Across six environments and four models, TRACER improves tool-selection accuracy over full-registry selection in 21 of 24 model-environment pairs, with average gains of 6 to 10 points; the three exceptions trail by at most 2.2. We analyze failures in both regimes to identify directions for future work.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种面向大语言模型智能体的轨迹感知工具检索方法，通过索引历史工具调用序列并融合经验与上下文先验进行排序，有效提升了工具选择的准确性和效率。其方法在多个环境和模型上进行了系统性验证，实验设计较为严谨，但作为预印本，其结论尚未经过同行评议的最终确认。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种新方法，能帮助AI智能体更准确、更高效地从大量工具中选择所需工具。

title: Making every stage of medical device document assessment with large language models deterministic
abstract:
arXiv:2610.21300v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: To show that a medical device complies with regulation, experts judge whether documents and records meet each requirement and record the judgment for others to verify. For each assessment item that experts define, large language models could prepare a preliminary assessment: a label such as Satisfied or Not satisfied, a reason and quoted evidence. We sent fourteen commercial deployments of such models (seven models from three providers, through six routes) the same request repeatedly, with the deterministic sampling settings each accepted; every deployment returned differing assessments for at least one request, and in twelve the label changed. Reducing reasoning where the interface allows it did not reduce the variation, and prompts of retrieved passages removed it only for the smallest models. The same open-weight model was reproducible or not depending only on how it was served. A pipeline we built to be deterministic at every stage -- text extraction and optical character recognition (OCR), chunking, embedding, indexing, retrieval and inference -- returned byte-identical output at each stage across reruns, interruptions, edits, machines of one graphics processing unit (GPU) model and days, for blood glucose meter and infusion pump documents. OCR, embedding and approximate retrieval varied when their own serving was not made invariant, and outputs changed with the GPU model and with the inference engine's scheduling settings, which therefore belong in the recorded configuration. End-to-end determinism is achievable and gives a testable basis for audit and change control.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于利用大语言模型实现医疗设备文档评估流程的端到端确定性，技术方案前沿且方法严谨，通过多模型对比和全流程控制实验验证了可行性。然而，其应用场景高度特定于医疗设备监管领域，在通用图情业务中的直接落地价值有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究通过构建全流程可控的确定性管道，证明了大语言模型在医疗设备文档合规性评估中可以产出稳定、可复现的结果。

title: Retrieved but Not Read: Understanding Why Search-Augmented LLMs Fail to Use Available Evidence
abstract:
arXiv:2610.21731v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Web search allows LLMs to access up-to-date information, but it remains unclear why they sometimes produce outdated answers even when relevant evidence is available. To study this problem, we construct temporal facts whose values changed after the models' training cutoffs. We evaluate one proprietary model under deployed web search and six open-weight model configurations under controlled retrieval. We find that models often answer from search snippets without opening the source pages, which is associated with higher rates of outdated answers and unfaithful citations. Our controlled experiments and layer-wise analysis reveal a gap between the availability of evidence and its effective use. Even when retrieved evidence influences internal predictions, models may still favour outdated information in their final answers. We hope these findings will help advance research on the reliable use of retrieved evidence in search-augmented LLMs.
thinking: 该论文通过构建时序性事实数据集，系统评估了检索增强大语言模型在证据利用上的缺陷，揭示了模型倾向于依赖摘要而非源文档的机制问题，方法设计严谨且具有启发性。然而，研究主要聚焦于模型行为诊断，其直接针对图书馆或信息机构业务场景的解决方案尚不明确，落地路径有待进一步探索。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，检索增强的大语言模型即使获取了最新证据，也常因依赖搜索结果摘要而非阅读原文，导致给出过时或不准确的答案。

title: CARA: Causally Guided Retrieval Agent for Question Answering
abstract:
arXiv:2610.22017v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation over text-rich knowledge graphs requires identifying evidence that contributes to answering a question, rather than merely matching its textual content. Existing agentic retrievers adaptively balance global search and multi-hop exploration but primarily rely on textual similarity to guide retrieval. We propose CARA, a training-free, CAusally guided Retrieval Agent that explicitly evaluates the causal relevance of retrieved evidence through two complementary criteria: consequentiality, measuring whether adding evidence improves answerability, and essentiality, assessing whether removing evidence weakens answerability. CARA integrates these assessments with path consistency to guide graph exploration and employs reciprocal rank fusion to aggregate evidence from multiple agents. We evaluate CARA on three STaRK datasets and augment STaRK with ground-truth answers to enable downstream question answering evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that CARA consistently outperforms existing retrievers. CARA also improves answer quality and faithfulness while examining fewer graph nodes and requiring fewer retrieval operations. These findings demonstrate that causal relevance assessment enables more focused and effective agentic graph retrieval, improving both retrieval performance and downstream question answering.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于因果推理的检索代理CARA，通过评估证据的因果相关性（必要性和结果性）来优化知识图谱上的检索增强生成，方法新颖且实验设计严谨。然而，作为一篇arXiv预印本，其技术前沿性虽高，但在实际业务场景中的具体落地路径和适用性尚需更多验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种基于因果推理的检索代理，能更精准地从知识图谱中查找答案所需证据，提升问答效果。

title: How Do LLM-Generated Texts Impact Term-Based Retrieval Models?
abstract:
arXiv:2508.17715v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: As more content generated by large language models (LLMs) floods into the Internet, information retrieval (IR) systems now face the challenge of distinguishing and handling a blend of human-authored and machine-generated texts. Recent studies suggest that neural retrievers may exhibit a preferential inclination toward LLM-generated content, while classic term-based retrievers like BM25 tend to favor human-written documents. This paper investigates the influence of LLM-generated content on term-based retrieval models, which are valued for their efficiency and robust generalization across domains. Our linguistic analysis reveals that LLM-generated texts exhibit smoother high-frequency and steeper low-frequency Zipf slopes, higher term specificity, and greater document-level diversity. These traits are aligned with LLMs being trained to optimize reader experience through diverse and precise expressions. Our study further explores whether term-based retrieval models demonstrate source bias, concluding that these models prioritize documents whose term distributions closely correspond to those of the queries, rather than displaying an inherent source bias. This work provides a foundation for understanding and addressing potential biases in term-based IR systems managing mixed-source content.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于LLM生成文本对传统基于词项的检索模型的影响，选题具有前沿性，但研究方法以语言学特征分析为主，未涉及复杂的实验验证或模型创新。研究结论对理解混合来源内容下的检索偏差具有理论价值，但直接应用于实际检索系统的改进路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，基于词项的检索模型对LLM生成内容的偏好源于其与查询的词分布匹配度更高，而非模型本身存在来源偏见。

title: What Tracks Hard-Negative Transfer? A Study of Lexical and Semantic Signals
abstract:
arXiv:2603.20990v5 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Which properties of hard-negative supervision track dense-retriever transfer before training? We compare lexical noncoverage, frozenencoder similarity statistics, hardness proxies, and combinations of these signals across BM25, dense, LLM-generated, and hybrid sources for MS MARCO training. Evaluation uses three retriever backbones and eleven BEIR datasets. Mean lexical residuality, an IDF-weighted measure of query-token noncoverage, reproduces the aggregate transfer ordering in all six backbone and setting blocks. The individual semantic statistics recover none of the complete orderings, and combining them with the lexical signal does not improve the observed rank agreement. After approximately matching BM25, dense, and LLM diagnostic samples for lexical residuality, none of the tested semantic statistics recovers the observed LLM > Dense > BM25 transfer ordering across three backbones, three matching resolutions, and 100 repetitions. Constructed controls further show that unrelated and false-negative-shaped passages can exhibit favorable lexical and semantic statistics. The findings identify a simple lexical association in this setting while distinguishing source level transfer agreement from the reliability of individual negatives.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于密集检索器迁移学习中的硬负样本选择问题，系统性地比较了词法和语义信号的预测能力，方法设计严谨，实验规模较大。研究结论明确指出了词法信号（如平均词法残差）在预测迁移性能上的主导作用，而语义信号作用有限，这为实际检索系统构建提供了直接的指导。然而，其技术核心仍围绕传统检索模型（如BM25）与预训练编码器的分析，未直接采用最前沿的大模型架构进行端到端优化，因此在技术前沿性上有所保留。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，在预测密集检索器迁移性能时，词法信号的预测能力远超语义信号，为高效构建训练数据提供了关键依据。

title: GRASP: Plan-Guided Graph Retrieval with Adaptive Fusion and Reranking on Semi-Structured Knowledge Bases
abstract:
arXiv:2605.30237v3 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Retrieval over semi-structured knowledge bases (SKBs) must handle both textual descriptions and relational constraints. Text-based retrievers capture the overall semantics of a query but struggle with multi-hop relations, whereas graph-based retrievers follow relational paths precisely but miss the broader meaning. We propose GRASP, a hybrid retriever that learns to fuse the two. A small LLM planner translates the query into an executable graph plan in a single call, its graph ranking is fused with a text ranking, and a fine-tuned reranker reorders the fused candidates. Instead of training the planner to be accurate on its own, we optimize it with reinforcement learning to maximize the gain its graph ranking brings to the fused ranking. On three STaRK benchmarks, GRASP achieves the best results on all metrics, improving the average Hit@1 by 18.6 points over the strongest baseline, while taking only 2.47 seconds per query.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种结合文本检索与图检索的混合检索方法，并引入强化学习优化规划器，在技术方法上具有前沿性。其方法在标准基准测试中验证有效，但作为预印本尚未经过同行评议，且主要面向特定SKB场景，在图书馆等实际业务中的直接应用路径尚需进一步探索。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种融合文本与图检索的混合方法，通过强化学习优化查询规划，在半结构化知识库检索任务上显著提升了准确率。

title: MemSyco-Bench: Benchmarking Sycophancy in Agent Memory
abstract:
arXiv:2607.01071v3 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Memory has emerged as a cornerstone of modern LLM-based agents, supporting their evolution from single-turn assistants to long-term collaborators. However, memory is not always beneficial: retrieved memories often induce a critical issue of sycophancy, causing agents to over-align with the user at the cost of factual accuracy or objective reasoning. Despite this emerging risk, existing memory benchmarks primarily evaluate whether memories are correctly stored, retrieved, or updated, while overlooking how retrieved memories influence downstream reasoning and decision-making. To bridge this gap, we propose MemSyco-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating memory-induced sycophancy in agent systems. MemSyco-Bench measures when memory should influence a decision and how valid memory should be used. Specifically, it covers five tasks that assess whether agents can reject memory as factual evidence, respect its applicable scope, resolve conflicts between memory and objective evidence, track memory updates, and use valid memory for personalization. All related resources are collected for the community at https://github.com/XMUDeepLIT/MemSyco-Bench.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于LLM智能体记忆引发的谄媚问题，提出了首个专门的评测基准MemSyco-Bench，选题新颖且切中了当前AI代理研究中的一个关键风险，技术前沿性高。其工作系统性地构建了涵盖五个任务的评测框架，方法论严谨，代码开源也利于社区复用，但作为基准研究，其本身对图书馆等业务场景的直接落地价值尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了首个用于评测大型语言模型智能体因记忆检索而产生谄媚行为的基准测试工具集。

title: KoViDoRe: A Benchmark for Korean Visual Document Retrieval
abstract:
arXiv:2608.20840v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Recent advances in multimodal retrieval have improved the ability to retrieve information from visually rich documents such as PDFs and reports. However, existing benchmarks remain largely centered on English and provide limited coverage of Korean visual documents with complex structures. Furthermore, most existing Korean resources primarily evaluate single-page retrieval, failing to capture realistic scenarios that require evidence aggregation across multiple pages. To address these gaps, we introduce KoViDoRe, a benchmark for Korean visual document retrieval. The dataset is constructed from publicly available Korean documents with diverse layouts, including tables, figures, and multi-column structures. We develop a multi-stage data curation pipeline consisting of structured document parsing, synthetic query generation using both summary-based and context-based strategies, and relevance mapping with human verification. Using KoViDoRe, we evaluate a wide range of multimodal retrieval models and observe that current models struggle to effectively handle Korean visual document retrieval, particularly in settings involving structured content and diverse query types. Motivated by this finding, we further curate a large-scale training dataset, Ko-VDR Train Public, to support the development of retrieval models tailored to Korean visual documents. Together, KoViDoRe and Ko-VDR Train Public provide a unified benchmark and training resource for Korean visual document retrieval.
thinking: 该论文构建了首个针对韩语视觉文档检索的基准数据集KoViDoRe，并配套发布了大规模训练集，填补了多模态检索领域非英语资源的空白。其数据构建流程规范，包含人工验证环节，方法严谨性较高；但技术方法本身未提出创新模型，前沿技术度中等。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究创建了一个用于评估和训练韩语视觉文档（如含表格、图表的多页PDF）检索模型的标准数据集与基准。

title: Self-improving data synthesis enables scalable adaptation of embedding models
abstract:
arXiv:2610.14730v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: AI agents require specialised retrieval across domains and tasks, but adapting embedding models is constrained by costly manual training-data design. Here we introduce SYNTRA, a self-improving agentic framework that turns a few retrieval examples into reusable synthesis instructions. Given an unlabelled corpus and a few relevant query-document pairs, SYNTRA infers implicit information needs and relevance criteria, then uses feedback on trial outputs to refine instructions for query generation and relevance assessment. Experiments across 24 datasets spanning 15 domains demonstrate that the same synthesis workflow produces effective training data, benefiting even strong embedding models with and without existing labelled training sets. Self-improvement strengthens this supervision on all six evaluated tasks, yielding better retrieval than human calibration on four. The training value persists at larger scales: on MS MARCO, retrieval gains continue across a 32-fold range of synthetic training-data sizes. SYNTRA thus enables scalable embedding-model adaptation with minimal human intervention.
thinking: 该论文提出的SYNTRA框架通过自改进机制自动生成合成训练数据，显著减少人工标注成本，在信息检索领域具有较高的技术前沿性。实验设计覆盖24个数据集和15个领域，方法严谨性较强，但其在图书馆等具体业务场景的直接落地路径仍需进一步明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种能自动生成并优化训练数据的自改进框架，可有效提升嵌入模型在不同领域的检索性能，减少对人工标注的依赖。

title: When Inputs Receive No Score: Evaluating Open-Web Event Admission on the Complete Stream
abstract:
arXiv:2610.17814v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: A Web item can link to the correct event without contributing information worth organizing. Evaluating item-level admission therefore begins with complete inputs, including those a processing pipeline fails to score. We study how this upstream selection changes ranking comparisons and constrains operational decisions. Across six instruction-model backbones, three strategies, and 602 human-annotated evaluation items, systems score different populations with different class compositions. Comparing rankings on shared inputs separates these population differences from discrimination. Score availability also limits attainable retention: four configurations score only ten of twelve positive development items, making a 90% full-stream target unreachable by threshold adjustment. Paired precision experiments show that this constraint depends on execution configuration as well as model choice. Qwen scores the same number of evaluation items under INT4 and INT8, yet exchanges four scored items for four others. Extraction-recovery diagnostics further show that obtaining more scores can increase false acceptance under an unchanged threshold. We connect these observations through a complete-stream evaluation protocol that checks calibration feasibility and separates upstream score loss from decision loss. The resulting account explains which inputs a system can score, what its operating point can achieve, and what it actually admits.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于开放网络事件准入评估中未评分输入的处理问题，提出了一个基于完整数据流的评估协议，方法设计严谨，通过多模型、多策略和人工标注数据进行了系统性验证。其研究问题具有较强的技术前沿性，但作为一项偏重方法论验证的研究，其直接面向图书馆等机构的业务落地路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 论文提出了一种评估网络事件信息处理系统的新方法，强调必须考虑所有输入（包括未评分的），才能准确衡量系统性能并设定可行的操作目标。

title: Enhancing Knowledge Density via Hierarchical Context Pruning for Retrieval-Augmented Repository-Level Code Completion
abstract:
arXiv:2508.10068v3 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has advanced repository-level code completion by retrieving external code snippets, API documentation, or type definitions to expand the model's contextual awareness. However, under the finite token budget of the context window, existing retrieval-augmented methods often saturate the budget with highly similar or even redundant code, which not only wastes tokens but also suppresses critical cross-file dependencies, preventing synergistic interaction between semantically similar reference snippets and cross-file dependency definitions. Therefore, further gains are limited by low knowledge density in the retrieved context rather than by model capacity. We propose SaraCoder, a retrieval-augmented framework that enhances knowledge density via hierarchical context pruning under a fixed context budget. A Hierarchical Feature Optimization module prunes an over-complete candidate pool in four stages. The freed tokens are then allocated to an External-Aware Identifier Disambiguator, which selectively injects only the most necessary cross-file dependency definitions. SaraCoder transforms context construction into a budget-aware optimization problem, balancing reference snippets and cross-file dependencies to build a context that is both knowledge-dense and semantically complete. Experiments on CrossCodeEval and RepoEval-Updated, across multiple backbone code LLMs, show that SaraCoder consistently outperforms strong RAG baselines such as GraphCoder and Repocoder in both code-level and identifier-level metrics, without increasing token usage, and yields synergistic gains when combined with other cross-file methods.
thinking: 该论文针对检索增强代码补全中的上下文冗余问题，提出了分层剪枝框架SaraCoder，技术方案新颖且实验验证充分，属于前沿的AI应用研究。其方法在固定上下文预算下优化知识密度，具有明确的工程应用价值，但主要面向软件开发场景，在图情领域的直接落地性有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种分层剪枝框架，能在固定上下文长度内优化检索到的代码信息密度，从而提升代码补全的准确性。

title: GraphCompliance: Structure-Aware Regulatory Compliance through Policy-Context Graph Alignment
abstract:
arXiv:2510.26309v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Regulatory compliance is an important requirement in many industrial and administrative settings. Yet compliance assessment remains difficult because regulatory requirements are distributed across structured documents and may depend on hierarchy, definitions, conditions, and cross-references, while the evidence relevant to a particular requirement may be embedded among multiple interacting actors, events, objects, and conditions in the assessed context. We present GraphCompliance, a structure-aware framework that represents regulatory documents as a schema-guided Policy Graph and contextual information as a Context Graph of entity-relation triples. GraphCompliance aligns the two graphs through a Compliance Gate, which identifies relevant regulatory requirements and evaluates them against the corresponding contextual evidence. This design makes regulatory structure explicit while organizing contextual facts into a comparable form, helping preserve structural dependencies and reduce terminology mismatch across different regulatory settings. Evaluation on EU2UK, GDPR-13, and CONTRACT yields Matthews correlation coefficients (MCC) of 0.802, 0.682, and 0.793, respectively. These values are numerically higher than those of the strongest compared methods on all three datasets. Ablation results further show that the key components of GraphCompliance contribute to its overall performance. These results support the utility of structured policy-context alignment for compliance-related prediction across heterogeneous regulatory settings. The source code of GraphCompliance is available at https://github.com/CHUNG-JiSeong/GraphCompliance.git.
thinking: 该论文提出了一个基于图结构对齐的法规遵从性评估框架，将法规文档和上下文信息分别建模为政策图和上下文图，并通过一个合规门进行对齐和评估，方法设计具有创新性。论文在多个数据集上进行了评估，结果优于基线方法，并进行了消融实验验证组件有效性，方法较为严谨。然而，其应用场景虽具有普遍意义，但在图情领域（如图书馆政策合规、数据管理规范检查）的直接落地路径和案例尚不明确，实践价值有待具体场景验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种通过图结构对齐来评估法规遵从性的新框架，在多个测试集上取得了优于现有方法的效果。

title: Multi-Agent Transactive Memory
abstract:
arXiv:2606.19911v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Decentralized deployment of LLM agents with diverse capabilities motivates infrastructure for knowledge sharing across heterogeneous agent populations. Just as search engines index human-generated artifacts for human problem solving, retrieval systems can organize agent-generated artifacts for reuse across agents, extending retrieval-augmented generation from human-authored documents to agent-generated ones. Agent trajectories in particular encode reusable procedural knowledge, yet are typically discarded after a single use or retained only by the producing agent, forcing newly instantiated agents to rediscover existing solutions. We propose Multi-Agent Transactive Memory (MATM), a framework for population-level storage and retrieval of agent trajectories, where producer agents contribute trajectories to a shared repository and consumer agents retrieve them to improve task execution. In interactive environments with long, procedurally rich trajectories (ALFWorld and WebArena), retrieving from MATM improves downstream task performance and reduces interaction steps without coordination or joint training, positioning MATM as a design pattern for population-level experience sharing in open agent ecosystems.
thinking: 论文提出了多智能体交互记忆框架，将检索增强生成从人类文档扩展到智能体生成轨迹，在交互环境中验证了其提升任务性能和减少交互步骤的效果，具有较好的技术前沿性和方法严谨性。然而，其业务落地价值目前主要局限于开放智能体生态系统这一特定研究场景，在传统图书馆和信息机构中的直接应用路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一个让不同AI智能体共享和复用任务执行经验的知识库框架，能有效提升后续任务的完成效率。

title: PremiseCheck: Efficient Fact-Checking of Human and AI Peer Reviews
abstract:
arXiv:2610.21046v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Peer review is under strain from the growth of submissions, and review comments written by humans or AI can misstate what a paper says. We introduce ReviewFact, a benchmark that labels such factual errors in review comments under one definition across NLP, machine learning, and the natural sciences, and that measures cost and latency alongside accuracy. A frontier LLM checks comments well but must read the whole paper for each check, while cheap decision models, which score whether a statement holds in a text, fall far short on whole comments that mix several implicit assertions. PremiseCheck is a framework that combines the two. An LLM rewrites each comment as explicit premises without reading the paper, and a decision model checks each premise against the paper. When each comment is checked on its own, PremiseCheck reaches accuracy comparable to GPT-5.5 across all three fields at about half its cost, and on NLP reviews at a quarter of its cost and less than half its latency.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种结合大语言模型与决策模型的高效事实核查框架，在保持高准确率的同时显著降低了计算成本和延迟，具有明确的技术创新性和实用性。然而，研究主要基于构建的基准数据集进行验证，尚未在真实、大规模的同行评审流程中进行应用测试，其方法严谨性有待进一步实践检验。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种混合模型框架，能以更低成本和延迟，高效核查人类或AI生成的同行评审意见中的事实错误。

title: SHIP: Structured and Hierarchical Insight with Privacy
abstract:
arXiv:2610.21048v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Extracting insights from textual data while protecting user privacy is increasingly important. Existing methods produce private insights in diverse forms for different analytical purposes, making their utility difficult to assess and compare. In this work, we formulate differentially private (DP) insights as reusable representations for answering analytical queries, providing a common basis for utility assessment. Answering these queries, however, requires fine-grained details and cross-attribute statistics that existing representations may omit. To capture this information, we introduce Structured and Hierarchical Insight with Privacy (SHIP), which automatically maps queries to attributes, builds a hierarchical hybrid taxonomy, and releases a DP synthetic table for further analysis. We also develop an evaluation protocol based primarily on QA performance and structured fidelity. Our experiments demonstrate SHIP's strong performance on both measures relative to existing private insight baselines, while identifying queries that remain challenging for structured representations.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种结合差分隐私与结构化层次化洞察提取的方法，在隐私保护前提下提升文本数据分析的可用性，技术方案新颖且实验设计较为系统。然而，作为预印本论文，其方法在图书馆等具体业务场景中的直接落地路径尚不明确，且未经过严格的同行评审过程。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种名为SHIP的新方法，能在保护用户隐私的同时，从文本中自动提取结构化的、可重用的洞察信息用于分析查询。

title: OpCredit: Operation-Aware Policy Learning for Agentic Knowledge Graph Question Answering
abstract:
arXiv:2610.21345v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Agentic knowledge graph question answering(KGQA) relies on sequences of executable operations, but trajectory-level rewards obscure their individual contributions. Successful trajectories may contain ineffective operations, while failed trajectories may contain useful ones. To assess individual operations, we propose OpCredit, an operationaware policy-learning framework that combines downstream outcome credit with immediate transition credit: Branch Outcome Credit (BOC) reuses ordinary rollouts to compare terminal task rewards observed after different operations under matched navigation contexts; Frontier Transition Credit (FTC) measures operation-induced changes in answer-conditioned frontier potential. The two complementary signals jointly supervise the corresponding decision spans during training, while inference uses only the learned policy and standard KG interface. Experiments on ComplexWebQuestions, WebQSP, and GrailQA across three backbones demonstrate consistent improvements in KGQA performance.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种针对知识图谱问答中操作级贡献评估的新框架，结合了结果信用和即时转移信用，在方法设计上具有创新性，属于前沿的强化学习应用。其方法在多个基准数据集上验证有效，但作为预印本，其方法严谨性（如实验细节和可复现性）的最终评估需待同行评审确认。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种新的操作感知策略学习框架，通过更精细地评估每一步操作的贡献，提升了智能体在知识图谱问答任务中的性能。

title: In the Guise of Correction: How Framing and Cultural Adaptation Erode LLM Safety on Real-World Criminal Cases
abstract:
arXiv:2610.21789v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Existing safety benchmarks rely largely on synthetic prompts with loosely grounded taxonomies and offer little focused analysis of severe crime categories. We introduce GUISE, a benchmark of criminal-assistance scenarios sourced from real-world cases and organised under a taxonomy from the UNODC International Classification of Crime for Statistical Purposes (ICCS). Each scenario is rendered under three linguistic framings and evaluated across five distinct cultures. Using our proposed two-tier evaluation framework, which judges both harmfulness and operational uplift, we find that: (i) framing alone drives unsafe compliance, with the mean unsafe compliance rate rising from 28.9% under direct requests to 66.4% under correction seeking (peaking at 97.3%; p < 0.05), as models correcting deliberately distorted details supply executable criminal steps; (ii) culturally adapted prompts elicit significantly more unsafe compliance than literal translations of the same requests in all four non-English languages (+7 to +18 points), a risk that translation-based benchmarks miss; and (iii) unsafe responses from the least-safe models carry strong Anglocentric registers, and the extent of this leakage increases monotonically with response harmfulness ($\rho$ = 0.46 to 0.63 across languages, all p < 0.001). GUISE offers a grounded resource and fine-grained diagnostics for strengthening refusal alignment across languages and cultures. We publish our code and data to facilitate future research.
thinking: 该论文通过构建基于真实犯罪案例的基准测试GUISE，系统评估了不同语言框架和文化适配对LLM安全性的侵蚀效应，方法严谨且样本具有现实基础。其发现对多语言大模型的安全对齐具有直接警示作用，但技术前沿性主要体现在评估框架而非模型本身。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，以“请求更正”为名提问或进行文化适配，会显著增加大语言模型对真实犯罪协助请求的危险响应率。

title: A Self-Improving Agent that Grows its Own DSL: Oracle-Free Operator Induction for Exact Question Answering
abstract:
arXiv:2610.20809v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: A self-improving agent has to decide which new skills to keep, and in practice it keeps whatever earns a high reward, convinces a judge model, or compresses its library, even when the skill is wrong. That is fine until the answers have to be exactly right: over a table of transactions, a total is either right or wrong. We ask a harder question: can an agent grow what it can compute with no reward, no judge, and no answer key, and still be exactly right? A single frozen model runs two nested loops over a small, exact domain-specific language (DSL). The inner loop answers new questions only when two independently written expressions agree on every record. The outer loop discovers its own missing capability and authors an operator for it, admitted only when an independent second implementation agrees and the result obeys a conservation law, all without ground truth. The inner loop roughly triples the answerable-question set, and the outer loop self-extends on disjoint starting sets, inventing operators outside the starting closure; a no-induction control answers none of the new questions. The admission rule is empirically sound: it rejects 138 of 138 buggy operator variants under an independent reference, even one written by a different model family, where the admit-if-it-runs, self-consistency, and compression signals the field relies on admit most of them. Unmodified, the same mechanism self-extends on two further domains with unrelated schemas, business-ledger and clinical-encounter question answering, growing their answerable sets more than tenfold and nearly twentyfold. The loop transfers across model families too: run with further proposers, the gate stays sound and independent families self-extend comparably, with only the induction yield tracking each proposer's DSL fluency.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种无需外部反馈即可自我扩展精确问答能力的智能体，通过双循环机制和领域特定语言（DSL）实现操作符的自主归纳与验证，方法新颖且严谨性较高。然而，其技术路径虽具前沿性，但主要面向高度结构化的表格数据问答，在图情领域的直接业务落地场景（如图书馆参考咨询）中应用范围可能受限，通用性有待进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究设计了一种能自主归纳新运算符以扩展精确问答能力的智能体，无需外部奖励或答案标注即可在结构化数据领域显著提升可回答问题范围。

title: Do Agents Need a New Kind of Paper? SPRA: Structured Paper Representation for Agents
abstract:
arXiv:2610.21424v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Scientific agents must connect research problems, methods, and findings dispersed through narrative articles. We introduce SPRA (Structured Paper Representation for Agents), a paper-level representation of persistent research objects and typed relations. Its empirical-AI profile organizes Problems, Contributions, Components, ExperimentSetups, Measures, and Findings for querying, traversal, and reuse. Selected paper-level citation relations record dependencies, component use, and comparisons with prior work; source locations support verification. We instantiate SPRA across more than one million AI papers, with 19.95 million research units and 24.07 million internal relations. Evaluations access SPRA through Schema-RAG with task evidence fixed before inference. Across seven subfields, SPRA improves source-conditioned scientific QA by 0.381/5 over passage retrieval while remaining close to Full Compact (0.078/5 lower on average). In directed cross-paper reasoning, qualification improves by 0.184/5 over passage retrieval; Top-5 synthesis shows mixed quality effects. Across all paired RQ2 tasks, including Top-5, input+output tokens decrease by 28.5% relative to passage retrieval and 95.3% relative to Full Compact. In idea generation, a 0.067-point lower Overall score than Full Compact accompanies 93.7% fewer input+output tokens. Together, these results support SPRA as a usable representation of scientific content and a foundation for research workflows that connect, inspect, and reuse paper-level research objects. The SPRA resource is accessible through the SciVerse scholarly-data platform.
thinking: 该论文提出了SPRA这一面向智能体的结构化论文表示框架，将传统叙事性论文内容转化为可查询、可遍历的研究对象网络，并基于百万级AI论文数据集进行了实证构建与评估。其核心优势在于为科学AI智能体提供了可直接操作的、细粒度的知识表示基础，技术前沿性高，方法严谨，通过大规模数据验证了其在提升问答效率与支持跨论文推理方面的价值。不足之处在于其实践应用价值目前主要局限于AI科研辅助场景，尚未广泛集成到图书馆或信息机构的现有工作流中。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究构建了一个面向AI智能体的结构化论文表示框架，能有效组织论文中的研究问题、方法和发现，提升科学问答与跨论文推理的效率。

title: Librarian Agents: Training LLMs to Curate Long-Context Workspaces that Anticipate Future Queries
abstract:
arXiv:2610.22273v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Reasoning over long document contexts remains a challenge for large language models (LLMs). Standard retrieval methods are inherently reactive, bottlenecking agents with complex, cross-document reasoning at inference time, while precomputed structures like knowledge graphs often fall short because they rely on rigid heuristics. Instead, can we allow agents to perform anticipatory directed curation: learning to proactively reorganize unstructured corpora prior to inference to efficiently serve diverse future queries. We build on a key asymmetry in modern agentic harnesses (e.g., Claude Code): while LLM agents are adept at navigating existing filesystems to solve an immediate task, they are rarely trained to construct reusable workspaces for future use. To instantiate this capability, we introduce Librarian Agents, a framework in which a builder agent transforms raw documents into a hierarchical filesystem of synthetic files and reference links, which forms a workspace tailored for a downstream answering agent. We formulate workspace construction as a Markov decision process and optimize the builder policy via reinforcement learning to directly maximize downstream answering accuracy. Empirically, Librarian Agents outperforms the strongest retrieval and precomputation baselines by 33 percentage points on BrowseComp-Plus, amortizes upfront construction costs across repeated queries, and generalizes zero-shot to unseen domains on BRIGHT with a 31-point average accuracy improvement.
thinking: 论文提出了一种基于强化学习的智能体框架，通过预构建层次化文件系统来优化长文档推理，在技术方法上具有显著的前沿性。其研究设计严谨，通过实验验证了性能提升，但作为一项技术探索，其直接应用于图书馆现有业务流程的路径尚不明确，实践价值有待具体场景验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究训练大语言模型作为“图书馆员智能体”，预先将文档整理成结构化工作区，以显著提升后续问答任务的准确率。

title: Chronoberg: A 250-Year Diachronic Corpus with Temporal Affective Lexicons for Language Model Analysis
abstract:
arXiv:2509.22360v3 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel at operating at scale by leveraging social media and data crawled from the web. Whereas existing corpora are diverse, their frequent lack of long-term temporal structure may however limit an LLM's ability to contextualize semantic and normative evolution of language and to capture diachronic variation. To support the latter, we introduce Chronoberg, a temporally structured corpus of English book texts spanning 250 years, curated from Project Gutenberg and enriched with a variety of temporal annotations. First, the edited nature of books enables us to quantify lexical semantic change through time-sensitive Valence-Arousal-Dominance analysis and to support historically-grounded interpretation. With the lexicons at hand, we demonstrate a need for modern LLM-based tools to better situate their contextualization of sentiment and detection of discriminatory language across various time-periods. In fact, we show how these tools struggle with diachronic shifts in meaning, emphasizing the need for temporally aware training and evaluation pipelines, and positioning Chronoberg as a scalable resource for respective studies. Disclaimer: This paper includes language and display of samples that could be offensive to readers. Open Access: Chronoberg is available publicly on HuggingFace at https://huggingface.co/datasets/spaul25/Chronoberg. Code is available at https://github.com/paulsubarna/Chronoberg.
thinking: 该论文构建了一个跨越250年的历时语料库Chronoberg，并整合了时间敏感的情感词典，为分析语言模型在历时语义变化上的表现提供了重要资源。其方法严谨，数据来源可靠且公开，但研究更侧重于资源构建和初步验证，在技术前沿性和直接业务落地方面相对有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究构建了一个覆盖250年的英文历时语料库，揭示了当前大语言模型在理解历史语境和语义变迁方面存在不足。

title: Large Language Models Naively Recover Ethnicity from Individual Records
abstract:
arXiv:2601.21132v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: I demonstrate that large language models can infer ethnicity from names with accuracy exceeding that of Bayesian Improved Surname Geocoding (BISG) without additional training data, enabling inference outside the United States and to contextually appropriate classification categories. Using stratified samples from Florida and North Carolina voter files with self-reported race, LLM-based classification achieves up to 84.7% accuracy, outperforming BISG (68.2%) on balanced samples. I test six models including Gemini 3 Flash, GPT-4o, and open-source alternatives such as DeepSeek v3.2 and GLM-4.7. Enabling extended reasoning can improve accuracy by 1-3 percentage points, though effects vary across contexts; including metadata such as party registration reaches 86.7%. LLM classification also reduces the income bias inherent in BISG, where minorities in wealthier neighborhoods are systematically misclassified as White. I further validate using Lebanese voter registration with religious sect (64.3% accuracy), Indian MPs from reserved constituencies (99.2%), and Indian land records with caste classification (74.0%). Aggregate validation across India, Uganda, Nepal, Armenia, Chile, and Costa Rica using original full-count voter rolls demonstrates that the method recovers known population distributions where naming conventions are distinctive. For large-scale applications, small transformer models fine-tuned on LLM labels exceed BISG accuracy while enabling local deployment at no cost.
thinking: 该论文系统评估了大语言模型从姓名推断族裔的准确性与应用潜力，通过多国选民数据验证了其超越传统方法（BISG）的性能和减少收入偏误的优势，方法设计严谨，样本多样且验证充分。研究虽聚焦前沿技术应用，但其核心贡献在于提供了一种低成本、可泛化的社会人口统计推断方法，对图书馆、档案馆等机构在用户研究或历史记录分析中处理敏感人口信息具有直接参考价值。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现大语言模型仅凭姓名就能高精度推断个人族裔，其表现优于传统统计方法，且能减少偏见并推广至多国场景。

title: EnsembleLink: Accurate Record Linkage Without Training Data
abstract:
arXiv:2601.21138v3 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Record linkage, the process of matching records that refer to the same entity across datasets, is essential to empirical social science but remains methodologically underdeveloped. Researchers treat it as a preprocessing step, applying ad hoc rules without quantifying the uncertainty that linkage errors introduce into downstream analyses. Existing methods either achieve low accuracy or require substantial labeled training data. I present EnsembleLink, a method that achieves high accuracy without any training labels. EnsembleLink leverages pre-trained language models that have learned semantic relationships (e.g., that "South Ozone Park" is a neighborhood in "New York City" or that "Lutte ouvriere" refers to the Trotskyist "Workers' Struggle" party) from large text corpora. On benchmarks spanning city names, person names, organizations, multilingual political parties, and bibliographic records, EnsembleLink matches or exceeds methods requiring extensive labeling. The method runs locally on open-source models, requiring no external API calls, and completes typical linkage tasks in minutes.
thinking: 该论文提出的EnsembleLink方法利用预训练语言模型实现无监督记录链接，在多个基准测试中达到了与有监督方法相当的准确率，技术前沿性突出。方法设计严谨，在多个数据集上验证了有效性，且开源模型本地运行的特性增强了其可复现性和实用性。然而，论文主要聚焦于方法验证，在图书馆、信息机构等具体业务场景下的直接落地路径和案例阐述不足。
one_sentence_summary: 该方法利用预训练语言模型的语义理解能力，无需人工标注即可实现高精度的跨数据集记录匹配。

title: MoCo: A One-Stop Shop for Model Collaboration Research
abstract:
arXiv:2601.21257v3 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Advancing beyond single monolithic language models (LMs), recent research increasingly recognizes the importance of model collaboration, where multiple LMs collaborate, compose, and complement each other. Existing research on this topic has mostly been disparate and disconnected, from different research communities, and lacks rigorous comparison. To consolidate existing research and establish model collaboration as a school of thought, we present MoCo: a one-stop Python library of executing, benchmarking, and comparing model collaboration algorithms at scale. MoCo features 26 model collaboration methods, spanning diverse levels of cross-model information exchange such as routing, text, logit, and model parameters. MoCo integrates 25 evaluation datasets spanning reasoning, QA, code, safety, and more, while users could flexibly bring their own data. Extensive experiments with MoCo demonstrate that most collaboration strategies outperform models without collaboration in 61.0% of (model, data) settings on average, with the most effective methods outperforming by up to 25.8%. We further analyze the scaling of model collaboration strategies, the training/inference efficiency of diverse methods, highlight that the collaborative system solves problems where single LMs struggle, and discuss future work in model collaboration, all made possible by MoCo. We envision MoCo as a valuable toolkit to facilitate and turbocharge the quest for an open, modular, decentralized, and collaborative AI future.
thinking: 该论文提出了一个用于模型协作研究的Python库MoCo，整合了26种协作方法和25个评估数据集，具有较强的技术前沿性和方法严谨性。然而，其作为工具库的性质使其在图情领域的直接业务落地价值尚不明确，需要结合具体应用场景进行转化。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究开发了一个整合多种大语言模型协作算法的工具库，实验表明模型协作策略在多数情况下能有效提升性能。

title: LLMSurgeon: Diagnosing Data Mixture of Large Language Models
abstract:
arXiv:2605.30348v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: The pretraining data mixture of Large Language Models (LLMs) constitutes their "digital DNA", shaping model behaviors, capabilities, and failure modes. Yet this composition is rarely disclosed, making post-hoc auditing of data combination or provenance difficult. In this work, we formalize Data Mixture Surgery (DMS): given only generated text from a target LLM, estimate the domain-level distribution of its pretraining corpus under a predefined taxonomy. We propose $\textbf{{LLMSurgeon}}$, a strong framework that casts DMS as an inverse problem under the label-shift assumption. Rather than directly aggregating classifier outputs, LLMSurgeon estimates a calibrated $\textit{soft}$ confusion matrix and solves a constrained inverse problem to correct systematic domain confusion and recover the latent mixture prior. To evaluate, we introduce $\textbf{{LLMScan}}$, a recipe-verifiable evaluation suite built from open-source LLMs with transparent pretraining mixtures. Across LLMScan, LLMSurgeon recovers domain mixtures with high fidelity under fixed protocols. Our work presents a practical, post-hoc approach for auditing the digital DNA of foundation models without access to their training data.
thinking: 论文提出了一种通过生成文本逆向推断大语言模型预训练数据混合比例的方法，在技术上有创新性，且方法设计严谨，通过构建可验证的数据集进行了系统评估。但该方法目前主要面向模型审计，对图书馆等机构的直接应用价值尚不明确，落地场景有待进一步探索。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种仅通过模型输出文本就能逆向推断其预训练数据构成比例的后审计方法。

title: AlignSAE: Concept-Aligned Sparse Autoencoders
abstract:
arXiv:2512.02004v4 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) encode factual knowledge within hidden parametric spaces that are difficult to inspect or control. While Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) can decompose hidden activations into more fine-grained, interpretable features, they often struggle to reliably align these features with human-defined concepts, resulting in entangled and distributed feature representations. To address this, we introduce AlignSAE, a method that aligns SAE features with a predefined ontology through a "pre-train, then post-train" curriculum. After an initial unsupervised training phase, we apply supervised post-training to bind specific concepts to dedicated latent slots while preserving the remaining capacity for general reconstruction. This separation creates an interpretable interface where specific concepts can be inspected and controlled without interference from unrelated features. Empirical results on GPT-2 across synthetic biographical QA (1-hop, 6 concepts) and compositional relational reasoning (2-hop, 20 concepts) demonstrate that AlignSAE enables precise causal interventions, such as reliable concept swaps (94.8% success in 1-hop), by targeting single, semantically aligned slots. AlignSAE achieves disentanglement improvements of $9$--$\infty\times$ over standard SAEs (measured via Mutual Information Gap), and further supports multi-hop reasoning and a mechanistic probe of grokking-like generalization dynamics. Although our evaluation focuses on GPT-2, AlignSAE itself is model-agnostic.

title: Cost-Efficient RAG for Entity Matching with LLMs: A Blocking-based Batch Processing Framework
abstract:
arXiv:2602.05708v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) offer a compelling approach to entity matching (EM) in label-scarce settings, yet their matching quality is sensitive to records with ambiguous or sparse attributes due to the absence of external factual grounding. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) directly addresses this grounding gap by retrieving and injecting relevant external knowledge. However, naively applying RAG to large-scale EM is expensive due to per-pair retrieval calls over large knowledge graphs (KGs) and the increase in input tokens caused by enriching prompts with retrieved contextual knowledge. To address the above limitation, we introduce a CE-RAG4EM (Cost-Efficient RAG for Entity Matching) framework that reduces overhead through blocking-based batch retrieval and generation. We investigate the benefits of this framework through a systematic analysis of RAG systems for entity matching, focusing on blocking-aware batch optimizations and retrieval granularity. Extensive experiments on nine widely used real-world entity matching benchmark datasets show that CE-RAG4EM under a zero-shot setting achieves comparable or improved matching quality while substantially reducing end-to-end overhead. The results demonstrate that our CE-RAG4EM closes the knowledge grounding gap of the LLM-EM baseline and yields significant improvements in F1 scores on datasets with ambiguous or numerically sparse attributes, while its batch retrieval and inference substantially reduce the overhead and maintain competitive matching quality compared to naive RAG4EM. Our analysis identifies clear performance-overhead trade-offs across blocking-based batch sizes and retrieval granularity, showing how matching quality and computational cost shift with each design choice. These findings offer concrete guidance for building scalable, efficient RAG systems for entity matching that balance accuracy and cost.

title: General Classification for Digital Knowledge: Algorithm, Identifiers and a First Benchmark
abstract:
arXiv:2610.19547v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Digital libraries and knowledge graphs need a way to organize very large collections so that related works are close and any work is quick to reach. The classifications libraries inherited for this, such as LCC and DDC, are maintained by editorial staff, are partly closed, and were not built against a stated, measurable objective. We propose the opposite: a general classification that is fitted, under the constraints that make a classification usable on a shelf or in a browse list, to the same quantity that a companion survey and benchmark (Awad, 2026) ranks existing schemes by. The objective is J = D + 0.005 N, where D is the normalized Dasgupta cost of the class tree on a fixed similarity graph (Dasgupta, 2016) and N is an expected navigation cost in bits with a per-level charge. Two constraints are hard: every class is a contiguous run of one fixed shelf order (the optimal-alphabetic-tree constraint of Hu and Tucker, 1971), and new works are filed by splitting leaf classes only, so that every existing class keeps its code, label and parent. On a corpus of 10,000 arXiv papers the fitted prototype has 110 hand-labelled classes and reaches cost 0.1722 in sample (average linkage 0.1518; arXiv's own categories 0.3333; the best existing scheme reached through the same lexical classifier 0.6414, from the survey). Filing 500 library books as new works created 16 classes and changed no existing identifier. Fit, filing and scoring share one embedding: the held-out skill of 0.922 falls to 0.896 when the same fit is scored on the graphs of the two other models, and on books the average falls from 0.806 to 0.731. The scheme has also seen only arXiv, and labels for inserted classes are weak. We state those limits plainly, release the scheme as CC0 open data, and ask whether a learned, open, order-preserving classification can become a general one.
thinking: 论文提出了一种基于算法和标识符的数字知识通用分类方法，并构建了首个基准测试，在方法严谨性上表现突出，通过具体数据集（arXiv论文）验证了方案的有效性。然而，该研究主要基于arXiv单一数据集，对新插入类别的标签处理较弱，且其前沿性更多体现在对传统分类问题的优化方法上，而非引入全新的颠覆性技术。

title: Reading the Neighborhood: Text-Attentive Graph Reranking for Automated Subject Indexing
abstract:
arXiv:2610.20048v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Subject indexing assigns descriptors from a controlled vocabulary to bibliographic records, a task characterized by thousands of labels, few positive examples per label, and a long tail of rarely used descriptors. Existing extreme multi-label classifiers treat the vocabulary as a flat list, ignoring the semantic relations that thesauri encode. We present TAGHN, a heterogeneous graph reranker over a per-document subgraph of retrieved candidates augmented with the thesaurus neighborhood. The relevance of a candidate descriptor is estimated jointly from its similarity with the document and also the degree to which the candidate's thesaurus neighborhood matches the document content. A decomposed scoring head combines interpretable graph-derived features with retrieval signals. On STW, an economic thesaurus of 6,198 descriptors, TAGHN reaches 0.380 macro F1 against 0.346 for a fine-tuned cross-encoder and 0.278 for a fixed-vocabulary XMLC classifier. In terms of micro F1, it outperforms reranking models and stays competitive (-3.0) with the best fixed-vocabulary XMLC model. Qualitative analysis shows the graph resolving errors that per-label scoring cannot, selecting a narrower gold descriptor where an unstructured reranker settles for its broader parent.

title: Filling holes in science draws collective attention, but most higher-order holes remain unexplored
abstract:
arXiv:2608.28822v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Most scientific discoveries justify their significance by filling holes between existing ideas and arguments. Representing knowledge as high-dimensional concept embeddings, we use persistent homology to detect scientific holes of increasing order, from lower-order gaps between disconnected ideas to higher-order cavities within unevenly connected ones; then we identify the research that fills them. Researchers who close holes draw outsized collective attention, staging novelty that the citing literature rewards, most strongly in discovery-oriented fields and least in design-oriented fields. Closing a hole is followed by persistent work on the same combinations of concepts at many times the rate of comparable holes left open. Yet as knowledge grows, higher-order holes explode while the fraction of research that fills them collapses, leaving most higher-order combinations unexplored. These results call for a richer science of holes and mark a frontier where contemporary AI might help fill the gaps human science opens.
thinking: 该论文采用持续同调等前沿数学方法分析科学知识结构中的“空洞”，方法新颖且具有理论深度，但缺乏具体应用场景和实证验证，实践指导性较弱。

title: Revisiting Generative vs. Dense Retrieval: A Static Value Prior Reverses the Gap
abstract:
arXiv:2610.19065v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Generative retrieval (GR) has emerged as a strong candidate generator for sequential recommendation as language models and semantic-item identifiers have improved. However, GR is not a uniformly stronger replacement of dense retrieval (DR) in online retail candidate generation. We examine their differences on two Amazon Toys datasets under different metrics. GR leads on best relevant item value among users both methods cover, while DR leads on exact-target recall and relevant value across the ranked list. With deep analysis, we find that popularity contributes the most to GR's measured value lead. Adding the same static item value to DR in one reranking step reverses this lead and keeps recall above GR. Finally, on an industrial-scale internal e-commerce dataset with LLM-judged relevance, we show that a 14B SID-LLM still underperforms a $47\times$ smaller dense encoder.

title: RCER: Reconstructing Cross-Evidence Relations for Iterative Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract:
arXiv:2610.19398v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Iterative retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) accumulates knowledge from retrieved evidence to answer complex questions, but existing methods struggle to reconstruct entity correspondences and inferential dependencies across retrieved passages as new information emerges. We propose RCER, an iterative RAG method that reconstructs these cross-evidence relations directly from accumulated source passages. Inter-round relational evidence acquisition identifies entity correspondences and relational dependencies to drive dynamic problem decomposition and iterative retrieval. Reasoning context reconstruction independently constructs a coherent reasoning context through joint selection of complementary passages and derivation of cross-evidence inferences. Cross-evidence compositional reasoning leverages these inferences to establish entity correspondences and compose relations across selected passages for answer derivation. Experiments show that RCER outperforms the best baselines by 2.83 EM and 3.06 F1 points on average across three multi-hop QA benchmarks and achieves superior performance on narrative and implicit reasoning tasks.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种迭代检索增强生成方法RCER，通过重建跨证据关系来提升复杂问答性能，在方法设计上具有创新性，并经过多基准测试验证。然而，作为一篇预印本论文，其方法严谨性虽在实验部分有所体现，但尚未经过同行评议的全面检验，且其技术前沿性主要体现在对现有RAG框架的优化上，而非引入全新的基础技术。

title: Bridging the Topological Divide: Dual-Branch Graph Distillation with Semantic Priors for Robust Cold-Start Recommendation
abstract:
arXiv:2610.19578v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Graph Collaborative Filtering models have achieved remarkable success in recommendation systems. However, they inherently suffer from a catastrophic representation collapse in strict cold-start scenarios due to the topological isolation of unobserved items. While integrating multi-modal semantic features offers a potential remedy, directly mapping isolated semantic attributes into a globally topology-driven collaborative space frequently precipitates representation degradation and optimization conflicts. To bridge this fundamental structural divide, we propose DualGCN, an innovative Dual-Branch Graph Knowledge Distillation Framework. Operating under a decoupled two-stage training paradigm, DualGCN first constructs a robust collaborative teacher network where item representations are anchored by a topology-smoothed semantic prior, effectively reshaping the latent manifold. Subsequently, a semantic student branch employs a residual mapping mechanism and a magnitude-agnostic cosine distillation objective to achieve high-fidelity cross-modal alignment without disrupting established collaborative signals. Furthermore, we introduce a dynamic norm reconstruction mechanism to rigorously calibrate the physical scales of novel and warm items during global retrieval. Extensive experiments across three real-world benchmark datasets demonstrate that DualGCN significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in strict cold-start scenarios while comprehensively preserving recommendation accuracy for highly active items.
thinking: 论文针对冷启动推荐中的拓扑隔离问题，提出了一种创新的双分支图知识蒸馏框架，在方法设计上具有前沿性，并通过多数据集实验验证了有效性。然而，作为一篇arXiv预印本，其方法严谨性尚未经过同行评议的完整检验，且其技术方案对实际图书馆或信息系统的工程落地能力提出了较高要求。
